raw.description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

  • Datavail is hiring a Senior Data Architect to lead the design and delivery of modern data platforms for our clients
  • You will own the architecture of client engagements from discovery through production, with a primary focus on Microsoft Fabric and the Azure data ecosystem
  • You will define target-state architectures, build the data models that underpin them, and establish the SDLC and DevOps practices that let client teams operate and extend what we deliver
  • This is a client-facing role
  • You will work directly with business stakeholders, client IT and security teams, and Datavail delivery teams of data engineers, analytics engineers and BI developers, often across several engagements at once

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Architecture and solution design
  • Lead discovery and current-state assessments of client data estates, including sources, integrations, platforms, data quality, security posture and operating model
  • Define target-state and transition architectures for analytics, data warehousing, Lakehouse, real-time and operational data workloads
  • Produce architecture deliverables: solution architecture documents, logical and physical architecture diagrams, architecture decision records (ADRs), non-functional requirements and capacity plans
  • Evaluate platform and build-versus-buy trade-offs across Fabric, Databricks, Azure Synapse Analytics and Azure SQL, and present recommendations with cost, risk and effort clearly stated
  • Apply the Azure Well-Architected Framework (reliability, security, cost optimization, operational excellence, performance efficiency) and the Cloud Adoption Framework's cloud-scale analytics guidance to every design
  • Design for scale and multi-domain ownership, including data mesh and hub-and-spoke patterns where they fit the client's organization
  • Plan and lead migrations from on-premises SQL Server, SSIS, SSAS and legacy data warehouses, and from Azure Synapse dedicated SQL pools, to Fabric and Azure
  • Lead architecture and design reviews, maintain reference architectures and standards, manage exceptions, and track technical debt
    Microsoft Fabric and Azure platform
  • Architect end-to-end Fabric solutions across OneLake, Lakehouse, Warehouse, Data Factory pipelines, Dataflows Gen2, Spark notebooks, Real-Time Intelligence (Eventstream, Eventhouse, KQL) and Power BI
  • Design OneLake strategy: workspace and domain structure, shortcuts to ADLS Gen2 and external storage, database mirroring, and medallion (bronze/silver/gold) layering on Delta Lake
  • Size and govern Fabric capacities (F SKUs), including workload isolation, capacity monitoring, throttling behavior and cost management
  • Forecast consumption, set budgets and tagging/showback standards, monitor unit economics, and optimize cloud/Fabric spend
  • Design Power BI semantic models for performance and scale, including Direct Lake, Import and DirectQuery storage modes, composite models, incremental refresh, and row-level and object-level security
  • Integrate Fabric with the wider Azure estate: ADLS Gen2, Azure Data Factory, Databricks and Unity Catalog, Azure SQL Database and Managed Instance, Cosmos DB, Event Hubs, Azure Functions and Azure Machine Learning
  • Design network and identity controls: Microsoft Entra ID, managed identities and service principals, Azure Key Vault, private endpoints and Private Link, managed virtual networks and workspace-level access
  • Data modeling
  • Own conceptual, logical and physical data models for client solutions, from business glossary through to deployed schemas
  • Apply the right modeling approach for each layer: Kimball dimensional modeling (star schemas, conformed dimensions, bus matrix, slowly changing dimensions Types 1, 2 and 6), Data Vault 2.0 (hubs, links, satellites) for integration layers, and normalized 3NF models for operational and master data
  • Design canonical and enterprise data models, master and reference data structures, and entity resolution approaches
  • Define naming standards, data type conventions, key strategies (surrogate, natural, hash), and partitioning and file layout for Delta tables
  • Maintain models in a modeling tool (erwin Data Modeler, ER/Studio, SqlDBM or equivalent) and keep them in version control alongside code
  • SDLC and DevOps
  • Establish the delivery lifecycle for data workloads: environment strategy (dev, test, prod), branching and pull request standards, code review, release management and rollback
  • Implement Fabric Git integration with Azure DevOps or GitHub, Fabric deployment pipelines, and automated deployment using the Fabric REST APIs and the fabric-cicd library
  • Build CI/CD pipelines in Azure DevOps Pipelines and GitHub Actions for Fabric items, Azure Data Factory, Databricks (Asset Bundles), SQL database projects (DACPAC/sqlpackage) and Power BI (PBIP/TMDL)
  • Define infrastructure as code with Bicep and Terraform for Azure resources, identities and networking
  • Embed automated testing: unit tests for transformations, data quality and contract tests, schema-drift detection, and regression testing of semantic models
  • Define DataOps practices for observability, alerting, lineage, pipeline SLAs and incident response, and hand them over with runbooks
  • Define support models, SLAs/SLOs, escalation paths, training, documentation, and handoff criteria
  • Work within Agile delivery (Scrum or Kanban) using Azure Boards or Jira, including backlog refinement, estimation and sprint planning
  • Set standards for AI-assisted development with GitHub Copilot and AI coding agents across design, code, testing and documentation, including review and quality guardrails
  • Data governance and security
  • Design governance frameworks aligned to DAMA-DMBOK, covering data ownership and stewardship, metadata, data quality, lifecycle and retention
  • Implement Microsoft Purview for data catalog, lineage, classification and sensitivity labels across Fabric and Azure sources
  • Design least-privilege security models using Fabric workspace roles, item permissions, OneLake security, and row-, column- and object-level security
  • Ensure solutions meet client regulatory obligations such as HIPAA, SOC 2, PCI DSS, GDPR and CCPA, working with client compliance and security teams
  • Establish responsible AI and AI governance aligned to the NIST AI Risk Management Framework, the EU AI Act and Microsoft's Responsible AI Standard, including approved model use, data access policies for AI, and human oversight
  • Design security controls for AI workloads, covering prompt injection, data exfiltration through agents, content filtering with Azure AI Content Safety, and Microsoft Purview data security for AI
  • AI and machine learning enablement
  • Design data foundations that support AI and machine learning: curated feature data, data quality controls and governed access for model training and inference
  • Architect solutions that use Azure Machine Learning, Fabric Data Science and Azure OpenAI, including retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) over enterprise data with Azure AI Search
  • Prepare client data estates and semantic models for Copilot in Fabric and Power BI
  • Design Fabric IQ solutions, including ontologies that define business entities, relationships, rules and data bindings to lakehouses, eventhouses and Power BI semantic models, and Fabric data agents for conversational Q&A over ontology-grounded data
    Model knowledge graphs for multi-hop reasoning over connected enterprise data, using Graph in Fabric and other graph technologies where appropriate
  • Architect agentic solutions with Microsoft Foundry and Foundry IQ, using knowledge sources and knowledge bases that ground agents in both unstructured content and structured Fabric data
  • Define where AI agents and models sit in the overall platform, including when to use Fabric, Foundry or Databricks, and how agents access governed data through APIs, tools and Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers
  • Design GenAIOps practices: evaluation of response quality and groundedness, tracing and observability, prompt and model versioning, and monitoring of token usage and cost
  • Plan AI cost and capacity, including model selection, provisioned versus pay-as-you-go deployments, and the impact of AI workloads on Fabric and Databricks compute
  • Consulting, pre-sales and delivery
  • Support pre-sales: lead technical discovery calls, shape solution approaches, build effort estimates and contribute to proposals and statements of work (SOWs), including scope, assumptions, deliverables and acceptance criteria
  • Fulfill the technical lead role on client engagements: own the technical approach and architecture standards, keep delivery aligned to scope and budget, serve as the primary technical contact for client teams, and raise risks and change requests early
  • Review implementation against approved designs, conduct readiness reviews, and provide production sign-off
  • Present architecture and recommendations to audiences from engineers to C-level executives, in writing and in person
  • Identify follow-on opportunities and contribute to account growth based on client needs
  • Develop solution accelerators and Datavail intellectual property (IP), such as reference architectures, reusable frameworks, deployment templates and packaged offerings, that speed up delivery and differentiate the practice
  • Stay ahead of innovation across Microsoft Fabric, Azure and the wider data and AI market: evaluate preview and newly released capabilities, build proofs of concept, and turn what works into practice guidance and client recommendations
  • Convert recurring patterns, decisions, and lessons learned into reusable Datavail intellectual property—including architecture blueprints, decision frameworks, assessment tools, checklists, templates, and accelerators—while protecting client confidentiality
  • Leadership and mentoring
  • Lead technical delivery teams of data engineers, analytics engineers and BI developers on client engagements
  • Mentor team members through design reviews, code reviews, pairing and certification guidance
    Contribute to hiring, interviewing and onboarding for the Data & Analytics practice

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Bachelor's degree in computer science, information systems, engineering or a related field, or equivalent professional experience
  • 10+ years of experience in data engineering, data warehousing or analytics, including 5+ years in a data or solution architect role
  • 3+ years designing and delivering data solutions on Azure, and hands-on delivery experience with Microsoft Fabric in production
  • End-to-end architecture ownership of at least two enterprise-scale data platform implementations
  • Expert-level dimensional modeling skills and working knowledge of Data Vault 2.0 and normalized modeling
  • Advanced SQL (T-SQL and Spark SQL) and working proficiency in Python/PySpark. Working knowledge of DAX and KQL
  • Practical experience implementing CI/CD, Git-based workflows and infrastructure as code for data platforms
  • Experience in a professional services, consulting or client-facing delivery environment, including pre-sales and estimation
  • Experience leading and mentoring technical teams
  • Strong written and verbal communication, with the ability to produce clear architecture documentation and lead client workshops
  • Ability to travel up to 25% to client sites
  • Authorization to work in the United States

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Microsoft Certified: Fabric Data Engineer Associate (DP-700)
  • Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect Expert (AZ-305)
  • Microsoft Certified: DevOps Engineer Expert (AZ-400)
  • Databricks Certified Data Engineer Professional
  • Delivered AI or machine learning solutions in production, including RAG or generative AI workloads on Azure
  • Experience designing ontologies or knowledge graphs, and hands-on work with Fabric IQ or Foundry IQ
  • Experience implementing AI governance or responsible AI programs, and GenAIOps evaluation and monitoring for production AI solutions
  • Experience with Azure Government (GCC, GCC High) or other government cloud environments, including FedRAMP and related compliance requirements
  • Experience architecting multi-tenant data platforms, including tenant isolation models (workspace-, capacity-, schema- or row-level), tenant onboarding automation and per-tenant security and cost allocation
  • Experience with transformation and data quality frameworks

  • Industry experience in healthcare, financial services, manufacturing, retail or the public sector

TECHNICAL ENVIRONMENT

  • Area Technologies and frameworks

Microsoft Fabric

  • OneLake, Lakehouse
  • Warehouse, Data Factory
  • Dataflows Gen2, Spark notebooks
  • Real-Time Intelligence
  • Mirroring
  • Shortcuts
  • Power BI, Direct Lake
  • Deployment pipelines

Azure data

  • ADLS Gen2
  • Azure Data Factory
  • Databricks, Unity Catalog
  • Azure Synapse Analytics
  • Azure SQL
  • Cosmos DB
  • Event Hubs
  • Stream Analytics

AI and ML

  • Azure Machine Learning
  • Fabric Data Science
  • Azure OpenAI
  • Azure AI Search
  • Copilot in Fabric
  • Microsoft Foundry
  • Foundry IQ, Azure AI Content Safety, Model Context Protocol (MCP)

Semantics and knowledge

  • Fabric IQ, ontology
  • Graph in Fabric
  • Fabric data agents
  • Knowledge graphs
  • Power BI semantic models

Security and governance

  • Microsoft Entra ID
  • Azure Key Vault
  • Private Link
  • Managed VNets
  • Microsoft Purview

DevOps

  • Azure DevOps (Repos, Pipelines, Boards)
  • GitHub and GitHub Actions
  • Fabric Git integration
  • Fabric-cicd
  • Databricks Asset Bundles
  • SQL database projects
  • Bicep, Terraform
  • GitHub Copilot

Languages

  • T-SQL
  • Spark SQL
  • Python
  • PySpark
  • DAX, KQL
  • PowerShell

Modeling

  • Kimball dimensional
  • Data Vault 2.0
  • 3NF
  • Medallion architecture; erwin
  • ER/Studio
  • SqlDBM

Frameworks

  • Azure Well-Architected Framework
  • Cloud Adoption Framework
  • DAMA-DMBOK
  • Data mesh
  • Agile (Scrum, Kanban)

raw.description:
Région : Bruxelles

La mission

Dans le cadre d’un projet informatique consacré à la gestion des parcours étudiants dans l’enseignement supérieur, vous assumez le rôle de chef de projet fonctionnel côté métier. Vous assurez l’interface entre les services métiers, les établissements d’enseignement supérieur et les équipes techniques. Votre mission consiste à traduire clairement les besoins et à veiller au suivi cohérent du projet.

Que vas-tu faire ?

  • Recueillir, examiner et préciser les besoins formulés par les services métiers et les établissements d’enseignement supérieur.
  • Déterminer les attentes fonctionnelles et organisationnelles avec les parties prenantes concernées.
  • Suivre l’avancement du projet et organiser la coordination entre les intervenants métier et les équipes techniques.
  • Transmettre un retour structuré aux collaborateurs et soutenir l’adoption des solutions déployées.

📝 Votre profil

  • Vous êtes titulaire d’un master.
  • Vous justifiez d’au moins 10 ans d’expérience en gestion de projets informatiques ou organisationnels.
  • Vous disposez d’au minimum 1 an d’expérience dans l’enseignement supérieur en Fédération Wallonie-Bruxelles, ou dans le cadre de projets liés aux parcours étudiants, notamment les inscriptions, les programmes d’études, la gestion des notes ou la mobilité internationale.
  • Vous connaissez parfaitement le fonctionnement académique et administratif des établissements, y compris les inscriptions et réinscriptions, les programmes, les unités d’enseignement, les crédits ECTS ainsi que les échanges de données avec E-Paysage.
  • Vous maîtrisez parfaitement le français.

raw.description:
As a Network Engineer, you will help strengthen and scale the infrastructure that underpins secure, reliable connectivity across critical systems. This role sits at the intersection of cloud networking, security, and infrastructure automation, with meaningful impact on the stability and performance of environments that support a growing fintech platform.

Responsibilities

  • Administer Palo Alto firewalls through PAN-OS and Panorama across environments.
  • Design and maintain AWS VPC networking, including routing, subnets, and network ACLs.
  • Manage networking infrastructure as code using Terraform and deployment pipelines.

Requirements

Requirements

  • 5+ years of network engineering experience
  • Strong hands-on experience with Palo Alto firewall administration, including PAN-OS and Panorama.
  • Solid understanding of AWS networking fundamentals, including VPC, subnets, NACLs, routing, and Transit/Hub VPC patterns.
  • Strong knowledge of Infrastructure as Code principles, with hands-on experience using Terraform to manage networking infrastructure.
  • Professional proficiency in English.
  • Based in LATAM.

Bonus Skills

  • Experience with VPN and IPSEC tunnel configuration across regions and remote sites.
  • Solid foundation in traditional networking (routing, switching — CCNA-level or equivalent).
  • Experience with Panorama lifecycle management (onboarding/offboarding firewalls, deployments, upgrades).
  • Familiarity with PAN-OS CVE remediation and firewall upgrade processes.
  • Familiarity with secrets and credential management tools (e.g., CyberArk for firewall and service account credentials).
  • Exposure to CI/CD pipelines and multi-environment deployments (test/stage/prod).
  • Experience working in hybrid environments (on-prem + AWS).

Benefits

  • Monthly salary of USD 6,000
  • A US$ 1,000 welcome package to get you started with the right gear
  • English conversation club & workshops
  • Health insurance
  • Psychotherapy sessions
  • Flexible payments in crypto, wire transfer, Wise, PayPal, or Payoneer
  • Unlimited reskilling in Udemy, Education IT & O'Reilly
  • Internet service
  • AI Tools & Learning Program
  • Co-working spaces
  • Paid time off

Our client is a Large and well known payment service provider holding the UK and EU licenses as well as strong and recognised brand name on the market.
The company supports all size businesses with card acquiring, payment processing, settlement, onboarding, and other merchant service solutions.

With the UK confirmed as a priority market, the business is strengthening local sales coverage and expanding its merchant base. This is a strong fit for sales professionals who know payments and want real ownership of a defined market.

💼 About the Role

As SeniorSales / Business Development Manager - UK, you will build new merchant relationships and sell acquiring services to low-mid risk verticals.
The role is focused on outbound pipeline generation, consultative sales, and closing new business with merchants, platforms, and e-commerce operators.
Company is looking for a young, ambitious and motivated mid-level Sales Executive to generate the strong portfolio of merchants across UK, doubling up the base salary with a very attractive commission structure offered by the company as a motivator to sell and perform.

🔍 Responsibilities

  • Build and manage a UK-focused outbound pipelineacross low-mid risk merchant verticals;

  • Sell acquiring and payment processingsolutions to e-commerce, and other sort of merchants;

  • Identify client's needsaround pricing, settlement, onboarding, risk, compliance, and payment methods;

  • Qualify prospects, run discovery calls, prepare proposals, and manage the full sales cycle;

  • Develop relationships with merchants, platforms, partners, and payment ecosystem contacts;

  • Track activity, opportunities, next steps, and forecasts accurately in the CRM;

  • Collaborate with onboarding, risk, compliance, and product teams to support deal execution;

  • Monitor UK market trends, visit local fintech and enterprise conferences making new connections and growing you value by holding bigger network of decison makers;

  • Each new attracted merchant will generate you a passive income for two years as commission on top of the base salary.

🎓 Requirements

  • 3+ years of B2B sales or business development experience;

  • Proven background in payments, acquiring, PSP, fintech, e-commerce, or merchant services;

  • Proven new business development experience in the UK market;

  • Good understanding of card acquiring,merchant onboarding, settlement, pricing, risk, and compliance basics;

  • Ability to generate outbound pipeline independently without heavy supervision;

  • Strong CRM discipline, reporting habits, and structured pipeline management;

  • Confident communication skills in English;

  • Existing network across small, medium and large enterprises and e-commerce..

Nice to Have

  • Knowledge of local UK payment methods and merchant buying behaviour;

  • Existing network of low-mid risk merchants;

  • Track record closing mid-market or enterprise merchant deals.

🤝 Key Competencies

  • Commercial ownershipand self-directed pipeline generation;

  • Consultative sellingand clear qualification discipline;

  • Ability to explain acquiring, pricing, onboarding, and settlement in simple business terms;

  • Strong follow-up habitsand resilience through longer sales cycles;

  • Market awareness across payments, fintech, and e-commerce.

✨ The Employer Offers

  • Remote or hybrid setup with strong market ownership;

  • Clear focus on the UK as a confirmed growth market;

  • Performance-based commission linked to new business results;

  • International payments exposure across acquiring, PSP, and merchant services;

  • Collaboration with experienced risk, compliance, onboarding, and product teams;

  • Flexible hours and independent working style;

  • Career path toward senior business development or market leadership;

  • Modern equipment and practical support for sales execution.

If you know the UK payments market and can turn your own pipeline into signed merchants, this role gives you the space to build meaningful revenue from day one.

raw.description:
Business Development Manager

Heb jij affiniteit met innovatieve optische- en meettechnologie en weet jij technische oplossingen te vertalen naar commerciële kansen? Krijg je daarnaast energie van het aanboren van nieuwe markten en het realiseren van groei? Dan zijn wij op zoek naar jou!

Als Business Development Manager ben je verantwoordelijk voor het stimuleren van de commerciële groei van onze Sensing Business in Europa. Je bent dé commerciële en interne gesprekspartner voor onze oplossingen op het gebied van licht-, display- en kleurmetingen. Je signaleert nieuwe marktkansen, ontwikkelt klantrelaties en helpt onze organisatie om onze positie binnen verschillende industrieën verder te versterken.

Je werkt nauw samen met onze salesteams, Marketing en de Europese Sensing-organisatie. Samen vertaal je ontwikkelingen in de markt en behoeften van klanten naar concrete commerciële mogelijkheden. Je opereert op Europees niveau, waarbij je regelmatig contact hebt met klanten en collega's in verschillende landen.

Wat ga je doen?

  • Ontwikkelen en realiseren van commerciële groeiplannen en omzetdoelstellingen voor de toegewezen markt en productportfolio's;

  • Actief identificeren van nieuwe marktkansen, potentiële klanten en strategische samenwerkingspartners.

  • Opbouwen, onderhouden en uitbreiden van relaties met bestaande klanten en partners binnen Europa.

  • Ontwikkelen van commerciële strategieën en proposities voor verschillende sectoren, waaronder automotive, manufacturing, food & agriculture, verlichting en displays, recycling, verf en kunststoffen.

  • Ondersteunen van de lokale salesteams bij het identificeren, kwalificeren en ontwikkelen van commerciële kansen.

  • Verzorgen en leiden van klantpresentaties, workshops, demonstraties en proof-of-concept trajecten.

  • Optreden als inhoudelijk en commercieel adviseur voor klanten gedurende het volledige verkooptraject.

  • Volgen van marktontwikkelingen, technologische innovaties en relevante wet- en regelgeving en deze vertalen naar commerciële kansen.

  • Opstellen en bewaken van commerciële plannen, forecasts en pipeline-ontwikkelingen en hierover rapporteren aan het management.

  • Nauw afstemmen met Europese collega's over nieuwe leads en commerciële trajecten, zodat kansen gezamenlijk en op de juiste manier worden opgepakt.

Wie ben jij?

Reports to: CTO

Department: Technology

Location: This is a fully remote U.S.-based position. Candidates must reside and work in one of the following states due to tax and compliance requirements: AR, AZ, CA, CO, FL, GA, ID, IL, LA, MD, MO, NC, NJ, NV, NY, OH, TX, VA, WA, WI, or WY.

FLSA Classification: Salaried, Exempt

Compensation: This position has geographic-based pay ranges. Final compensation and geographic tier placement are determined based on the candidate's primary work location, skills, experience, and qualifications.

Tier 1 (Higher Cost Markets): $190,000 - $220,000

Tier 2 (National Markets): $180,000 - $210,000

Tier 3 (Lower Cost Markets): $170,000 - $200,000

About the Company

Paleovalley and Wild Pastures were born from a simple but radical idea: real food can heal — people, animals, and the planet. When Paleovalley co-founders Autumn and Chas Smith saw how industrialized food was affecting human health and the health of the land, they refused to play along. Autumn’s own journey of healing through nutrient-dense foods lit a fire that became Paleovalley. From there, the mission grew roots, sprouted wings, and eventually expanded into Wild Pastures to bring regeneratively raised meats directly to families nationwide.

Today, Paleovalley crafts deeply nourishing snacks and supplements made with organic ingredients and honorable sourcing. Wild Pastures connects small American farmers practicing regenerative agriculture with customers who believe better food is worth fighting for. Every product, every partnership, and every decision is guided by a commitment to real ingredients, regenerative practices, and the belief that health is built from the soil up.

We’re a team of grounded doers, curious thinkers, bold builders, and warm humans who like to laugh while doing meaningful work. We're growing quickly, fueled by purpose and a shared desire to repair the food system one thoughtful choice at a time. If you feel energized by impact, drawn to mission, and ready to join a company rewriting the future of food, we’d love to meet you!

About the Opportunity

The technology behind Paleovalley and Wild Pastures is central to how customers shop, subscribe, and get help - and how our teams fulfill orders and run the business. Much of it was built in-house by our co-founder and CTO. As both brands grow, we need a technology organization that can keep these platforms strong, connect them with our business systems, and support the next stage of growth.

The Vice President of Technology will be the CTO’s trusted right hand and lead the full technology function across software engineering, business systems, and IT. This leader will set priorities and investment plans with the CTO, make consequential day-to-day decisions with substantial autonomy, and own the team, budget, delivery, and health of our technology. The role gives the CTO room to focus on company-wide direction and the technical work where he can add the most value.

Success here requires executive judgment, real technical depth, and a practical approach to AI and automation. You’ll work through architecture, code, and difficult incidents while building shared knowledge and ownership across the team. You’ll also guide AI adoption that improves how we build software and run the business, partnering with E-Commerce on reliable solutions for the shopping experience and commercial priorities.

What You’ll Do

Technology Strategy and Leadership

  • Set the technology strategy and multi-year roadmap with the CTO, turning business priorities into clear investments, sequencing, and delivery across both brands.
  • Lead engineering, business systems, and IT as one function, developing leaders, clarifying decision rights, and building the capacity needed for growth.
  • Own the technology budget, staffing, and vendor strategy; make sound build-versus-buy decisions and raise enterprise-level risks and architectural choices with the CTO.
  • Establish and oversee a centralized technology request intake and prioritization process, evaluating incoming requests, defining project scope, assessing business impact, allocating resources, and communicating realistic timelines to stakeholders across departments.
  • Develop scalable engineering workflows and project management practices that improve accountability, delivery predictability, and cross-functional communication without introducing unnecessary administrative complexity.

Custom Platforms and Engineering

  • Own the architecture and engineering delivery of our custom commerce, subscription, customer service, and internal platforms, balancing new capabilities with reliability and maintainability.
  • Stay close to the technical work through design and code reviews, hands-on troubleshooting, and selective coding when a critical problem calls for it.
  • Set practical standards for testing, releases, monitoring, and incident response so teams can move quickly while protecting the customer and employee experience.
  • Reduce dependence on any one person by documenting critical systems, sharing ownership, cross-training the team, and testing recovery procedures.

AI and Automation

  • Lead AI and automation strategy with the CTO, turning emerging capabilities into practical agents, workflows, and tools that improve efficiency, decision-making, and organizational capacity.
  • Evaluate where AI, conventional automation, and human expertise are best applied, measuring business value before scaling adoption across engineering and business functions.

Business Systems, IT and Security

  • Lead the strategy for business applications, integrations, and data flows that connect commerce with customer service, fulfillment, manufacturing, supply chain, and finance.
  • Oversee IT services, infrastructure, access, cybersecurity, privacy, and vendor risk, including practical standards for AI reliability, data protection, and appropriate human oversight.
  • Maintain continuity and disaster recovery plans for revenue-critical and operational systems, and prioritize technical debt based on security, scalability, cost, and business impact.

Delivery and Cross Functional Partnership

  • Partner with E-Commerce and web experience teams to translate storefront and testing priorities into technical solutions; E-Commerce owns commercial outcomes while Technology owns platform delivery.
  • Partner with business leaders to evaluate processes, automation opportunities, and capacity needs before recommending additional systems, vendors, or headcount.
  • Set realistic commitments, manage competing requests, and give the CTO and executive team a clear view of progress, service health, and emerging risks.
  • Serve as a responsive and solutions-oriented technology partner to department leaders, ensuring incoming requests are properly evaluated, stakeholders receive clear updates, and technical priorities remain aligned with business impact and available capacity.

What You’ll Need to Succeed

  • 8+ years of progressive experience in software engineering and technology leadership, including 4+ years leading technical teams and developing managers or other senior leaders.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field preferred; equivalent practical experience and demonstrated technical leadership will be considered in lieu of a degree.
  • Strong command of software architecture, production code, integrations, cloud infrastructure, and engineering practices.
  • Hands-on experience applying AI tools and automation in software development or business workflows, with sound judgment about their limitations, reliability, and data risks.
  • Experience leading customer-facing commerce or subscription platforms alongside enterprise applications and IT services.
  • A track record of making custom or founder-built systems maintainable, documented, and independently operable.
  • Practical judgment in security, privacy, access, incident response, disaster recovery, and business continuity.
  • Business acumen to manage budgets, vendors, technical investments, and competing priorities across functions.
  • Ability to earn a technical founder’s trust while leading independently and building a stronger technology organization.

Bonus Points

  • Experience working in a startup, founder-led business, or high-growth e-commerce environment.
  • Experience with custom-built e-commerce platforms, legacy application modernization, or migrations involving PHP/Laravel-based systems.
  • Familiarity with platforms such as Shopify and the technical considerations involved in building or integrating e-commerce functionality.
  • Experience with RESTful APIs, MySQL or comparable relational databases, AWS or similar cloud infrastructure, and modern web development practices.
  • Experience with ERP, warehouse management, fulfillment, or customer service platforms, including systems such as Acumatica, Logiwa, Klaviyo, or Gladly.
  • Familiarity with Agile, Scrum, or other structured project management practices; relevant certifications are a plus.
  • Interest in food, wellness, and regenerative agriculture.

Our Commitment to You

  • Medical, dental, and vision coverage with 100% employer-paid dental/vision and a small monthly medical premium for employees; dependents may be added at employee cost
  • Generous Paid time off to support balance and rest
  • Paid sick time for when you need it
  • Six (6) company-paid holidays each year & two (2) floating holidays
  • Paid parental leave after 6 months of service for eligible employees
  • 100% company-paid Short-Term Disability, Long-Term Disability, and Life Insurance
  • Referral bonuses up to $1,500 when you refer great people who join our team
  • 401(k) or Roth Plans with up to a 4% company match after one year of service
  • $300 Paleovalley Monthly product stipend for employees

Compliance & Employment Practices

Paleovalley and Wild Pastures are proud to be equal opportunity employers. We make employment decisions based on qualifications, merit, and business needs, and we do not discriminate based on any status protected by applicable federal, state, or local law. We’re also committed to providing reasonable accommodations throughout the hiring process. If you need assistance or an accommodation at any point, please reach out to .

All applicants must be authorized to work in the United States. At this time, Paleovalley and Wild Pastures are unable to sponsor or assume sponsorship of employment visas, including but not limited to H-1B, TN, or OPT. Any offer of employment is contingent upon completion of Form I-9 and verification of work authorization. We participate in E-Verify to confirm eligibility to work in the U.S.

To support an efficient and consistent application review process, we may use technology-assisted tools to help organize and review applications; however, these tools do not make hiring decisions. All final hiring decisions are made by our team.

This role is open until filled.

About the company

Paid per approved task, about $100/hr equivalent. One flat rate for every approved task.

Built to fit around a clinical practice:

  • Tasks estimated at about 10–20 hrs/week while the project is active; you choose when and how much to contribute
  • Contribute anytime, from anywhere
  • No patient contact, no malpractice exposure: you review written clinical cases
  • All reviewers are license-verified physicians
  • $50 one-time onboarding reward, paid once your first production task is approved

Mindrift connects specialists with project-based AI opportunities for leading tech companies, focused on testing, evaluating, and improving AI systems. Participation is project-based.

What this opportunity involves

We’re looking for actively practicing, US-licensed physicians (MD/DO) living outside the US, with an active, unrestricted US medical license, to evaluate clinical EHR vignettes for a medical AI evaluation project. General and internal medicine are the main focus. On this project, contributors may:

  • Evaluate clinical EHR vignettes paired with a question, a proposed answer, and a distractor “trap” answer across diagnosis and treatment tasks, spanning cardiovascular, nervous, hematologic, respiratory, digestive, urinary, reproductive, musculoskeletal, and integumentary systems;
  • Score the clinical reasoning quality of benchmark items: vignette accuracy and completeness, whether the vignette gives the answer away, answer correctness and gradeability, and trap quality;
  • Check whether the reasoning chain reaches the answer from vignette facts alone, correct reasoning traces, and write short rationales;
  • Work within three independent blind reads, followed by physician adjudication. Real clinical complexity only. You’re improving the AI tools you’ll eventually use yourself.

If you’re a practicing physician ready to take on this challenging and engaging project, apply to take part!

What we look for

This opportunity is a good fit for US-licensed physicians living outside the US who are looking for a flexible, time-limited project they can fit around clinical practice. Ideally, contributors will have:

  • Medical degree (MD or DO) and an active, unrestricted US medical license (verified at onboarding and re-checked monthly);
  • Board certification or completed residency training, with recent direct patient care (attending-level preferred);
  • Broad, multi-system diagnostic and treatment experience (internal, family, emergency, or hospital medicine);
  • Strong clinical reasoning: differential diagnosis, next-step management, and application of evidence-based guidelines;
  • Prior experience in medical AI evaluation, clinical content or exam-question review, or medical annotation/QA (a plus);
  • Strong written English (C1+).

This opportunity is not suitable for medical students, unlicensed medical graduates, non-physician clinicians (NPs, PAs, nurses, pharmacists), or non-clinical healthcare titles.

How it works

Apply → Pass qualification(s) → Join a project → Complete tasks → Get paid ​

How to apply

Please submit your CV in English and indicate your level of English proficiency.

Project time expectations

You decide when and how much to contribute. For this project, tasks are estimated at around 10–20 hours per week during active phases. This is an estimate, not a minimum or a guaranteed workload, and applies only while the project is active. Tasks are submitted within the project timeline and need to meet the listed acceptance criteria to be approved.

Earnings

Earnings are per approved task, at a flat rate set to about $100/hr equivalent based on estimated task time. There are no tiers or speed adjustments to the base rate. QA and adjudication tasks are paid at a higher rate.

  • $50 one-time onboarding reward, paid once your first production task is approved.
  • Incentives: additional earnings for high-quality approved tasks. Terms are shared in the project guidelines.

Applicants must reside in California

LEAP is seeking a Director of Clinical Case Management to provide agency-wide leadership and oversight of its case management, social work, and clinical services. This leader will be responsible for case management quality, staff leadership and clinical supervision, service delivery, regulatory compliance, and the continued development of a coordinated, person-centered clinical model for individuals with intellectual and developmental disabilities.

The Director will lead and develop LEAP’s social work team, supervise an Associate Director of Clinical Case Management if the position is established, establish clinical standards and practices, and ensure high-quality, consistent services across regions. Working closely with the CEO and other department leaders, the Director will use clinical expertise, data, and quality measures to strengthen services, address complex needs, and support LEAP’s continued growth.

What You'll Do

1. Case Management Leadership, Clinical Supervision & Team Development

  • Lead, supervise, coach, and develop LEAP's social work/clinical team, including supervision of an Associate Director of Clinical Case Management, if established, to support agency-wide clinical operations and day-to-day implementation.
  • Provide clinical supervision to assigned staff and partner with an external clinical consultant to ensure appropriate clinical supervision across the team, consistent with Board of Behavioral Sciences (BBS) requirements and professional standards.
  • Maintain an active presence in the field, observing staff practice, reviewing cases and plans, and coaching staff to strengthen clinical judgment and service quality.
  • Monitor caseloads, workload, staff capacity, and clinical practice across regions.
  • Lead case consultation and support social workers in complex cases, crises, and situations requiring higher-level clinical judgment.
  • Identify training and professional-development needs for staff and providers and build team capacity to deliver LEAP's clinical model consistently.

2. Case Management Implementation & Service Oversight

  • Oversee implementation of clinical programs, protocols, and service standards across regions.
  • Ensure clinical assessments, intake, care planning, case management, home visits, crisis planning, and service coordination are delivered consistently and appropriately in collaboration with the Residential Services department.
  • Ensure clinical services match each client’s assessed needs and are effectively integrated into their care plan.
  • Oversee clinical and therapeutic consultant services, ensuring appropriate referral, utilization, coordination, and quality.
  • Provide oversight of crisis response and agency-wide on-call program, ensuring that appropriate protocols, escalation channels, staff readiness, and follow-through processes are in place and effective.
  • Supervise and guide the Associate Director in coordinating agency-wide clinical operations and initiatives, specialist services, workflow, and day-to-day implementation of clinical standards and practices.
  • Collaborate with Residential Services, Operations, Quality & Compliance, home providers, and other partners to support coordinated service delivery.

3. Case Management Strategy & Program Development

  • Partner with the CEO to establish LEAP's case management strategy and clinical priorities aligned with client and provider needs, organizational goals, and growth.
  • Lead the ongoing development and refinement of LEAP's case management service model and related clinical supports, including clear program goals, KPIs, and quality and impact measures.
  • Develop and maintain case management and clinical program guides, protocols, standards, and practice expectations that translate the model into consistent service delivery.
  • Use evidence-based practices, regulatory requirements, organizational data, and client, provider, and staff experiences to strengthen case management and clinical practices.
  • Identify emerging clinical needs and opportunities for new or enhanced services, interventions, and partnerships.

4. Quality, Outcomes & Continuous Improvement

  • Establish meaningful clinical quality, service, and outcome measures aligned with LEAP's clinical model and organizational KPIs.
  • Oversee and monitor clinical documentation, service delivery, caseload trends, utilization, outcomes, incidents, and other quality and effectiveness indicators.
  • Use data, case reviews, compliance findings, client, provider, and staff experience and feedback to identify trends, risks, gaps, and opportunities for improvement.
  • Ensure clinical practices meet applicable regulatory, licensing, Regional Center, ethical, and organizational requirements.
  • Translate findings into improvements for clinical protocols, training, staffing, services, and program design.

5. Partnerships, Cross-Functional Leadership & Board Support

  • Partner with department leaders to address cross-functional needs affecting clinical services, clients, home providers, and staff.
  • Build and maintain relationships with Regional Centers, clinical providers, community organizations, and other strategic partners.
  • Represent LEAP's clinical model, priorities, and needs in appropriate external meetings and partnerships.

This isn't just a job; it's a launchpad for personal and professional growth.

About you

You have a solid understanding of accounting principles, a keen desire to learn and grow, and a strong attention to detail. When something doesn’t look right, you dig in and ask questions until you understand it. Your organization and adaptability let you handle a wide range of tasks and adjust to changing priorities. You take feedback well, work well in a team, and are passionate about using technology to improve efficiency.

Key responsibilities and impact

  • General Ledger & Bookkeeping: Record journal entries, maintain the general ledger, and reconcile bank, credit card, and balance sheet accounts each month.
  • Accounts Receivable & Revenue Support: Prepare customer invoices, apply payments, manage collections, and keep deferred revenue schedules up to date. Prepare RevOps reporting.
  • Accounts Payable & Expense Management: Process vendor invoices and payments, manage the company credit card workflow, review employee expenses for policy compliance, and maintain vendor records, including 1099 tracking.
  • Month-End & Year-End Close: Prepare accruals, prepaids, deferrals, and COGS entries. Complete account reconciliations and support monthly, quarterly, and annual financial statements.
  • Cash Management: Track daily cash activity and reconcile cash accounts
  • Salesforce & Systems: Maintain customer records, contracts, and commission data in Salesforce, and keep billing and accounting systems in sync.
  • Compliance: Prepare and file sales tax returns, monitor payroll tax filings, and maintain state filings and registrations.
  • Audit & Tax Support: Prepare schedules and supporting documents for the annual audit, tax returns, and external reporting.
  • Records & Organization: Process mail, organize files, and keep accounting records complete and audit-ready.

Qualifications

  • 2–4 years of accounting experience; SaaS or subscription business experience preferred
  • Working knowledge of GAAP, including accrual accounting and revenue recognition (ASC 606)
  • Experience with QuickBooks Online or a similar accounting system
  • Salesforce experience is a plus
  • Strong Excel skills and attention to detail
  • Organized, dependable, and comfortable owning recurring deadlines

Our culture

Candidates who complete it give us a much better sense of who they are, and it helps us confirm that every applicant is who they say they are. If you'd rather not, or can't, we'll review your application as submitted after the 10-day window.

Director of AI and Enterprise Architecture

Remote – Western US (Pacific or Mountain time zone preferred)

Why Us

NewRocket is a ServiceNow Elite Partner and a Claude Select partner, helping enterprises reimagine how work gets done with ServiceNow and AI. We work with public and private sector organizations, including some of the world’s biggest brands, to simplify processes, remove complexity, and turn the promise of AI into measurable business outcomes. We are “Raising the Bar” in delivering technology’s promise to create new kinds of experiences for our customers.

Our Core Values: Excellence, Creativity, Integrity, Teamwork and Empathy #ExCITE. At NewRocket, these values guide everything we do: they are the foundation of our culture and define how we Go Beyond for our clients.

The Role

About the role

We're hiring a Director of AI and Enterprise Architecture to be the technical leader on our client engagements, working alongside our forward deployed engineers as they build and deploy agentic AI inside complex enterprise environments. This is a billable, client-facing consulting role.

Large enterprises don't run on one system. They run on decades of layered platforms: ERP backbones like SAP and Oracle, service and workflow platforms like ServiceNow, CRM, HR and finance suites, custom integrations, data warehouses, and the identity and security controls that hold it all together. Agentic AI only creates value when it can work safely inside that landscape: reading the right data, taking the right actions, respecting approvals and access controls, and leaving an audit trail that satisfies IT, security and compliance.

On each engagement, you're the person who understands that landscape. You map the client's systems, translate their business goals into the architecture and requirements agents need, and lead the forward deployed engineers through it as they build, so workflows make it out of pilot and into the client's production environment.

What you'll do

  • Lead engagements technically. Serve as the senior technical leader on client engagements, setting architecture direction and guiding the forward deployed engineers who are building alongside you.
  • Map the client's system landscape. Quickly get to grips with each client's environment, including ServiceNow, SAP, Oracle, Salesforce, Workday, custom systems and the integrations between them, and turn it into a clear picture the engineering team can build against.
  • Translate business processes into agent-ready requirements. Work with client process owners to break down workflows like incident resolution, procure-to-pay, order-to-cash and employee onboarding into the tasks, data, decisions, permissions and human approval points an agent must handle.
  • Design how agents connect to systems of record. Define the integration approach for each engagement: APIs, integration platforms, event streams, MCP and tool-calling layers, and data access patterns.
  • Get workflows into production. Navigate the client's environments, change management, release processes, testing, monitoring and support handoff so agentic workflows move from pilot to production.
  • Clear the path with security and governance. Design identity and access models for agents (service accounts, least privilege, delegated authority), audit logging and controls, and win sign-off from client CISOs, risk teams and auditors.
  • Advise senior client stakeholders. Act as a trusted architecture advisor to client CIOs, CTOs, enterprise architects and platform owners, and identify where agentic workflows can expand into new use cases.
  • Strengthen the practice. Turn what you learn on engagements into reusable blueprints, integration playbooks and readiness assessments, and share field insight with our product and engineering teams.

What you bring

  • 7 to 10 years of experience in enterprise architecture, solution architecture or technical leadership roles within large, complex enterprise software environments.
  • Deep hands-on knowledge of at least two major enterprise platforms, such as ServiceNow, SAP (S/4HANA, BTP), Oracle (Fusion, E-Business Suite, OCI), Salesforce or Workday, including their data models, APIs, extension frameworks and upgrade constraints.
  • Strong grounding in enterprise integration: REST and SOAP APIs, middleware and iPaaS (MuleSoft, Boomi, SAP Integration Suite or similar), event-driven architecture, and master data management.
  • Practical experience with AI or automation in production, such as LLM-based applications, agentic workflows, RPA or intelligent automation, and a clear point of view on where agents fit and where they don't.
  • Proven track record moving enterprise systems from design to production, including environment management, SDLC and change control, testing, monitoring and operational support.
  • Solid understanding of enterprise security and governance: identity and access management, SSO and OAuth, role-based access, audit, and regulatory requirements such as SOX, GDPR or HIPAA.
  • Client-facing consulting experience, such as at a Big Four firm (Deloitte, PwC, EY, KPMG), Accenture or another global systems integrator or enterprise software vendor's professional services team, including working in a billable delivery model and advising executive stakeholders in plain business terms.
  • Experience serving as technical lead for engineering teams on delivery engagements, guiding engineers who are building while staying hands-on enough to unblock them.
  • Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, information systems or a related field, or equivalent experience.

Location and travel

  • You must live in the Western United States, in the Mountain or Pacific time zone.
  • You must be willing to travel up to 75% to client sites.

Nice to have

  • Enterprise architecture frameworks such as TOGAF, or platform certifications (ServiceNow Certified Technical Architect, SAP or Oracle architect certifications).
  • Familiarity with agent frameworks and protocols, including Model Context Protocol (MCP), tool use and function calling, retrieval-augmented generation and agent evaluation methods.
  • Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP) and modern data platforms (Snowflake, Databricks).
  • Experience working alongside forward deployed engineering teams, or in a similar embedded delivery model.
  • Experience in regulated industries such as financial services, healthcare, public sector or manufacturing.
  • Public thought leadership: talks, writing or published reference architectures on enterprise AI.

What success looks like

This is a billable, client-facing consulting role. You'll be embedded on customer engagements alongside our forward deployed engineers, serving as the architecture lead who helps the team navigate complex enterprise system landscapes.

  1. Engagement delivery: You consistently meet billable utilization targets and are the go-to architect on our most complex client engagements.
  2. Landscape mastery for the team: On each engagement, you quickly map the client's system landscape (ServiceNow, SAP, Oracle and the integrations between them) and give forward deployed engineers a clear path through it: where the data lives, which APIs and controls apply, and who owns what.
  3. Production outcomes: Agentic workflows you architect reach the client's production environment, with sign-off from their IT, security and risk teams.
  4. Client trust: Clients see you as a senior advisor, leading to engagement extensions, expanded scope and referenceable outcomes.
  5. Repeatable delivery: Patterns, integration playbooks and readiness assessments from your engagements are reused across the practice, making each new deployment faster.

We Take Care of Our People

 NewRocket is committed to a diverse and inclusive workplace. We value and celebrate diversity, believing that every employee matters and should be respected and heard.  We are proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and affirmative action employer, committed to providing employment opportunity regardless of sex, race, creed, color, gender, religion, marital status, domestic partner status, age, national origin, or ancestry, physical or mental disability, medical condition, sexual orientation, pregnancy, citizenship, military, or Veteran status. For individuals with disabilities who would like to request an accommodation, please contact .

Join the mission to make the digital world safer.

About Team Cymru

Team Cymru is the leader in Internet Threat Intelligence. Our unique and global insight empowers an amazing team of analysts to develop industry leading intelligence that is critical to the success of our customers’ cyber security efforts.

Team Cymru is an ardent supporter of the Threat Intelligence community. We enable industry collaboration by hosting exclusive conferences each year. Our team members actively participate in working groups, attend industry events, and work directly with fellow community peers.

We’re looking for a Threat Intelligence Advisor based in the United Kingdom to support customers and prospects across EMEA. This is a customer-facing role spanning pre-sales and post-sales. You’ll partner with Sales to lead discovery, build the business case, and run Proof of Value (PoV) engagements with new prospects, then stay engaged after the sale to help customers operationalize Team Cymru’s intelligence and realize measurable value.

You’ll act as the trusted technical advisor to threat intelligence and security leadership teams, translating their risks and priorities into solutions built on Team Cymru’s products and showing how those solutions help them detect, mitigate, and prevent threats. Deep Cyber Threat Intelligence and threat hunting expertise is essential because it earns credibility with practitioners, but success in this role is measured by customer outcomes, technical wins, and adoption rather than analytical output.

Each member of the Threat Intelligence Advising team is empowered to help us achieve our goals. We are dedicated, respectful, and have the highest standards of ethics and integrity. We take ownership and strive to win a positive outcome, in a fun, positive, and collaborative environment that optimizes our development and growth.

Key Responsibilities:

Discovery and Risk Based Prioritization

  • Lead opportunity discovery sessions to understand customers’ threat intelligence maturity, challenges, and goals
  • Perform risk-based assessments to identify and prioritize threats aligned to operational and strategic objectives
  • Collaborate with security teams to ensure a deep understanding of their immediate and long-term needs

Business Case Development

  • Assist in quantifying the business impact of customer threats, aligning those to cross functional metrics
  • Develop ROI-driven narratives and frameworks to support investment in Team Cymru’s threat intelligence solutions
  • Help present clear and compelling business cases to technical and non-technical stakeholders

Solution Design and Presentation

  • Design simple, scalable, tailored solutions that solve customer pain and align to their priorities and objectives
  • Facilitate cross-functional collaboration within the customer’s organization and ensure alignment across stakeholders
  • Deliver engaging presentations and demos tailored to diverse audiences, from technical teams to senior leadership

Value Realization

  • Drive successful Proof of Value (PoV) engagements, ensuring alignment with customers’ desired business goals
  • Track progress toward achieving PoV goals, providing insights and recommendations for continuous improvement
  • Support customers in operationalizing solutions and ensuring intelligence is both relevant and useable

Continuous Improvement

  • Provide guidance on how market trends, challenges, and opportunities can help shape Team Cymru’s solutions
  • Gather and analyze feedback from customers to identify opportunities for product enhancements and innovation
  • Collaborate with Product and Engineering teams to incorporate customer insights into future releases and updates

Qualifications & Experience

  • 3-5+ years working with cybersecurity stakeholders, such as Detection Engineers, SOC Analysts, Threat Intelligence Specialists, or Security Architects, specifically in relation to Cyber Threat Intelligence
  • 3+ years of experience in a pre-sales, solutions engineering, or customer-facing threat intelligence role, leading engagements with large enterprise organizations across the UK and EMEA
  • Experience leveraging various frameworks, risk-based prioritization, and proactive threat hunting
  • Demonstrated knowledge of industry trends, emerging threats, and best practices for leveraging threat intelligence
  • Skilled at optimizing sales qualification and engagement through frameworks such as MEDDICC and Challenger
  • Proficiency in TCP/IP, HTTP, SMTP, DNS, and BGP protocols, network topology, and packet analysis is essential
  • The ability to analyze network flow data for threat detection
  • Hands-on experience using threat intelligence platforms, SIEMs, and SOARs
  • In-depth technical experience leveraging and integrating with SIEMs, TIPs, and custom detection pipelines

Additional Skills

  • Exceptional discovery, communication, and presentation skills
  • Strong customer engagement and relationship-building skills
  • Excellent presentation and writing skills, including the development of visual aids and diagrams
  • Ability to communicate technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences, at all levels
  • Metrics-driven, risk-based approach to problem-solving and decision-making
  • Ability to take ownership and adapt processes to effectively drive to the desired business outcomes
  • Collaborative mindset with a focus on achieving customer outcomes and continuous improvement
  • Experience with NetFlow, sFlow, JFlow, or IPFIX is strongly desired
  • Strong scripting or automation skills in Python, PowerShell, or similar is a plus

Education and Certifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Security, a related field, or equivalent experience
  • CISSP, GCTI, GCIA, or similar cybersecurity certifications (preferred)

Why Join Team Cymru?

At Team Cymru, we provide unmatched global threat intelligence that empowers organizations to proactively disrupt adversaries. As a Threat Intelligence Advisor, you will work directly with security teams across EMEA, helping them harness the full power of our threat intelligence to achieve critical business and security outcomes.

We offer a collaborative, mission-driven culture where your expertise and impact will directly contribute to improving global security.

Ready to make an impact? Apply now and join a team protecting millions worldwide.

This job description is not exhaustive. Responsibilities may evolve as needed. Team Cymru is an equal opportunity employer and welcomes applicants from all backgrounds.

raw.description:
About Rippling

Rippling gives businesses one place to run HR, IT, and Finance. It brings together all of the workforce systems that are normally scattered across a company, like payroll, expenses, benefits, and computers. For the first time ever, you can manage and automate every part of the employee lifecycle in a single system.

Take onboarding, for example. With Rippling, you can hire a new employee anywhere in the world and set up their payroll, corporate card, computer, benefits, and even third-party apps like Slack and Microsoft 365—all within 90 seconds.

Based in San Francisco, CA, Rippling has raised $1.4B+ from the world’s top investors—including Kleiner Perkins, Founders Fund, Sequoia, Greenoaks, and Bedrock—and was named one of America's best startup employers by Forbes.

We prioritize candidate safety. Please be aware that all official communication will only be sent from @Rippling.com addresses.

About the role

As a Technical Account Consultant at Rippling, you’ll be the primary expert for our customers’ finance and payroll operations. This is a highly hands-on, client-facing role where you’ll spend a significant portion of your day on calls, deeply engaging with customers to understand their unique business needs. You’ll provide expert guidance on Rippling’s payroll, time and attendance, time off, and other financial products, helping clients navigate complex scenarios and optimize their workflows.

Your work will be centered on building strong, trusted relationships with customer administrators, acting as their advocate and providing personalized, proactive support. You will be a vital resource, not just for your customers, but for your internal team as well. If you thrive on direct customer interaction and want to be at the forefront of financial technology, this role is for you.

What you will do

  • Provide Hands-On Customer Support: Engage in 3-4 hours of direct customer calls daily to provide in-depth technical assistance and strategic guidance on Rippling’s payroll and financial products.
  • Deepen Product Expertise: Become a go-to resource on all things payroll, time and attendance, time off, and accounting integrations, solving complex, interdependent problems.
  • Drive Adoption: Partner with clients to increase their use of key features, consult on best practices, and help them seamlessly integrate Rippling into their business operations.
  • Ensure Customer Success: Act as a project manager for your engagements, guiding customers to ensure they feel supported and confident with our platform.
  • Act as an Advocate: Thoughtfully advocate for customer needs by working closely with internal product and engineering teams to influence our product roadmap.

What you will need

  • 3+ years of SaaS experience in a customer-facing role like account management, consulting, or technical support.
  • Experience in the payroll or HR technology industry, with a background in managing or implementing payroll, time and attendance, or other financial systems.
  • Strong communication skills: The ability to explain complex technical and financial scenarios in simple, clear, and concise written or verbal communication.
  • Ruthless prioritization and exceptional time management skills; you’re a master at juggling multiple tasks without dropping the ball.
  • Passion for helping customers and colleagues succeed.
  • Strong attention to detail and a knack for solving intricate problems.
  • Confidence with hands-on technical support in a fast-paced environment.

Additional Information

Rippling is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workforce and do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, ancestry, physical disability, mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, age, sexual orientation, veteran or military status, or any other legally protected characteristics, Rippling is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities who need assistance during the hiring process. To request a reasonable accommodation, please email

Rippling highly values having employees working in-office to foster a collaborative work environment and company culture. For office-based employees (employees who live within a defined radius of a Rippling office), Rippling considers working in the office, at least three days a week under current policy, to be an essential function of the employee's role.

This role will receive a competitive salary + variable + benefits + equity. The salary for US-based employees will be aligned with one of the ranges below based on location; see which tier applies to your location here. If you do not see your location listed, you can ask your recruiter.

A variety of factors are considered when determining someone’s compensation–including a candidate’s professional background, experience, and location. Final offer amounts may vary from the amounts listed.

Please note: We are not currently able to consider or hire any candidates located in the greater San Francisco Bay Area or New York City Metropolitan Area.

raw.description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

  • Datavail is hiring a Senior Data Architect to lead the design and delivery of modern data platforms for our clients
  • You will own the architecture of client engagements from discovery through production, with a primary focus on Microsoft Fabric and the Azure data ecosystem
  • You will define target-state architectures, build the data models that underpin them, and establish the SDLC and DevOps practices that let client teams operate and extend what we deliver
  • This is a client-facing role
  • You will work directly with business stakeholders, client IT and security teams, and Datavail delivery teams of data engineers, analytics engineers and BI developers, often across several engagements at once

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Architecture and solution design
  • Lead discovery and current-state assessments of client data estates, including sources, integrations, platforms, data quality, security posture and operating model
  • Define target-state and transition architectures for analytics, data warehousing, Lakehouse, real-time and operational data workloads
  • Produce architecture deliverables: solution architecture documents, logical and physical architecture diagrams, architecture decision records (ADRs), non-functional requirements and capacity plans
  • Evaluate platform and build-versus-buy trade-offs across Fabric, Databricks, Azure Synapse Analytics and Azure SQL, and present recommendations with cost, risk and effort clearly stated
  • Apply the Azure Well-Architected Framework (reliability, security, cost optimization, operational excellence, performance efficiency) and the Cloud Adoption Framework's cloud-scale analytics guidance to every design
  • Design for scale and multi-domain ownership, including data mesh and hub-and-spoke patterns where they fit the client's organization
  • Plan and lead migrations from on-premises SQL Server, SSIS, SSAS and legacy data warehouses, and from Azure Synapse dedicated SQL pools, to Fabric and Azure
  • Lead architecture and design reviews, maintain reference architectures and standards, manage exceptions, and track technical debt
    Microsoft Fabric and Azure platform
  • Architect end-to-end Fabric solutions across OneLake, Lakehouse, Warehouse, Data Factory pipelines, Dataflows Gen2, Spark notebooks, Real-Time Intelligence (Eventstream, Eventhouse, KQL) and Power BI
  • Design OneLake strategy: workspace and domain structure, shortcuts to ADLS Gen2 and external storage, database mirroring, and medallion (bronze/silver/gold) layering on Delta Lake
  • Size and govern Fabric capacities (F SKUs), including workload isolation, capacity monitoring, throttling behavior and cost management
  • Forecast consumption, set budgets and tagging/showback standards, monitor unit economics, and optimize cloud/Fabric spend
  • Design Power BI semantic models for performance and scale, including Direct Lake, Import and DirectQuery storage modes, composite models, incremental refresh, and row-level and object-level security
  • Integrate Fabric with the wider Azure estate: ADLS Gen2, Azure Data Factory, Databricks and Unity Catalog, Azure SQL Database and Managed Instance, Cosmos DB, Event Hubs, Azure Functions and Azure Machine Learning
  • Design network and identity controls: Microsoft Entra ID, managed identities and service principals, Azure Key Vault, private endpoints and Private Link, managed virtual networks and workspace-level access
  • Data modeling
  • Own conceptual, logical and physical data models for client solutions, from business glossary through to deployed schemas
  • Apply the right modeling approach for each layer: Kimball dimensional modeling (star schemas, conformed dimensions, bus matrix, slowly changing dimensions Types 1, 2 and 6), Data Vault 2.0 (hubs, links, satellites) for integration layers, and normalized 3NF models for operational and master data
  • Design canonical and enterprise data models, master and reference data structures, and entity resolution approaches
  • Define naming standards, data type conventions, key strategies (surrogate, natural, hash), and partitioning and file layout for Delta tables
  • Maintain models in a modeling tool (erwin Data Modeler, ER/Studio, SqlDBM or equivalent) and keep them in version control alongside code
  • SDLC and DevOps
  • Establish the delivery lifecycle for data workloads: environment strategy (dev, test, prod), branching and pull request standards, code review, release management and rollback
  • Implement Fabric Git integration with Azure DevOps or GitHub, Fabric deployment pipelines, and automated deployment using the Fabric REST APIs and the fabric-cicd library
  • Build CI/CD pipelines in Azure DevOps Pipelines and GitHub Actions for Fabric items, Azure Data Factory, Databricks (Asset Bundles), SQL database projects (DACPAC/sqlpackage) and Power BI (PBIP/TMDL)
  • Define infrastructure as code with Bicep and Terraform for Azure resources, identities and networking
  • Embed automated testing: unit tests for transformations, data quality and contract tests, schema-drift detection, and regression testing of semantic models
  • Define DataOps practices for observability, alerting, lineage, pipeline SLAs and incident response, and hand them over with runbooks
  • Define support models, SLAs/SLOs, escalation paths, training, documentation, and handoff criteria
  • Work within Agile delivery (Scrum or Kanban) using Azure Boards or Jira, including backlog refinement, estimation and sprint planning
  • Set standards for AI-assisted development with GitHub Copilot and AI coding agents across design, code, testing and documentation, including review and quality guardrails
  • Data governance and security
  • Design governance frameworks aligned to DAMA-DMBOK, covering data ownership and stewardship, metadata, data quality, lifecycle and retention
  • Implement Microsoft Purview for data catalog, lineage, classification and sensitivity labels across Fabric and Azure sources
  • Design least-privilege security models using Fabric workspace roles, item permissions, OneLake security, and row-, column- and object-level security
  • Ensure solutions meet client regulatory obligations such as HIPAA, SOC 2, PCI DSS, GDPR and CCPA, working with client compliance and security teams
  • Establish responsible AI and AI governance aligned to the NIST AI Risk Management Framework, the EU AI Act and Microsoft's Responsible AI Standard, including approved model use, data access policies for AI, and human oversight
  • Design security controls for AI workloads, covering prompt injection, data exfiltration through agents, content filtering with Azure AI Content Safety, and Microsoft Purview data security for AI
  • AI and machine learning enablement
  • Design data foundations that support AI and machine learning: curated feature data, data quality controls and governed access for model training and inference
  • Architect solutions that use Azure Machine Learning, Fabric Data Science and Azure OpenAI, including retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) over enterprise data with Azure AI Search
  • Prepare client data estates and semantic models for Copilot in Fabric and Power BI
  • Design Fabric IQ solutions, including ontologies that define business entities, relationships, rules and data bindings to lakehouses, eventhouses and Power BI semantic models, and Fabric data agents for conversational Q&A over ontology-grounded data
    Model knowledge graphs for multi-hop reasoning over connected enterprise data, using Graph in Fabric and other graph technologies where appropriate
  • Architect agentic solutions with Microsoft Foundry and Foundry IQ, using knowledge sources and knowledge bases that ground agents in both unstructured content and structured Fabric data
  • Define where AI agents and models sit in the overall platform, including when to use Fabric, Foundry or Databricks, and how agents access governed data through APIs, tools and Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers
  • Design GenAIOps practices: evaluation of response quality and groundedness, tracing and observability, prompt and model versioning, and monitoring of token usage and cost
  • Plan AI cost and capacity, including model selection, provisioned versus pay-as-you-go deployments, and the impact of AI workloads on Fabric and Databricks compute
  • Consulting, pre-sales and delivery
  • Support pre-sales: lead technical discovery calls, shape solution approaches, build effort estimates and contribute to proposals and statements of work (SOWs), including scope, assumptions, deliverables and acceptance criteria
  • Fulfill the technical lead role on client engagements: own the technical approach and architecture standards, keep delivery aligned to scope and budget, serve as the primary technical contact for client teams, and raise risks and change requests early
  • Review implementation against approved designs, conduct readiness reviews, and provide production sign-off
  • Present architecture and recommendations to audiences from engineers to C-level executives, in writing and in person
  • Identify follow-on opportunities and contribute to account growth based on client needs
  • Develop solution accelerators and Datavail intellectual property (IP), such as reference architectures, reusable frameworks, deployment templates and packaged offerings, that speed up delivery and differentiate the practice
  • Stay ahead of innovation across Microsoft Fabric, Azure and the wider data and AI market: evaluate preview and newly released capabilities, build proofs of concept, and turn what works into practice guidance and client recommendations
  • Convert recurring patterns, decisions, and lessons learned into reusable Datavail intellectual property—including architecture blueprints, decision frameworks, assessment tools, checklists, templates, and accelerators—while protecting client confidentiality
  • Leadership and mentoring
  • Lead technical delivery teams of data engineers, analytics engineers and BI developers on client engagements
  • Mentor team members through design reviews, code reviews, pairing and certification guidance
    Contribute to hiring, interviewing and onboarding for the Data & Analytics practice

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Bachelor's degree in computer science, information systems, engineering or a related field, or equivalent professional experience
  • 10+ years of experience in data engineering, data warehousing or analytics, including 5+ years in a data or solution architect role
  • 3+ years designing and delivering data solutions on Azure, and hands-on delivery experience with Microsoft Fabric in production
  • End-to-end architecture ownership of at least two enterprise-scale data platform implementations
