Business Development Manager

Heb jij affiniteit met innovatieve optische- en meettechnologie en weet jij technische oplossingen te vertalen naar commerciële kansen? Krijg je daarnaast energie van het aanboren van nieuwe markten en het realiseren van groei? Dan zijn wij op zoek naar jou!

Als Business Development Manager ben je verantwoordelijk voor het stimuleren van de commerciële groei van onze Sensing Business in Europa. Je bent dé commerciële en interne gesprekspartner voor onze oplossingen op het gebied van licht-, display- en kleurmetingen. Je signaleert nieuwe marktkansen, ontwikkelt klantrelaties en helpt onze organisatie om onze positie binnen verschillende industrieën verder te versterken.

Je werkt nauw samen met onze salesteams, Marketing en de Europese Sensing-organisatie. Samen vertaal je ontwikkelingen in de markt en behoeften van klanten naar concrete commerciële mogelijkheden. Je opereert op Europees niveau, waarbij je regelmatig contact hebt met klanten en collega's in verschillende landen.

Wat ga je doen?

  • Ontwikkelen en realiseren van commerciële groeiplannen en omzetdoelstellingen voor de toegewezen markt en productportfolio's;

  • Actief identificeren van nieuwe marktkansen, potentiële klanten en strategische samenwerkingspartners.

  • Opbouwen, onderhouden en uitbreiden van relaties met bestaande klanten en partners binnen Europa.

  • Ontwikkelen van commerciële strategieën en proposities voor verschillende sectoren, waaronder automotive, manufacturing, food & agriculture, verlichting en displays, recycling, verf en kunststoffen.

  • Ondersteunen van de lokale salesteams bij het identificeren, kwalificeren en ontwikkelen van commerciële kansen.

  • Verzorgen en leiden van klantpresentaties, workshops, demonstraties en proof-of-concept trajecten.

  • Optreden als inhoudelijk en commercieel adviseur voor klanten gedurende het volledige verkooptraject.

  • Volgen van marktontwikkelingen, technologische innovaties en relevante wet- en regelgeving en deze vertalen naar commerciële kansen.

  • Opstellen en bewaken van commerciële plannen, forecasts en pipeline-ontwikkelingen en hierover rapporteren aan het management.

  • Nauw afstemmen met Europese collega's over nieuwe leads en commerciële trajecten, zodat kansen gezamenlijk en op de juiste manier worden opgepakt.

Wie ben jij?

  • Je hebt minimaal een afgeronde HBO-opleiding, bij voorkeur in een technische richting zoals Engineering, Natuurkunde of Scheikunde. Een bedrijfskundige opleiding in combinatie met sterke technische affiniteit is ook passend.

  • Je hebt minimaal 5 jaar ervaring in een commerciële functie binnen een technische B2B-omgeving, bijvoorbeeld in business development of technische sales.

  • Je hebt ervaring met industriële meettechnologie en bij voorkeur kennis van kleurmeting, spectrofotometrie, colorimetrie en licht- en displaymetingen.

  • Je hebt ervaring met het ontwikkelen van nieuwe markten en het uitbouwen van strategische klantrelaties.

  • Je bent in staat om technische producteigenschappen te vertalen naar concrete klantbehoeften en commerciële oplossingen.

  • Je hebt een ondernemende instelling, ziet kansen en neemt initiatief om deze te benutten.

  • Je bent analytisch sterk en hebt ervaring met het opstellen van commerciële plannen, forecast en businesscases.

  • Je bent communicatief vaardig en weet zowel technische specialisten als commerciële en managementstakeholders te overtuigen.

  • Je beheerst de Engelse taal, zowel mondeling als schriftelijk. Beheersing van een andere Europese taal is een pré.

  • Je bent gewend om internationaal en met verschillende afdelingen en culturen samen te werken.

  • Je vindt het geen probleem om regelmatig te reizen binnen Europa.

Wat bieden we?

Een uitdagende, internationale functie binnen een innovatieve en groeiende business unit van een beursgenoteerde organisatie, waarin je volop ruimte krijgt om commerciële kansen te ontwikkelen en daadwerkelijk impact te maken.

Daarnaast bieden wij:

  • Een aantrekkelijk salaris en een compleet pakket aan (secundaire) arbeidsvoorwaarden, waaronder een prestatiegerichte bonusregeling.

  • Een zelfstandige en strategische rol met veel internationale contacten en verantwoordelijkheid.

  • De mogelijkheid om mee te bouwen aan de verdere Europese groei van onze Sensing Business Unit.

  • Een innovatieve werkomgeving met toegang tot hoogwaardige meettechnologie en een breed portfolio aan oplossingen.

  • Ruimte voor persoonlijke ontwikkeling, trainingen en opleidingen.

  • Een collegiale werkomgeving waarin samenwerking, kennisdeling en ondernemerschap centraal staan.

Wie zijn wij?

Konica Minolta is een internationaal bedrijf dat innovatieve oplossingen aan organisaties en de samenleving biedt. Het hoofdkantoor is gevestigd in Tokyo. Konica Minolta heeft haar groepsmaatschappijen in 50 landen met meer dan 35.000 werknemers. De organisatie biedt producten en diensten in 150 landen over de hele wereld.

Onze Mensen en Innovaties houden ons in beweging om onze business te versterken, continu ons motto 'Rethink and shape the future' toe te passen en de manier waarop mensen zakendoen en technologie inzetten te veranderen.

Iedere dag bij Konica Minolta is een kans om jouw Ideeën te delen, Verandering te stimuleren en samen te werken met collega's met verschillende achtergronden en ervaringen.

Together, we rethink today in order to shape the Future!

Reports to: CTO

Department: Technology

Location: This is a fully remote U.S.-based position. Candidates must reside and work in one of the following states due to tax and compliance requirements: AR, AZ, CA, CO, FL, GA, ID, IL, LA, MD, MO, NC, NJ, NV, NY, OH, TX, VA, WA, WI, or WY.

FLSA Classification: Salaried, Exempt

Compensation: This position has geographic-based pay ranges. Final compensation and geographic tier placement are determined based on the candidate's primary work location, skills, experience, and qualifications.

Tier 1 (Higher Cost Markets): $190,000 - $220,000

Tier 2 (National Markets): $180,000 - $210,000

Tier 3 (Lower Cost Markets): $170,000 - $200,000

About the Company

Paleovalley and Wild Pastures were born from a simple but radical idea: real food can heal — people, animals, and the planet. When Paleovalley co-founders Autumn and Chas Smith saw how industrialized food was affecting human health and the health of the land, they refused to play along. Autumn’s own journey of healing through nutrient-dense foods lit a fire that became Paleovalley. From there, the mission grew roots, sprouted wings, and eventually expanded into Wild Pastures to bring regeneratively raised meats directly to families nationwide.

Today, Paleovalley crafts deeply nourishing snacks and supplements made with organic ingredients and honorable sourcing. Wild Pastures connects small American farmers practicing regenerative agriculture with customers who believe better food is worth fighting for. Every product, every partnership, and every decision is guided by a commitment to real ingredients, regenerative practices, and the belief that health is built from the soil up.

We’re a team of grounded doers, curious thinkers, bold builders, and warm humans who like to laugh while doing meaningful work. We're growing quickly, fueled by purpose and a shared desire to repair the food system one thoughtful choice at a time. If you feel energized by impact, drawn to mission, and ready to join a company rewriting the future of food, we’d love to meet you!

About the Opportunity

The technology behind Paleovalley and Wild Pastures is central to how customers shop, subscribe, and get help - and how our teams fulfill orders and run the business. Much of it was built in-house by our co-founder and CTO. As both brands grow, we need a technology organization that can keep these platforms strong, connect them with our business systems, and support the next stage of growth.

The Vice President of Technology will be the CTO’s trusted right hand and lead the full technology function across software engineering, business systems, and IT. This leader will set priorities and investment plans with the CTO, make consequential day-to-day decisions with substantial autonomy, and own the team, budget, delivery, and health of our technology. The role gives the CTO room to focus on company-wide direction and the technical work where he can add the most value.

Success here requires executive judgment, real technical depth, and a practical approach to AI and automation. You’ll work through architecture, code, and difficult incidents while building shared knowledge and ownership across the team. You’ll also guide AI adoption that improves how we build software and run the business, partnering with E-Commerce on reliable solutions for the shopping experience and commercial priorities.

What You’ll Do

Technology Strategy and Leadership

  • Set the technology strategy and multi-year roadmap with the CTO, turning business priorities into clear investments, sequencing, and delivery across both brands.
  • Lead engineering, business systems, and IT as one function, developing leaders, clarifying decision rights, and building the capacity needed for growth.
  • Own the technology budget, staffing, and vendor strategy; make sound build-versus-buy decisions and raise enterprise-level risks and architectural choices with the CTO.
  • Establish and oversee a centralized technology request intake and prioritization process, evaluating incoming requests, defining project scope, assessing business impact, allocating resources, and communicating realistic timelines to stakeholders across departments.
  • Develop scalable engineering workflows and project management practices that improve accountability, delivery predictability, and cross-functional communication without introducing unnecessary administrative complexity.

Custom Platforms and Engineering

  • Own the architecture and engineering delivery of our custom commerce, subscription, customer service, and internal platforms, balancing new capabilities with reliability and maintainability.
  • Stay close to the technical work through design and code reviews, hands-on troubleshooting, and selective coding when a critical problem calls for it.
  • Set practical standards for testing, releases, monitoring, and incident response so teams can move quickly while protecting the customer and employee experience.
  • Reduce dependence on any one person by documenting critical systems, sharing ownership, cross-training the team, and testing recovery procedures.

AI and Automation

  • Lead AI and automation strategy with the CTO, turning emerging capabilities into practical agents, workflows, and tools that improve efficiency, decision-making, and organizational capacity.
  • Evaluate where AI, conventional automation, and human expertise are best applied, measuring business value before scaling adoption across engineering and business functions.

Business Systems, IT and Security

  • Lead the strategy for business applications, integrations, and data flows that connect commerce with customer service, fulfillment, manufacturing, supply chain, and finance.
  • Oversee IT services, infrastructure, access, cybersecurity, privacy, and vendor risk, including practical standards for AI reliability, data protection, and appropriate human oversight.

About the company

Paid per approved task, about $100/hr equivalent. One flat rate for every approved task.

Built to fit around a clinical practice:

  • Tasks estimated at about 10–20 hrs/week while the project is active; you choose when and how much to contribute
  • Contribute anytime, from anywhere
  • No patient contact, no malpractice exposure: you review written clinical cases
  • All reviewers are license-verified physicians
  • $50 one-time onboarding reward, paid once your first production task is approved

Mindrift connects specialists with project-based AI opportunities for leading tech companies, focused on testing, evaluating, and improving AI systems. Participation is project-based.

What this opportunity involves

We’re looking for actively practicing, US-licensed physicians (MD/DO) living outside the US, with an active, unrestricted US medical license, to evaluate clinical EHR vignettes for a medical AI evaluation project. General and internal medicine are the main focus. On this project, contributors may:

  • Evaluate clinical EHR vignettes paired with a question, a proposed answer, and a distractor “trap” answer across diagnosis and treatment tasks, spanning cardiovascular, nervous, hematologic, respiratory, digestive, urinary, reproductive, musculoskeletal, and integumentary systems;
  • Score the clinical reasoning quality of benchmark items: vignette accuracy and completeness, whether the vignette gives the answer away, answer correctness and gradeability, and trap quality;
  • Check whether the reasoning chain reaches the answer from vignette facts alone, correct reasoning traces, and write short rationales;
  • Work within three independent blind reads, followed by physician adjudication. Real clinical complexity only. You’re improving the AI tools you’ll eventually use yourself.

If you’re a practicing physician ready to take on this challenging and engaging project, apply to take part!

What we look for

This opportunity is a good fit for US-licensed physicians living outside the US who are looking for a flexible, time-limited project they can fit around clinical practice. Ideally, contributors will have:

  • Medical degree (MD or DO) and an active, unrestricted US medical license (verified at onboarding and re-checked monthly);
  • Board certification or completed residency training, with recent direct patient care (attending-level preferred);
  • Broad, multi-system diagnostic and treatment experience (internal, family, emergency, or hospital medicine);
  • Strong clinical reasoning: differential diagnosis, next-step management, and application of evidence-based guidelines;
  • Prior experience in medical AI evaluation, clinical content or exam-question review, or medical annotation/QA (a plus);
  • Strong written English (C1+).

This opportunity is not suitable for medical students, unlicensed medical graduates, non-physician clinicians (NPs, PAs, nurses, pharmacists), or non-clinical healthcare titles.

How it works

Apply → Pass qualification(s) → Join a project → Complete tasks → Get paid ​

How to apply

Please submit your CV in English and indicate your level of English proficiency.

Project time expectations

You decide when and how much to contribute. For this project, tasks are estimated at around 10–20 hours per week during active phases. This is an estimate, not a minimum or a guaranteed workload, and applies only while the project is active. Tasks are submitted within the project timeline and need to meet the listed acceptance criteria to be approved.

Earnings

Earnings are per approved task, at a flat rate set to about $100/hr equivalent based on estimated task time. There are no tiers or speed adjustments to the base rate. QA and adjudication tasks are paid at a higher rate.

  • $50 one-time onboarding reward, paid once your first production task is approved.
  • Incentives: additional earnings for high-quality approved tasks. Terms are shared in the project guidelines.

Applicants must reside in California

LEAP is seeking a Director of Clinical Case Management to provide agency-wide leadership and oversight of its case management, social work, and clinical services. This leader will be responsible for case management quality, staff leadership and clinical supervision, service delivery, regulatory compliance, and the continued development of a coordinated, person-centered clinical model for individuals with intellectual and developmental disabilities.

The Director will lead and develop LEAP’s social work team, supervise an Associate Director of Clinical Case Management if the position is established, establish clinical standards and practices, and ensure high-quality, consistent services across regions. Working closely with the CEO and other department leaders, the Director will use clinical expertise, data, and quality measures to strengthen services, address complex needs, and support LEAP’s continued growth.

What You'll Do

1. Case Management Leadership, Clinical Supervision & Team Development

  • Lead, supervise, coach, and develop LEAP's social work/clinical team, including supervision of an Associate Director of Clinical Case Management, if established, to support agency-wide clinical operations and day-to-day implementation.
  • Provide clinical supervision to assigned staff and partner with an external clinical consultant to ensure appropriate clinical supervision across the team, consistent with Board of Behavioral Sciences (BBS) requirements and professional standards.
  • Maintain an active presence in the field, observing staff practice, reviewing cases and plans, and coaching staff to strengthen clinical judgment and service quality.
  • Monitor caseloads, workload, staff capacity, and clinical practice across regions.
  • Lead case consultation and support social workers in complex cases, crises, and situations requiring higher-level clinical judgment.
  • Identify training and professional-development needs for staff and providers and build team capacity to deliver LEAP's clinical model consistently.

2. Case Management Implementation & Service Oversight

  • Oversee implementation of clinical programs, protocols, and service standards across regions.
  • Ensure clinical assessments, intake, care planning, case management, home visits, crisis planning, and service coordination are delivered consistently and appropriately in collaboration with the Residential Services department.
  • Ensure clinical services match each client’s assessed needs and are effectively integrated into their care plan.
  • Oversee clinical and therapeutic consultant services, ensuring appropriate referral, utilization, coordination, and quality.
  • Provide oversight of crisis response and agency-wide on-call program, ensuring that appropriate protocols, escalation channels, staff readiness, and follow-through processes are in place and effective.
  • Supervise and guide the Associate Director in coordinating agency-wide clinical operations and initiatives, specialist services, workflow, and day-to-day implementation of clinical standards and practices.
  • Collaborate with Residential Services, Operations, Quality & Compliance, home providers, and other partners to support coordinated service delivery.

3. Case Management Strategy & Program Development

  • Partner with the CEO to establish LEAP's case management strategy and clinical priorities aligned with client and provider needs, organizational goals, and growth.
  • Lead the ongoing development and refinement of LEAP's case management service model and related clinical supports, including clear program goals, KPIs, and quality and impact measures.
  • Develop and maintain case management and clinical program guides, protocols, standards, and practice expectations that translate the model into consistent service delivery.
  • Use evidence-based practices, regulatory requirements, organizational data, and client, provider, and staff experiences to strengthen case management and clinical practices.
  • Identify emerging clinical needs and opportunities for new or enhanced services, interventions, and partnerships.

4. Quality, Outcomes & Continuous Improvement

  • Establish meaningful clinical quality, service, and outcome measures aligned with LEAP's clinical model and organizational KPIs.
  • Oversee and monitor clinical documentation, service delivery, caseload trends, utilization, outcomes, incidents, and other quality and effectiveness indicators.
  • Use data, case reviews, compliance findings, client, provider, and staff experience and feedback to identify trends, risks, gaps, and opportunities for improvement.
  • Ensure clinical practices meet applicable regulatory, licensing, Regional Center, ethical, and organizational requirements.
  • Translate findings into improvements for clinical protocols, training, staffing, services, and program design.

5. Partnerships, Cross-Functional Leadership & Board Support

  • Partner with department leaders to address cross-functional needs affecting clinical services, clients, home providers, and staff.
  • Build and maintain relationships with Regional Centers, clinical providers, community organizations, and other strategic partners.
  • Represent LEAP's clinical model, priorities, and needs in appropriate external meetings and partnerships.
  • Provide the CEO and Board with clinical trends, outcomes, risks, and program updates as requested.
  • Contribute clinical expertise to organizational planning, growth, and agencywide policy development.

Who We're Looking For

Required Qualifications

Education:

  • Master's degree in Social Work (MSW) from an accredited institution.
  • Current California LCSW license in good standing.
  • Meets applicable California BBS requirements to provide clinical supervision to associate clinicians.

Experience:

  • 10-15 years of significant progressive experience in social work, behavioral health, clinical services, or related human-services settings, including experience supervising and developing professional staff.
  • Demonstrated experience overseeing clinical programs, case management/service coordination, quality, and complex cases.
  • Experience serving individuals with intellectual and developmental disabilities and/or individuals with complex behavioral health needs strongly preferred.
  • Knowledge of California's developmental disabilities service system, Regional Centers, the Lanterman Act, applicable Title 17/Title 22 requirements, and related regulatory requirements strongly preferred.
  • Strong analytical skills and demonstrated ability to use clinical and operational data to assess quality, identify trends, and improve services.
  • Strong leadership, communication, judgment, collaboration, and change-management skills.

Compensation & Benefits

Employment Status: Full-time, exempt.

Salary: $155,000–$185,000 annually, commensurate with qualifications and experience.

LEAP of California offers a competitive benefits package. We will discuss specific benefits and eligibility during the recruitment process.

Equal Opportunity Employer

LEAP of California is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a diverse team that reflects the communities we serve. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, creed, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity/expression, marital status, national origin, ancestry, ethnicity, disability, genetic predisposition, age, citizenship status, military status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

We strongly encourage applications from:

  • Individuals with disabilities and family members of individuals with disabilities
  • People of color and members of underrepresented communities
  • Those with lived experience in disability services, social work, or community advocacy

Director of AI and Enterprise Architecture

Remote – Western US (Pacific or Mountain time zone preferred)

Why Us

NewRocket is a ServiceNow Elite Partner and a Claude Select partner, helping enterprises reimagine how work gets done with ServiceNow and AI. We work with public and private sector organizations, including some of the world’s biggest brands, to simplify processes, remove complexity, and turn the promise of AI into measurable business outcomes. We are “Raising the Bar” in delivering technology’s promise to create new kinds of experiences for our customers.

Our Core Values: Excellence, Creativity, Integrity, Teamwork and Empathy #ExCITE. At NewRocket, these values guide everything we do: they are the foundation of our culture and define how we Go Beyond for our clients.

The Role

About the role

We're hiring a Director of AI and Enterprise Architecture to be the technical leader on our client engagements, working alongside our forward deployed engineers as they build and deploy agentic AI inside complex enterprise environments. This is a billable, client-facing consulting role.

Large enterprises don't run on one system. They run on decades of layered platforms: ERP backbones like SAP and Oracle, service and workflow platforms like ServiceNow, CRM, HR and finance suites, custom integrations, data warehouses, and the identity and security controls that hold it all together. Agentic AI only creates value when it can work safely inside that landscape: reading the right data, taking the right actions, respecting approvals and access controls, and leaving an audit trail that satisfies IT, security and compliance.

On each engagement, you're the person who understands that landscape. You map the client's systems, translate their business goals into the architecture and requirements agents need, and lead the forward deployed engineers through it as they build, so workflows make it out of pilot and into the client's production environment.

What you'll do

  • Lead engagements technically. Serve as the senior technical leader on client engagements, setting architecture direction and guiding the forward deployed engineers who are building alongside you.
  • Map the client's system landscape. Quickly get to grips with each client's environment, including ServiceNow, SAP, Oracle, Salesforce, Workday, custom systems and the integrations between them, and turn it into a clear picture the engineering team can build against.
  • Translate business processes into agent-ready requirements. Work with client process owners to break down workflows like incident resolution, procure-to-pay, order-to-cash and employee onboarding into the tasks, data, decisions, permissions and human approval points an agent must handle.
  • Design how agents connect to systems of record. Define the integration approach for each engagement: APIs, integration platforms, event streams, MCP and tool-calling layers, and data access patterns.
  • Get workflows into production. Navigate the client's environments, change management, release processes, testing, monitoring and support handoff so agentic workflows move from pilot to production.
  • Clear the path with security and governance. Design identity and access models for agents (service accounts, least privilege, delegated authority), audit logging and controls, and win sign-off from client CISOs, risk teams and auditors.
  • Advise senior client stakeholders. Act as a trusted architecture advisor to client CIOs, CTOs, enterprise architects and platform owners, and identify where agentic workflows can expand into new use cases.
  • Strengthen the practice. Turn what you learn on engagements into reusable blueprints, integration playbooks and readiness assessments, and share field insight with our product and engineering teams.

What you bring

  • 7 to 10 years of experience in enterprise architecture, solution architecture or technical leadership roles within large, complex enterprise software environments.
  • Deep hands-on knowledge of at least two major enterprise platforms, such as ServiceNow, SAP (S/4HANA, BTP), Oracle (Fusion, E-Business Suite, OCI), Salesforce or Workday, including their data models, APIs, extension frameworks and upgrade constraints.
  • Strong grounding in enterprise integration: REST and SOAP APIs, middleware and iPaaS (MuleSoft, Boomi, SAP Integration Suite or similar), event-driven architecture, and master data management.
  • Practical experience with AI or automation in production, such as LLM-based applications, agentic workflows, RPA or intelligent automation, and a clear point of view on where agents fit and where they don't.
  • Proven track record moving enterprise systems from design to production, including environment management, SDLC and change control, testing, monitoring and operational support.
  • Solid understanding of enterprise security and governance: identity and access management, SSO and OAuth, role-based access, audit, and regulatory requirements such as SOX, GDPR or HIPAA.
  • Client-facing consulting experience, such as at a Big Four firm (Deloitte, PwC, EY, KPMG), Accenture or another global systems integrator or enterprise software vendor's professional services team, including working in a billable delivery model and advising executive stakeholders in plain business terms.
  • Experience serving as technical lead for engineering teams on delivery engagements, guiding engineers who are building while staying hands-on enough to unblock them.
  • Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, information systems or a related field, or equivalent experience.

Location and travel

  • You must live in the Western United States, in the Mountain or Pacific time zone.
  • You must be willing to travel up to 75% to client sites.

Nice to have

  • Enterprise architecture frameworks such as TOGAF, or platform certifications (ServiceNow Certified Technical Architect, SAP or Oracle architect certifications).
  • Familiarity with agent frameworks and protocols, including Model Context Protocol (MCP), tool use and function calling, retrieval-augmented generation and agent evaluation methods.
  • Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP) and modern data platforms (Snowflake, Databricks).
  • Experience working alongside forward deployed engineering teams, or in a similar embedded delivery model.
  • Experience in regulated industries such as financial services, healthcare, public sector or manufacturing.
  • Public thought leadership: talks, writing or published reference architectures on enterprise AI.

What success looks like

This is a billable, client-facing consulting role. You'll be embedded on customer engagements alongside our forward deployed engineers, serving as the architecture lead who helps the team navigate complex enterprise system landscapes.

  1. Engagement delivery: You consistently meet billable utilization targets and are the go-to architect on our most complex client engagements.
  2. Landscape mastery for the team: On each engagement, you quickly map the client's system landscape (ServiceNow, SAP, Oracle and the integrations between them) and give forward deployed engineers a clear path through it: where the data lives, which APIs and controls apply, and who owns what.
  3. Production outcomes: Agentic workflows you architect reach the client's production environment, with sign-off from their IT, security and risk teams.
  4. Client trust: Clients see you as a senior advisor, leading to engagement extensions, expanded scope and referenceable outcomes.
  5. Repeatable delivery: Patterns, integration playbooks and readiness assessments from your engagements are reused across the practice, making each new deployment faster.

We Take Care of Our People

About Team Cymru

Team Cymru is the leader in Internet Threat Intelligence. Our unique and global insight empowers an amazing team of analysts to develop industry leading intelligence that is critical to the success of our customers’ cyber security efforts.

Team Cymru is an ardent supporter of the Threat Intelligence community. We enable industry collaboration by hosting exclusive conferences each year. Our team members actively participate in working groups, attend industry events, and work directly with fellow community peers.

We’re looking for a Threat Intelligence Advisor based in the United Kingdom to support customers and prospects across EMEA. This is a customer-facing role spanning pre-sales and post-sales. You’ll partner with Sales to lead discovery, build the business case, and run Proof of Value (PoV) engagements with new prospects, then stay engaged after the sale to help customers operationalize Team Cymru’s intelligence and realize measurable value.

You’ll act as the trusted technical advisor to threat intelligence and security leadership teams, translating their risks and priorities into solutions built on Team Cymru’s products and showing how those solutions help them detect, mitigate, and prevent threats. Deep Cyber Threat Intelligence and threat hunting expertise is essential because it earns credibility with practitioners, but success in this role is measured by customer outcomes, technical wins, and adoption rather than analytical output.

Each member of the Threat Intelligence Advising team is empowered to help us achieve our goals. We are dedicated, respectful, and have the highest standards of ethics and integrity. We take ownership and strive to win a positive outcome, in a fun, positive, and collaborative environment that optimizes our development and growth.

Key Responsibilities:

Discovery and Risk Based Prioritization

  • Lead opportunity discovery sessions to understand customers’ threat intelligence maturity, challenges, and goals
  • Perform risk-based assessments to identify and prioritize threats aligned to operational and strategic objectives
  • Collaborate with security teams to ensure a deep understanding of their immediate and long-term needs

Business Case Development

  • Assist in quantifying the business impact of customer threats, aligning those to cross functional metrics
  • Develop ROI-driven narratives and frameworks to support investment in Team Cymru’s threat intelligence solutions
  • Help present clear and compelling business cases to technical and non-technical stakeholders

Solution Design and Presentation

  • Design simple, scalable, tailored solutions that solve customer pain and align to their priorities and objectives
  • Facilitate cross-functional collaboration within the customer’s organization and ensure alignment across stakeholders
  • Deliver engaging presentations and demos tailored to diverse audiences, from technical teams to senior leadership

Value Realization

  • Drive successful Proof of Value (PoV) engagements, ensuring alignment with customers’ desired business goals
  • Track progress toward achieving PoV goals, providing insights and recommendations for continuous improvement
  • Support customers in operationalizing solutions and ensuring intelligence is both relevant and useable

Continuous Improvement

  • Provide guidance on how market trends, challenges, and opportunities can help shape Team Cymru’s solutions
  • Gather and analyze feedback from customers to identify opportunities for product enhancements and innovation
  • Collaborate with Product and Engineering teams to incorporate customer insights into future releases and updates

Qualifications & Experience

  • 3-5+ years working with cybersecurity stakeholders, such as Detection Engineers, SOC Analysts, Threat Intelligence Specialists, or Security Architects, specifically in relation to Cyber Threat Intelligence
  • 3+ years of experience in a pre-sales, solutions engineering, or customer-facing threat intelligence role, leading engagements with large enterprise organizations across the UK and EMEA
  • Experience leveraging various frameworks, risk-based prioritization, and proactive threat hunting
  • Demonstrated knowledge of industry trends, emerging threats, and best practices for leveraging threat intelligence
  • Skilled at optimizing sales qualification and engagement through frameworks such as MEDDICC and Challenger
  • Proficiency in TCP/IP, HTTP, SMTP, DNS, and BGP protocols, network topology, and packet analysis is essential
  • The ability to analyze network flow data for threat detection
  • Hands-on experience using threat intelligence platforms, SIEMs, and SOARs
  • In-depth technical experience leveraging and integrating with SIEMs, TIPs, and custom detection pipelines

Additional Skills

  • Exceptional discovery, communication, and presentation skills
  • Strong customer engagement and relationship-building skills
  • Excellent presentation and writing skills, including the development of visual aids and diagrams
  • Ability to communicate technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences, at all levels
  • Metrics-driven, risk-based approach to problem-solving and decision-making
  • Ability to take ownership and adapt processes to effectively drive to the desired business outcomes
  • Collaborative mindset with a focus on achieving customer outcomes and continuous improvement
  • Experience with NetFlow, sFlow, JFlow, or IPFIX is strongly desired
  • Strong scripting or automation skills in Python, PowerShell, or similar is a plus

Education and Certifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Security, a related field, or equivalent experience
  • CISSP, GCTI, GCIA, or similar cybersecurity certifications (preferred)

Why Join Team Cymru?

At Team Cymru, we provide unmatched global threat intelligence that empowers organizations to proactively disrupt adversaries. As a Threat Intelligence Advisor, you will work directly with security teams across EMEA, helping them harness the full power of our threat intelligence to achieve critical business and security outcomes.

We offer a collaborative, mission-driven culture where your expertise and impact will directly contribute to improving global security.

Ready to make an impact? Apply now and join a team protecting millions worldwide.

This job description is not exhaustive. Responsibilities may evolve as needed. Team Cymru is an equal opportunity employer and welcomes applicants from all backgrounds.

Role Summary
The Senior WebLogic Middleware Administrator is responsible for the administration, configuration, maintenance, security remediation, compliance management, automation, troubleshooting, and operational support of enterprise Oracle WebLogic platforms and supporting infrastructure. The role focuses on maintaining highly available, secure, and compliant environments while using automation to improve operational efficiency, reduce manual effort, and ensure consistency across middleware services.


Key Responsibilities

  • Administer and support Oracle WebLogic Server environments, including domain, Admin Server, Managed Server, cluster, and Node Manager configuration.
  • Support Oracle HTTP Server and Apache, plus Tomcat and IIS as needed.
  • Perform security remediation, vulnerability management, Oracle Critical Patch Update (CPU) patching, upgrades, and compliance validation.
  • Manage SSL/TLS certificates, keystores, truststores, LDAP, Kerberos, Active Directory integration, SSO, and WebLogic security realms and authentication providers.
  • Administer Linux, Solaris, and Windows servers supporting middleware environments.
  • Design, develop, and maintain automation for WebLogic administration, patching, compliance validation, and operational support using Shell, Python, and WLST (Jython) scripting.
  • Automate deployments, domain and configuration updates, certificate management, reporting, and system health checks.
  • Support CI/CD deployment processes and enterprise automation tools where applicable.
  • Perform performance monitoring, JVM tuning, data source and connection pool tuning, thread and heap dump analysis, troubleshooting, and root cause analysis.
  • Execute change management, incident management, and service restoration activities.
  • Maintain documentation, procedures, audit evidence, and compliance records.

You will be successful in this role if you have:

Required Qualifications

  • BA/BS degree and 6-8 years of relevant experience, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • 6+ years of middleware administration experience, with a primary focus on enterprise WebLogic environments.
  • Experience in security remediation, vulnerability management, and audit compliance.
  • Demonstrated experience developing automation solutions that improve operational efficiency and reduce manual effort.
  • US Citizenship required and ability to obtain a government security clearance.

Required Technical Skills

  • Oracle WebLogic Server, Oracle HTTP Server, Apache, Tomcat, IIS
  • WLST (Jython), Shell, Python, XML, HTML, Awk, Sed, Curl
  • Linux (RHEL, SUSE), Solaris, AIX, and Windows Server administration
  • SSL/TLS, LDAP, Active Directory, Kerberos, SSO, security hardening
  • REST API integration (including WebLogic REST management), task scheduling, and operational scripting
  • Oracle database (JDBC, data sources, GridLink/multi data source configuration)
  • JVM tuning, monitoring, and performance analysis

Preferred Qualifications

  • Oracle Fusion Middleware, Coherence, or SOA Suite exposure
  • Kafka, Zookeeper, Artifactory, WordPress, ServiceNow, or Remedy administration
  • Ansible, Jenkins, Git, GitLab CI/CD, or similar tools

Working together in an interdisciplinary environment, we study the interactions between human populations and the natural and physical environments in project-specific contexts. This includes a wide range of industrial, government and Indigenous clients.   • Knowledge of and experience meeting Canadian impact assessment requirements (federal, provincial)

  • Experience in planning, managing and undertaking engagement with diverse communities and stakeholder groups

  • Product & Domain Expertise: Serve as the SME for sampling applications and LOS offerings. Maintain deep knowledge of product functionality, workflows, integrations, data, compliance requirements, and operational dependencies. Act as an escalation point for product-related questions, issues, and decision support.

raw.description:
Paradise Media is a privately owned media company with a global portfolio of sports and iGaming brands.

This role can be based in Malta (hybrid) or remote within Europe.

About the role

We’re hiring an experienced SEO Performance Manager to lead the performance of a group of sites.

You’ll choose priorities and take ideas from investigation through implementation and results, with data, developer and content support behind you. There are no clients or accounts, so decisions stay close to the work and good ideas can move quickly.

The role can be fully remote with good overlap with European working hours, or hybrid from our Balluta Bay office in Malta, right on the water, with panoramic sea views and a full-size private gym.

What you’ll do

  • Lead SEO performance across assigned sites, from strategy and prioritisation through implementation and follow-up.
  • Choose priorities based on the size of the opportunity, likely impact, effort and risk.
  • Lead keyword strategy, site architecture, internal linking and on-page optimisation.
  • Investigate problems involving crawling, indexing, templates, architecture and internal linking.
  • Improve existing pages and decide where new pages, sections or launches are worth the effort.
  • Turn ideas into tests, involve the right developers and content specialists, and remain close to the work until it is live and measured.
  • Monitor rankings, traffic, conversion and revenue, investigate unexpected changes and adjust the plan when results move in the wrong direction.
  • Use AI to improve research, analysis, implementation and quality checks while remaining responsible for the final decision and output.
  • Share useful methods and give feedback to more junior SEOs as the role develops.

What we’re looking for

  • At least three years of hands-on SEO, ideally in iGaming, affiliate or another competitive search market.
  • Examples of choosing between competing SEO opportunities when time or resources were limited.
  • Experience diagnosing a meaningful traffic or ranking problem and identifying the underlying cause.
  • At least one test or improvement that you took from an initial idea through implementation and measurement.
  • A clear understanding of how rankings, traffic, conversion and revenue relate to one another.
  • A solid technical SEO foundation, including crawling, indexing, architecture, internal linking and on-page optimisation.
  • Confident using Google Search Console, analytics, crawling and backlink tools to investigate performance and make decisions. We care about what you can determine with the tools, not which brand you have used.
  • Experience working directly with developers on technical changes.
  • Comfortable using AI in practical SEO work, or able to learn new technical tools quickly.
  • Based in Malta on a hybrid schedule, or fully remote with good overlap with European working hours.
  • Fluent Italian language required.

Useful, but not essential

  • Experience with WordPress, large websites or site migrations.
  • Experience improving conversion as well as rankings and traffic.
  • Experience guiding junior colleagues or working with external specialists.
  • Basic HTML, CSS, SQL or scripting skills.

What success looks like after six months

You have a clear plan for your sites, have shipped several meaningful improvements and have shown that you can choose priorities, learn from results and change course when the evidence requires it.

Why join Paradise Media

  • Have room to test ideas, with data, developer and content support available to get useful work live.
  • Work with experienced SEOs who compare approaches and share what they learn.
  • Stay close to implementation and see the relationship between your decisions and the results.
  • Help improve how the SEO team uses AI in day-to-day work.
  • Receive a competitive salary and 27 days of paid annual leave, plus public holidays.
  • Work fully remote or from our Malta office. The office has a full-size gym, personal trainers, Secretlab gaming chairs, 49-inch monitors, fresh fruit and vegetables, and the sea outside the window.

How to apply

If you want room to make decisions, test ideas and stay close to the results, we would like to hear from you. When you apply, tell us about one SEO decision or test you personally took from idea through implementation and measurement.

Get to know us better

CodiLime is a software and network engineering industry expert and the first-choice service partner for top global networking hardware providers, software providers and telecoms. We create proofs-of-concept, help our clients build new products, nurture existing ones and provide services in production environments. Our clients include both tech startups and big players in various industries and geographic locations (US, Japan, Israel, Europe).

While no longer a startup - we have 250+ people on board and have been operating since 2011 we’ve kept our people-oriented culture. Our values are simple:

  • Act to deliver.

  • Disrupt to grow.

  • Team up to win.

The project and the team

We are a Developer team creating a network orchestration framework. This framework models, automates, and manages the full life cycle, including deployment, of Data Center networking and services on any environment.

By collaborating with us, you'll engage with a globally recognized hi-tech company and have a significant impact on their modern, flagship solution.

Our Engineers are involved in the whole product life cycle: design, PoC, demo, and deployment.

We work on multiple interesting projects at the same time, so it may happen that we’ll invite you to the interview for another project if we see that your competencies and profile are well-suited for it.

Your role

The following are some of the responsibilities you will have as a member of the team:

  • Leading design, architecture, and optimization for networking infrastructure&devices in Large scale DCs and/or Offices

  • Overseeing entire site deployment cycles from initial requirements to operational handover

  • Collaborating with cross-functional IT, security, and facility teams plus external vendors

  • Enforcing and maintaining robust technical documentation and architectural standards

  • Developing Python and/or Ansible scripts to drive network automation initiatives

Do we have a match?

You must meet all of the following criteria in order to be a Network Engineer with Data Center Network Automation:

  • Excellent knowledge of networks (routing, switching) at least at Professional level, preferably proven by adequate certifications such as CCNP/CCIE or comparable

  • Excellent knowledge of large-scale Data Center and/or Offices networking, proven by at least 7 years of relevant hands-on work experience in this domain

  • Deep understanding of BGP protocol:

    • IPv4/IPv6/VPNs (L3VPN, L2VPN, EVPN VXLAN-based)

    • VPNs handling advanced route-target policies

    • Knowledge of large network designs and ability to debug&troubleshoot scenarios including all of the above

  • Practical proficiency with at least two of the following: Cisco, Arista, Juniper, Aruba, Cumulus Linux platforms or other leading vendor

  • Deep understanding of Layer 2 networks (STP/RSTP/MSTP)

  • Expertise in Network Access Control and authentication protocols like 802.1X, RADIUS, and TACACS+

  • Communication skills, proficiency in English (min. B2 level), ability to collaborate on technical solutions

Beyond the criteria above, we would appreciate the nice-to-haves:

  • Hands-on experience with advanced network automation using tools like Ansible or Python

  • Knowledge of Linux & Bash

  • Experience with IaC (for example: Terraform)

  • Knowledge of AWS

The Customer Success Manager (CSM) owns a defined portfolio of client accounts, with a primary focus on retention and product adoption. The CSM works closely with the Customer Success Director and cross-functional teams to identify risk, support renewal outcomes and ensure clients realize measurable value from FoodChain ID solutions across their account lifecycle.

Account Relationship Management

Retention & Renewal Support

About Nettwerk Music Group

Founded in 1984, Nettwerk Music Group is a leading global independent record label with a legacy of purpose-driven innovation. We nurture a diverse roster of artists within fan-connected communities, helping artists cultivate deeply engaged audiences to build sustainable, long-term careers in the ever-evolving music industry.
Headquartered in Vancouver, Nettwerk's hybrid workforce operates from strategic hubs in Los Angeles, London, Hamburg, Eora / Sydney, New York, Nashville, Berlin, Amsterdam, Toronto, and beyond. With a wealth of cross-market expertise, our unified global team creates impactful, culturally resonant music experiences that transcend borders.

Role Summary

The Fan Engagement Intern role gives students and emerging talent the chance to translate their education and passion into real-world music industry experience. Collaborating directly with our Fan Engagement team, you will learn to leverage digital channels, social strategy, and compelling content to drive audience growth and community engagement for artists. In this role, you will gain hands-on experience with fan research & data, social management, content creation, and trend-driven strategy. We’re looking for someone obsessed with internet culture, fandoms, and niche communities who can translate creative ideas into impactful content for our artists.

This is a part-time internship requiring approximately 10–15 hours per week.

Role Responsibilities

  • Support the team in running artist fan & niche accounts - helping brainstorm content ideas, schedule posts, and keep pages active and engaging.
  • Identify emerging trends and sounds within our artist catalog, sourcing relevant viral clips, audio, and captions to build engaging fan page strategies.
  • Assist in publishing content and testing engagement tactics across experimental digital pages and emerging platforms.
  • Conduct research to identify relevant content creators, influencers, and superfans for upcoming artist campaigns and concert invites.
  • Create and batch short-form social assets for artists, including lyric videos, fan edits, and aesthetic content.
  • Capture iPhone content at local Nettwerk shows or events for use on fan pages.
  • Assist the fan engagement team with tasks as needed. Opportunity to explore cross-functional opportunities with other departments (such as marketing or advertising) based on interest and label needs.

What Success Looks Like

  • The fan pages you support stay active and consistent, with clear examples of posts or experimental tests that successfully moved engagement.
  • You are willing to dive in and experiment with new content concepts, with several of your original ideas actually being run by the team.
  • You’ve built creator and superfan lists that were used for real campaigns or show invites.
  • You take direction well, complete assigned tasks thoroughly and on time, and adapt easily to shifting team needs.
  • You spot trends and community opportunities early, taking the initiative to research an artist's specific fandom and present fresh concepts to the team.
  • You ask thoughtful questions, seek feedback to refine work, and actively explore how fan engagement impacts wider label and artist strategies

Qualifications

  • Immersed in online culture & fandoms, social media platforms (TikTok, Instagram, YouTube), and emerging internet subcultures.
  • Basic proficiency with short-form video editing tools (e.g., CapCut, Premiere, Canva) and experience posting to social media platforms.
  • Creative mindset with an interest in leveraging social analytics and research to inform content decisions.
  • Self-starter with high attention to detail, strong time-management skills, and clear written/verbal communication.
  • Eagerness to learn the mechanics of digital music marketing and fan community building.
  • Familiarity with Nettwerk’s artist roster and current digital music trends.

*While direct experience isn't required, we’d love to see anything you’ve created! Feel free to share links or attachments to fan accounts you’ve managed, video edits, social media pages you’ve grown, design/content projects, or any creative work that showcases your interests.

$15.00 USD per hour (Nashville, TN)

raw.description:
📋 Tâches et responsabilités

Le cadre du projet

Le projet s'inscrit dans une administration fédérale belge chargée de l'établissement et de la perception des impôts, droits et taxes, ainsi que de la gestion des informations et services associés pour les citoyens, les entreprises et les professionnels.

Dans ce cadre, une vaste base de connaissances juridique et réglementaire multilingue est entièrement reconstruite sur la base d'une architecture de données gouvernée. La plateforme s'adresse aux collaborateurs internes et à un large public externe de professionnels, notamment des comptables, des fiscalistes et des juristes. Le développement est organisé par phases, avec une gouvernance des données au centre de l'architecture et des jalons de décision clairement définis.

Le rôle

En tant qu'Analyste Business / Fonctionnel senior, vous rejoignez une équipe restreinte de profils seniors qui établit les fondations de la plateforme avant l'augmentation de la capacité de développement. Vous assurez la liaison entre le métier et l'IT, recueillez les besoins, modélisez l'information et rédigez les spécifications qui orientent un développement assisté par IA, toujours soumis à une revue humaine. La mission se déroule par étapes, selon des jalons de décision clairement établis.

Principales responsabilités

  • Préparer et animer des ateliers avec les gestionnaires de contenu, les experts métier et les key users internes et externes.
  • Documenter les processus actuels de rédaction, de traduction, de validation, de publication et de dépublication.
  • Dresser l'inventaire fonctionnel de l'application existante, notamment pour la recherche, la taxonomie, les abonnements et les profils utilisateurs.
  • Recueillir, analyser et prioriser les exigences selon la méthode MoSCoW, puis constituer, gérer et affiner le product backlog.
  • Définir les personas et les parcours utilisateurs des collaborateurs internes, des professionnels externes, des citoyens, des partenaires API et des outils d'IA.
  • Définir le modèle de classification des documents, avec les niveaux public, interne, restreint et embargo, puis formaliser les règles de publication avec le métier.
  • Rédiger des spécifications d'intention destinées à un pipeline de développement assisté par IA, avec des critères d'acceptation précis.
  • Effectuer la validation fonctionnelle des incréments et coordonner les tests d'acceptation utilisateurs (UAT).
  • Faire le lien entre le métier et l'IT, tout en analysant directement les données au moyen de SQL afin d'étayer les hypothèses.

📝 Votre profil

  • Expérience significative en tant qu'Analyste Business / Fonctionnel dans des environnements IT et data complexes.
  • Maîtrise de l'ingénierie des exigences et de la rédaction de spécifications assorties de critères d'acceptation, par exemple selon Volère / Robertson, les cas d'utilisation ou Gherkin.
  • Bonne pratique des méthodes Agile, notamment des epics, user stories, story maps et de la gestion de backlog.
  • Maîtrise de la modélisation des processus et de l'information, notamment BPMN, UML et les modèles conceptuels ou d'information.
  • Solides bases en SQL, avec une affinité pour l'analyse et la visualisation des données au moyen de Power BI et Python.
  • Une expérience en modélisation de données et/ou en gouvernance des données (Data Governance) constitue un atout majeur.
  • La connaissance des API, notamment Open API, ainsi que des patterns d'intégration event-driven et pub/sub est un plus.
  • La familiarité avec les notations d'architecture d'entreprise Archimate et TOGAF est un plus.
  • Vous maîtrisez le néerlandais à un niveau natif ou équivalent et disposez d'une bonne connaissance du français et de l'anglais.
  • Vous combinez une vision d'ensemble avec une attention précise portée aux données et aux détails.

Compétences obligatoires

  • Ingénierie des exigences et rédaction de spécifications avec critères d'acceptation, notamment Volère / Robertson.
  • Analyse Business / Fonctionnelle.
  • Pratiques Agile, modélisation BPMN et utilisation de SQL.

💼 Offre

Vous ferez partie d'une PME belge en pleine croissance, où l’initiative et le développement personnel sont encouragés. Nous vous offrirons un environnement de travail agréable, entouré(e) de collègues sympathiques. Ensemble, nous élaborerons un plan de carrière, avec une attention particulière et un budget dédié à la formation ou à la certification complémentaire. Vous pouvez compter sur un salaire attractif, complété par des avantages extra-légaux, y compris une voiture de société.

(Freelance est également possible)

raw.title: Senior Google Ads Buyer, DTC eCommerce
raw.excerpt: Everyone can run a search campaign.  Almost nobody can tell you whether it worked.
raw.description:
Everyone can run a search campaign. Almost nobody can tell you whether it worked.

That is the whole job.

Google will happily show you a 6x ROAS built almost entirely out of people who already knew your client's name. It will auto apply assets you did not ask for. It will report a number that makes a client feel great and tells you nothing about whether you grew the business.

So we do not hire people to manage Google Ads. We hire marketers who can tell the difference between demand they created and demand they harvested, and who can prove it to a client's face.

At Sweat Pants Agency we work with around 50 DTC and eCommerce brands, 20 to 25 of them on paid media. We spend $6 to $9M a month on Meta and $1 to $2M a month on Google. We are the only agency behind two INC #1 fastest growing brands, both from zero.

You would own a set of our Google accounts end to end.

Here is what "end to end" actually means.

You are the account manager. We do not have any. You talk to the client directly. You write the updates, you run the calls, and you defend the call you made. The reason we do it this way is ownership. When you are the person answering for the account, it is your result, not somebody else's summary of your result.

You own the whole funnel, not the campaign. Feed and Merchant Center, search and Shopping and PMax, Demand Gen and YouTube, the landing page, and the conversion tracking underneath all of it. If the feed is why Shopping is starving, that is yours. If the page is why the clicks do not convert, that is yours too. Our team ships advertorials, comparison pages, and PDPs in Claude Code, deploys them to Vercel, points a subdomain at them, and tests them live before anything touches the client's Shopify theme.

You are expected to have an opinion about attribution and to defend it. We optimize to NC-CPA and NC-ROAS, not blended and not last click. We have turned brand search off to see what actually shifts to organic. We run geo holdouts. If a campaign is not incremental, we would rather know than keep the number.

You can live anywhere. We are remote and we hire worldwide. The one hard requirement is that you can take client calls during US Eastern business hours, because you are the client's point of contact. The rest of your day is yours. Nobody here is on a time clock. We judge you on output.

If you want a lane, a ticket queue, and a scope document, this is a bad fit and we will both know it fast.

If you want to own the whole picture and be judged on whether the number moved, keep reading.

Requirements

What the job looks like

  • Own a set of DTC accounts as the strategist, the buyer, and the client's direct point of contact. Budgets run from $5k/mo to well into six figures a month.
  • Own the client relationship. There is no account manager between you and them. You present the results, the plan, and the reasoning, and you are the one who answers when something is not working.
  • Audit before you touch anything. Every account we take over gets a real review first: campaign and ad group structure, keywords versus search terms, negatives, bidding strategy per campaign type, impression share, feed health, landing pages, audiences, and conversion tracking. Then a Loom walking the client through what you found. That Loom is how we sell and it is how we keep people.
  • Run brand and non brand as different businesses. Brand is mostly assisted conversion and it usually belongs on target impression share, not target CPA. Non brand is where the growth is and where the waste is. Report them separately or you are reporting nothing.
  • Know what PMax is actually doing. The most common mistake we see is optimizing PMax against an incremental CAC when half the volume inside it is branded. If you cannot separate those two, you cannot set a target.
  • Keep Google's automation on a leash. Auto applied recommendations, auto applied assets, and auto created sitelinks have cost our clients real money. We audit for them on a schedule.
  • Own the feed. Merchant Center hygiene, product titles, disapprovals, promotions, and what the feed does to Shopping and PMax delivery.
  • Own the tracking. GA4, GTM, Shopify goal imports versus a raw Google Ads tag, enhanced conversions, offline conversion imports for the lead gen accounts. When the numbers do not reconcile, you are the one who finds out why.
  • Diagnose the bottleneck, then go fix it. Creative, offer, AOV, landing page, checkout, tracking. Nobody is going to reassign it to another team.
  • Build the things the account needs. Landing pages, scripts, reporting, whatever removes the constraint. We are heavy AI users and we expect you to build, not just prompt.

You are a fit if

  • You have done this with real money. Hands on Google Ads at meaningful spend on DTC and eCommerce, with results you can walk us through: CPA, ROAS, revenue, and what you actually changed to get them. Shopping and PMax specifically, not just search.
  • You are fluent in the whole stack, not one campaign type. Search, Shopping, PMax, Demand Gen, YouTube, Merchant Center, GA4, GTM. Bing is a nice to have.
  • You are AI native, and you build. This is a requirement, not a bonus. You should already be using Claude or equivalent as a working tool rather than a novelty, and you should be able to build and ship a landing page with it.
  • You can communicate your ideas in English at a native or near native level. You will be in front of clients constantly. You need to explain your thinking clearly, sell an idea on its merits, push back when a client is about to force the account into mediocrity, and raise a problem before it becomes a fire. This matters as much as anything else on this list.
  • You are skeptical of your own numbers. You would rather run the holdout than protect the dashboard.
  • You can work US Eastern business hours for client calls. Where you live is up to you.
  • Bonus: you have built or operated your own Shopify store, or you have run Meta at spend too.

You are not a fit if

  • "That was not my role" is in your vocabulary. It is the fastest way to end an interview here. If the feed was the problem on an account you ran, you should have done something about the feed.
  • You want to be told what to do this week.
  • You need a ticketing system to know what matters.
  • You quote blended ROAS as if it settles the question.

Benefits

Why this role is exciting

This is not a maintenance job. You would have real influence over how we run Google across the agency.

You will work on real brands with real budgets. We test aggressively. We learn quickly. We build frameworks that scale.

You get trust on day one. You get a lot of autonomy. Some people thrive with it. You will get feedback fast either way, and if you make it through the first 30 days you will probably be here for a long time. Our retention on this team is very good and that is not an accident.

You will grow into senior strategy. We want people who want more responsibility. If you perform, you will grow.

As a Senior Sales Development Representative, you will identify and engage our ideal customers using Vendavo’s target account profile. You will lead the first stage of the customer journey, starting conversations and building early relationships through outbound prospecting, targeted campaigns, events and coordinated marketing activity.

You will guide prospects through the early stages of the commercial lifecycle: discovering opportunities, qualifying interest and fit, and securing high-quality meetings for our Account Executives. You will also support the account team on key marketing activity. Your work lays the foundation for predictable, high-quality pipeline across our enterprise segment.

THE OPPORTUNITY

  • Leverage research and tailored outreach to create new opportunities with both New Logo accounts and existing customers.
  • Run outbound prospecting (cold calling, email, LinkedIn) on strategic target accounts using concise, research-led messaging. Most of your quota will be expected to come from outbound.

  • Assist in the mentorship and training of new SDRs on process, technology and the company, and act as a leader and problem solver for the team.

raw.description:
About Nerdio

At Nerdio, our mission is to simplify the lives of IT professionals and maximize their Microsoft cloud and end user computing investments.

We support organizations of all sizes looking to deploy, manage, and cost-optimize native Microsoft technologies. We partner with Enterprises and Managed Service Providers all over the world to add value on top of their existing native Microsoft investments like Azure Virtual Desktop (AVD), Windows 365, and Microsoft Intune.

Created in 2016, Nerdio has always taken a market-leading and collaborative approach to cloud deployment and management. In fact, our product roadmap is greatly influenced by the regular feedback we receive from having seen companies deploy AVD into production environments several thousand times using Nerdio technology.

Today, Nerdio is used in over 50 countries by more than 15,000 organizations of every size and vertical. We’re committed to delivering exceptional service and support, which starts with identifying and supporting the best staff possible.

We are a fast-moving, nimble company looking for individuals who are collaborative, empathetic, driven and who love to move at the speed of light. If you want to be part of the AVD transformation that Microsoft and Nerdio are leading, then we want to speak with you.

About the role

Nerdio is hiring a Digital Program Manager to orchestrate the scaled customer experience across Customer Success. You will own the automated journeys end to end, and act as an internal consultant to the rest of the CS organization: finding friction in the customer journey and removing it with automation and agentic AI.

You will report to the Senior Manager, Digital Customer Success and work alongside the Pooled CS team, but your reach is wider: the plays you build are designed for reuse across Customer Success, so customers get one seamless experience no matter who owns the moment. This is a builder role with no named book of business. You bring the ownership and customer-first urgency of a CAM or TAM to cross-functional programs, and you are comfortable bringing structure to ambiguity.

What you'll do

Orchestrate the scaled customer experience

  • Own the digital journey from onboarding through adoption, value realization, renewal, and expansion readiness. Build, launch, monitor, and iterate the plays and automations at each stage.
  • Build the triggers and handoffs that bring in a CAM or TAM at the right moment (health thresholds, renewal risk, expansion signals, escalations, champion changes, customer requests), following the coverage model set by the strategy lead.
  • Deliver against the current and future-state journey maps owned by the strategy lead. Surface the friction points you find in the data and in the field, and close them so the experience feels the same regardless of who owns the moment.

Act as an internal consultant to Customer Success

  • Lead discovery with CS teams: ticket analysis, stakeholder interviews, and data review to find where manual, repetitive, or inconsistent work hurts customers or burns CAM/TAM capacity.
  • Recommend and build the fix: automation, signal-based triggers, and agentic AI. Give teams plays they can turn on today.

Lead agentic AI and automation

  • Move the program from static plays to adaptive, agentic journeys for higher-complexity moments, such as personalized onboarding and automated EBR/TVR one-pagers.
  • Equip CAMs and TAMs with agentic insights that make their jobs easier and return capacity to them.
  • Evaluate tools, run pilots, and set guardrails so AI-driven touches are accurate, on-brand, and hand off to a human when one is needed.

Run the program and the partnerships

  • Own program and project management from discovery to launch to iteration: scope, plan, sequence, and keep a current view of the roadmap, status, and dependencies.
  • Partner with Marketing on every lifecycle communication, RevOps on segmentation and metrics, Product on telemetry and in-app messaging, Support on ticket signals, and Sales on expansion.
  • Prove impact. Tie each play to NRR, adoption, and risk reduction, run test-and-learn cycles, and share results broadly.

Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in digital customer success, lifecycle or adoption marketing, CS operations, or program management for a scaled customer segment.
  • A track record of leading cross-functional programs from idea to launch and influencing partners without direct authority.
  • A consultative approach: you can run discovery, facilitate working sessions, and turn what you hear into a prioritized plan.
  • Hands-on experience with CS, marketing automation, or CRM platforms, and the ability to build or configure automated journeys.
  • Practical experience with, or strong curiosity about, AI agents and LLM-based workflows, and sound judgment on where AI should and should not act.
  • Data fluency: you use product telemetry, health scores, and attribution to choose what to build and show what worked.
  • Strong prioritization, risk management, and written and verbal communication for audiences from CAMs to executives.
  • A builder mentality and comfort with ambiguity.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in B2B SaaS, cloud, or the Microsoft and MSP ecosystem.
  • Experience with Partner Success or Support operations.
  • Hands-on use of no-code or low-code agent builders and prompt design.

  • Health and Welfare Plans*
  • Life and Disability Plans*
  • Retirement Plan*
  • Unlimited Flexible Paid Time Off, including your birthday off!
  • Collaborative Team Culture

* Benefits for international employees, outside the US, vary by country.

About the company

Paid per approved task, about $100/hr equivalent. One flat rate for every approved task.

Built to fit around a clinical practice:

  • Tasks estimated at about 10–20 hrs/week while the project is active; you choose when and how much to contribute
  • Contribute anytime, from anywhere
  • No patient contact, no malpractice exposure: you review written clinical cases
  • All reviewers are license-verified physicians
  • $50 one-time onboarding reward, paid once your first production task is approved

Mindrift connects specialists with project-based AI opportunities for leading tech companies, focused on testing, evaluating, and improving AI systems. Participation is project-based.

What this opportunity involves

We’re looking for actively practicing physicians (MD/DO) with an active, unrestricted US medical license to evaluate clinical EHR vignettes for a medical AI evaluation project. General and internal medicine are the main focus. On this project, contributors may:

  • Evaluate clinical EHR vignettes paired with a question, a proposed answer, and a distractor “trap” answer across diagnosis and treatment tasks, spanning cardiovascular, nervous, hematologic, respiratory, digestive, urinary, reproductive, musculoskeletal, and integumentary systems;
  • Score the clinical reasoning quality of benchmark items: vignette accuracy and completeness, whether the vignette gives the answer away, answer correctness and gradeability, and trap quality;
  • Check whether the reasoning chain reaches the answer from vignette facts alone, correct reasoning traces, and write short rationales;
  • Work within three independent blind reads, followed by physician adjudication. Real clinical complexity only. You’re improving the AI tools you’ll eventually use yourself.

If you’re a practicing physician ready to take on this challenging and engaging project, apply to take part!

What we look for

This opportunity is a good fit for US-licensed physicians looking for a flexible, time-limited project they can fit around clinical practice. Ideally, contributors will have:

  • Medical degree (MD or DO) and an active, unrestricted US medical license (verified at onboarding and re-checked monthly);
  • Board certification or completed residency training, with recent direct patient care (attending-level preferred);
  • Broad, multi-system diagnostic and treatment experience (internal, family, emergency, or hospital medicine);
  • Strong clinical reasoning: differential diagnosis, next-step management, and application of evidence-based guidelines;
  • Prior experience in medical AI evaluation, clinical content or exam-question review, or medical annotation/QA (a plus);
  • Strong written English (C1+).

This opportunity is not suitable for medical students, unlicensed medical graduates, non-physician clinicians (NPs, PAs, nurses, pharmacists), or non-clinical healthcare titles.

How it works ​

Apply → Pass qualification(s) → Join a project → Complete tasks → Get paid

Project time expectations

You decide when and how much to contribute. For this project, tasks are estimated at around 10–20 hours per week during active phases. This is an estimate, not a minimum or a guaranteed workload, and applies only while the project is active. Tasks are submitted within the project timeline and need to meet the listed acceptance criteria to be approved.

Earnings

Earnings are per approved task, at a flat rate set to about $100/hr equivalent based on estimated task time. There are no tiers or speed adjustments to the base rate. QA and adjudication tasks are paid at a higher rate.

  • $50 one-time onboarding reward, paid once your first production task is approved.
  • Incentives: additional earnings for high-quality approved tasks. Terms are shared in the project guidelines.
