raw.title: Paid Search Strategist, DTC eCommerce
raw.excerpt: Everyone can run a search campaign.  Almost nobody can tell you whether it worked.
raw.description:
Everyone can run a search campaign. Almost nobody can tell you whether it worked.

That is the whole job.

Google will happily show you a 6x ROAS built almost entirely out of people who already knew your client's name. It will auto apply assets you did not ask for. It will report a number that makes a client feel great and tells you nothing about whether you grew the business.

So we do not hire people to manage Google Ads. We hire marketers who can tell the difference between demand they created and demand they harvested, and who can prove it to a client's face.

At Sweat Pants Agency we work with around 50 DTC and eCommerce brands, 20 to 25 of them on paid media. We spend $6 to $9M a month on Meta and $1 to $2M a month on Google. We are the only agency behind two INC #1 fastest growing brands, both from zero.

You would own a set of our Google accounts end to end.

Here is what "end to end" actually means.

You are the account manager. We do not have any. You talk to the client directly. You write the updates, you run the calls, and you defend the call you made. The reason we do it this way is ownership. When you are the person answering for the account, it is your result, not somebody else's summary of your result.

You own the whole funnel, not the campaign. Feed and Merchant Center, search and Shopping and PMax, Demand Gen and YouTube, the landing page, and the conversion tracking underneath all of it. If the feed is why Shopping is starving, that is yours. If the page is why the clicks do not convert, that is yours too. Our team ships advertorials, comparison pages, and PDPs in Claude Code, deploys them to Vercel, points a subdomain at them, and tests them live before anything touches the client's Shopify theme.

You are expected to have an opinion about attribution and to defend it. We optimize to NC-CPA and NC-ROAS, not blended and not last click. We have turned brand search off to see what actually shifts to organic. We run geo holdouts. If a campaign is not incremental, we would rather know than keep the number.

You can live anywhere. We are remote and we hire worldwide. The one hard requirement is that you can take client calls during US Eastern business hours, because you are the client's point of contact. The rest of your day is yours. Nobody here is on a time clock. We judge you on output.

If you want a lane, a ticket queue, and a scope document, this is a bad fit and we will both know it fast.

If you want to own the whole picture and be judged on whether the number moved, keep reading.

Requirements

What the job looks like

  • Own a set of DTC accounts as the strategist, the buyer, and the client's direct point of contact. Budgets run from $5k/mo to well into six figures a month.
  • Own the client relationship. There is no account manager between you and them. You present the results, the plan, and the reasoning, and you are the one who answers when something is not working.
  • Audit before you touch anything. Every account we take over gets a real review first: campaign and ad group structure, keywords versus search terms, negatives, bidding strategy per campaign type, impression share, feed health, landing pages, audiences, and conversion tracking. Then a Loom walking the client through what you found. That Loom is how we sell and it is how we keep people.
  • Run brand and non brand as different businesses. Brand is mostly assisted conversion and it usually belongs on target impression share, not target CPA. Non brand is where the growth is and where the waste is. Report them separately or you are reporting nothing.
  • Know what PMax is actually doing. The most common mistake we see is optimizing PMax against an incremental CAC when half the volume inside it is branded. If you cannot separate those two, you cannot set a target.
  • Keep Google's automation on a leash. Auto applied recommendations, auto applied assets, and auto created sitelinks have cost our clients real money. We audit for them on a schedule.
  • Own the feed. Merchant Center hygiene, product titles, disapprovals, promotions, and what the feed does to Shopping and PMax delivery.
  • Own the tracking. GA4, GTM, Shopify goal imports versus a raw Google Ads tag, enhanced conversions, offline conversion imports for the lead gen accounts. When the numbers do not reconcile, you are the one who finds out why.
  • Diagnose the bottleneck, then go fix it. Creative, offer, AOV, landing page, checkout, tracking. Nobody is going to reassign it to another team.
  • Build the things the account needs. Landing pages, scripts, reporting, whatever removes the constraint. We are heavy AI users and we expect you to build, not just prompt.

You are a fit if

  • You have done this with real money. Hands on Google Ads at meaningful spend on DTC and eCommerce, with results you can walk us through: CPA, ROAS, revenue, and what you actually changed to get them. Shopping and PMax specifically, not just search.
  • You are fluent in the whole stack, not one campaign type. Search, Shopping, PMax, Demand Gen, YouTube, Merchant Center, GA4, GTM. Bing is a nice to have.
  • You are AI native, and you build. This is a requirement, not a bonus. You should already be using Claude or equivalent as a working tool rather than a novelty, and you should be able to build and ship a landing page with it.
  • You can communicate your ideas in English at a native or near native level. You will be in front of clients constantly. You need to explain your thinking clearly, sell an idea on its merits, push back when a client is about to force the account into mediocrity, and raise a problem before it becomes a fire. This matters as much as anything else on this list.
  • You are skeptical of your own numbers. You would rather run the holdout than protect the dashboard.
  • You can work US Eastern business hours for client calls. Where you live is up to you.
  • Bonus: you have built or operated your own Shopify store, or you have run Meta at spend too.

You are not a fit if

  • "That was not my role" is in your vocabulary. It is the fastest way to end an interview here. If the feed was the problem on an account you ran, you should have done something about the feed.
  • You want to be told what to do this week.
  • You need a ticketing system to know what matters.
  • You quote blended ROAS as if it settles the question.

Benefits

Why this role is exciting

This is not a maintenance job. You would have real influence over how we run Google across the agency.

You will work on real brands with real budgets. We test aggressively. We learn quickly. We build frameworks that scale.

You get trust on day one. You get a lot of autonomy. Some people thrive with it. You will get feedback fast either way, and if you make it through the first 30 days you will probably be here for a long time. Our retention on this team is very good and that is not an accident.

You will grow into senior strategy. We want people who want more responsibility. If you perform, you will grow.

Who We Are

Teroxx is an innovative digital asset boutique operating at the intersection of finance and technology. We are a MiCA-licensed Crypto-Asset Service Provider (CASP) in the EU, offering secure, user-centric financial solutions to private and institutional clients. Our portfolio includes exchange, crypto-asset advisory, portfolio management, custody, and market analytics.

About the Role

We are looking for a strategic, commercially minded, and hands-on Senior Product Marketing Manager to join our Product Department and build our Product Marketing capabilities.

You will own product marketing for assigned product areas, translating complex product capabilities into compelling positioning, clear value propositions, and effective go-to-market strategies. You will also drive growth across the customer lifecycle, from acquisition and conversion to engagement, retention, and monetization.

This role combines product marketing, growth strategy, and analytics, with the opportunity to establish new processes, take ownership of strategic initiatives, and shape how Product Marketing operates within Teroxx. As the function grows, there will be an opportunity to progress into a Lead Product Marketing role.

The role is opened for candidates from EU and B2B contractors (full-time).

Your Key Responsibilities

  • Product Marketing & Positioning: Own marketing for assigned product areas, developing differentiated positioning, messaging, and value propositions. Translate complex product features into clear customer benefits, informed by customer needs, market research, and competitive insights.
  • Go-to-Market & Marketing Strategy: Develop long-term marketing strategies and quarterly roadmaps aligned with business objectives. Lead GTM planning and execution for product launches, feature rollouts, and strategic initiatives, coordinating creative and cross-functional teams to ensure high-quality delivery.
  • Growth & Lifecycle Marketing: Drive growth across paid acquisition, SEO, conversion optimization, in-app marketing, lifecycle communications, upselling, and retention. Work with existing team members and external partners to improve channel performance and customer engagement.
  • Analytics & Function Development: Establish marketing analytics, tracking, and attribution through GA4 and Mixpanel. Use performance data and customer feedback to optimize initiatives. Own the transition of relevant activities, assets, and processes from Communications, while establishing the Product Marketing function, its priorities, and ways of working.
  • Strategic Collaboration: Work closely with Product, Design, Compliance, and Business Development to identify opportunities, support strategic initiatives, and translate product and business objectives into measurable marketing outcomes. Contribute to the marketing strategy for the MiFID licensing POC.

What We're Looking For

Required

  • 5+ years of experience in Product Marketing, Growth Marketing, or a related role, ideally within fintech, financial services, or technology.
  • Proven experience owning product positioning, go-to-market strategies, and marketing initiatives end-to-end.
  • Understanding of performance and lifecycle marketing, including paid channels, SEO, conversion optimization, and customer engagement.
  • Experience with marketing analytics, tracking, and attribution, ideally using GA4 and Mixpanel.
  • Strong strategic, analytical, and project management skills, with the ability to translate business objectives into actionable plans.
  • Excellent English communication skills and the ability to simplify complex product concepts.
  • Strong ownership mindset, initiative, and ability to operate independently in an evolving environment.
  • The candidate is expected to be currently based in an EU Member State

Preferred:

  • Experience in digital assets, cryptocurrency, blockchain, or regulated financial services.
  • Familiarity with MiCA, AML, and European regulatory frameworks.
  • Experience building a Product Marketing or Growth function.
  • Familiarity with marketing automation and customer engagement platforms.

Initial Priorities & Success

  • Complete the transition of relevant activities, assets, and knowledge from the Communications team.
  • Establish the Product Marketing function, its priorities, processes, and roadmap.
  • Improve Performance Marketing activities across paid channels, SEO, and conversion optimization, working closely with the existing team.
  • Establish the GA4 and Mixpanel analytics and tracking foundation.
  • Lead GTM planning and execution for OpenPayd and the Ambassador Program.
  • Help shape the marketing strategy for the MiFID licensing POC.
  • Demonstrate clear ownership, initiative, and tangible progress across these priorities.

Why Join Us?

  • Build and shape a Product Marketing function within the Product Department.
  • Work directly with Product leadership and influence product strategy and commercial growth.
  • Gain exposure to a fully MiCA-licensed CASP environment.
  • Take ownership of impactful initiatives across product, marketing, and growth.
  • Develop professionally with the opportunity to progress into a Lead Product Marketing role.

Naše programy tvoří experti z praxe, jsou zaměřené na skutečné potřeby trhu a vedené v prostředí spolupráce, zvídavosti a růstu.

V roce 2023 jsme se spojili sTether, abychom naši misi rozšířili do celého světa – zpřístupnit praktické a kariérně posilující vzdělávání všem, kdo chtějí růst.

Dnes budujeme novou generaci digitálních profesionálů: marketérů, designérů, vývojářů a tvůrců, kteří nechtějí jen práci, ale i dopad.

Naše hodnoty jsou jednoduché a žité: lidé na prvním místě, zvědavost, kvalita a zodpovědnost.

A jsme teprve na začátku.

Role Overview

Hledáme člověka s bohatou praxí v oblasti AI, který povede náš praktický online kurz AI Knowledge Base. V kurzu se účastníci učí vybudovat a používat znalostní systém postavený na umělé inteligenci. Může sloužit jejich týmu nebo firmě, ale i jim samotným. Naučí se propojit s AI dokumenty, wiki, zápisy z porad a další materiály. Znalosti, které jsou roztroušené po různých nástrojích a v hlavách různých lidí, pak půjdou snadno uspořádat, dohledat a využít.

Kurz stojí na příkladech z firemní praxe. Účastníci jsou obvykle lidé, kteří chtějí udělat pořádek ve znalostech svého týmu nebo firmy. Stejné principy ale platí i pro osobní poznámky a projekty. Účastníky proto vedeme k tomu, aby si systém nejdřív postavili pro sebe a teprve potom ho rozšířili na celý tým.

Budete vést večerní online lekce a provázet účastníky principy, nástroji a praktickým využitím správy znalostí s pomocí AI. Nebudete je učit, jak se proklikat jedním konkrétním nástrojem. Pomůžete jim pochopit, jak:

  • navrhnout vlastní systém,

  • propojit AI s vlastními daty,

  • vyhodnocovat odpovědi generované AI,

  • řešit přístupová práva a bezpečnost dat,

  • udržet systém dlouhodobě živý.

Main Responsibilities

  • Sdílíte s účastníky své odborné znalosti a praktické zkušenosti.

  • Připravujete a vedete poutavé online lekce, které kombinují teorii, praktické ukázky a interaktivní cvičení. Pracujete hlavně s realistickými firemními scénáři a necháváte prostor, aby si účastníci vše vyzkoušeli i na vlastních datech.

  • Podporujete, motivujete a provázíte účastníky celým kurzem. Pomáháte jim přenést to, co se naučili, do jejich vlastního prostředí.

  • Vytváříte otevřenou a vstřícnou atmosféru, ve které se účastníci z různých firem a s různým zázemím aktivně zapojují, spolupracují a sdílejí zkušenosti.

  • Udržujete výuku aktuální: sledujete nové trendy v AI a zapracováváte do ní relevantní technologie a osvědčené postupy.

Requirements

  • Praktickou zkušenost s budováním a používáním znalostního systému s AI. Ideálně jak pro sebe, tak pro tým nebo firmu, kde ho aktivně používají i další lidé.

  • Základní programátorské dovednosti. Zvládnete napsat jednoduché skripty v Pythonu nebo JavaScriptu a propojit AI nástroje s daty, workflow nebo automatizacemi. Zkušenost seniorního vývojáře není potřeba.

  • Praktickou zkušenost s AI nástroji, jako jsou ChatGPT (custom GPTs), Claude (Projects), Gemini / NotebookLM nebo Microsoft 365 Copilot. Patří sem i práce s nahranými zdroji a s připojenými úložišti dokumentů (Google Drive, SharePoint, Notion, Confluence a podobně).

  • Schopnost vysvětlit, jak AI pracuje se zdroji informací a jak ověřovat odpovědi, které generuje. Umíte také vysvětlit, jak při práci s firemními daty přistupovat k ochraně dat, přístupovým oprávněním, důvěrnosti informací a GDPR.

  • Schopnost vysvětlovat přenositelné koncepty, ne jen jednotlivé nástroje. Například jak strukturovat znalosti, aby s nimi AI uměla pracovat, a jak systém udržovat i po prvotním nastavení.

  • Kritický a vyvážený pohled na AI včetně jejích omezení a rizik.

  • Výborné komunikační dovednosti. Umíte srozumitelně vysvětlit složité koncepty a přiblížit je i lidem bez technického zázemí.

  • Upřímný zájem pomáhat druhým růst a získat jistotu při práci s AI.

  • Možnost učit s praktickými příklady, které neobsahují žádná důvěrná data klientů ani zaměstnavatele. Nebrání vám v tom NDA ani konkurenční doložka.

  • Češtinu na úrovni C2.

Nice to have

  • Předchozí zkušenost s výukou, mentoringem, facilitací workshopů nebo veřejným vystupováním. Není to podmínkou, pokud jasně komunikujete a umíte složité myšlenky srozumitelně vysvětlit.

  • Zkušenost se zaváděním AI nástrojů nebo knowledge managementu ve firmě. Například jako interní lídr, konzultant nebo na pozici v provozu či IT.

What we offer

  • Přátelské a inspirativní pracovní prostředí.

  • Samostatnost a tvůrčí svobodu při vedení kurzů.

  • Neomezený přístup ke všem kurzům XPUP a slevy pro rodinné příslušníky.

  • Atraktivní program odměn za doporučení.

  • Příležitost pomáhat vychovávat novou generaci lidí, kteří AI rozumějí a umějí ji využívat v praxi.

Remote Talent LATAM connects talented professionals across Latin America with growing companies in the U.S. and other international markets. We help professionals find long-term remote opportunities where they can grow their careers while making a meaningful impact on the teams they join.

About the Client

Our client is a results-driven digital marketing agency specializing in lead generation for U.S.-based local service businesses.

The agency helps businesses generate qualified leads through Google Ads, Google Local Services Ads (LSAs), and other digital marketing strategies. Their clients include businesses in industries such as roofing, remodeling, landscaping, legal, medical, and other high-ticket local services.

About the Role

We’re looking for a Google Ads Specialist to manage and scale campaigns for U.S.-based local service businesses. In this role, you’ll take ownership of campaign performance, from building and launching campaigns to optimizing results and identifying opportunities for profitable growth.

You’ll manage a portfolio of approximately 25–35 Google Ads accounts, with the final number depending on your capacity and performance. Account budgets typically range from $5,000 to $50,000 per month, averaging around $15,000.

This is a hands-on, backend role focused on campaign management and measurable results rather than direct client communication. You’ll work closely with the internal team, sharing performance updates, identifying risks, and making sure campaigns continue moving in the right direction.

Key Responsibilities

  • Manage and optimize campaigns: Build, launch, monitor, and continuously improve Google Ads and Local Services Ads (LSAs) campaigns for U.S. local service businesses.
  • Drive performance: Monitor key metrics such as cost per lead (CPL), cost per qualified lead, qualified lead volume, and return on ad spend (ROAS), making data-driven decisions to improve results.
  • Scale successful accounts: Identify opportunities to increase budgets, launch additional campaigns, explore Performance Max (PMax), and grow accounts profitably.
  • Oversee conversion tracking and landing pages: Work with an assigned assistant responsible for conversion tracking and landing page design, providing clear direction and ensuring everything is properly implemented.
  • Prioritize lead quality: Optimize campaigns for qualified leads and booked jobs, not just clicks or form submissions.
  • Document and improve processes: Maintain clear documentation of successful strategies, optimizations, and workflows that can be replicated across the team.
  • Keep the team informed: Share regular performance updates, flag potential issues, and communicate opportunities and risks proactively without waiting to be asked.

Requirements

  • 2–3+ years of hands-on Google Ads experience, ideally in an agency environment managing multiple accounts simultaneously.
  • Proven experience managing Google Ads campaigns for U.S.-based local service businesses. You should be able to demonstrate past results through account examples, case studies, or performance data.
  • Experience managing monthly advertising budgets in the $5,000–$50,000 range, with an understanding of how to optimize and scale campaigns responsibly.
  • A strong understanding of campaign performance metrics, conversion tracking, lead quality, and optimization strategies tied to business outcomes.
  • Solid English communication skills, with the ability to explain performance trends, recommendations, and results clearly.
  • Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage a high volume of accounts while maintaining attention to detail.
  • A proactive, self-sufficient approach. You take responsibility for your accounts, identify problems early, and keep the team informed of your progress.
  • Genuine interest in Google Ads and a passion for improving campaign performance through testing, analysis, and continuous optimization.
  • Must be available to work U.S. Eastern business hours.

Nice to Have

  • Current experience working at a digital marketing or performance marketing agency.
  • Familiarity with GoHighLevel, WhatConverts, ClickUp, or similar tools.
  • Experience with Meta Ads or other paid media platforms.
  • Experience directing or collaborating with specialists responsible for conversion tracking and landing page development.
  • Solid knowledge of Google Local Services Ads (LSAs).

Benefits

  • Fully Remote, U.S. Eastern business hours.
  • Monthly compensation: starts at $2,000, with flexibility depending on experience.
  • Performance bonus: Monthly bonus target of 10% of earnings.
  • 12 PTO days + U.S. holidays.
  • Payment through Wise, either biweekly or monthly.
  • Career Growth: Opportunities to transition into client-facing or management roles may be available over time, depending on your interests and career goals. However, advancement in these areas is entirely optional, with the role remaining focused on hands-on campaign management.

About SiTime

SiTime is the Precision Timing company.

Timing is the heartbeat of all electronics, ensuring performance, resilience and scalability. For decades, quartz devices, non-silicon technology, have kept systems in sync, but they struggle in harsher, more demanding environments. MEMS-based Precision Timing delivers greater accuracy, smaller size and resilience. Today, MEMS timing powers over 400 applications, including high-growth ones in AI datacenters, automated driving, industrial and humanoid robots, wearables and IoT.

Our semiconductor MEMS programmable solutions offer a rich feature set that enables customers to differentiate their products with higher performance, smaller size, lower power, and better reliability. With more than 4 billion devices shipped, SiTime is changing the timing industry. For more information, visit: www.sitime.com.

Job Summary

We are seeking a highly motivated and skilled Packaging Process Engineer to join SiTime in Singapore, focusing on Bumping, Flip-chip and Wafer-Level Chip Scale Packaging (WLCSP) technologies. In this role, you will be responsible for developing, optimizing, and sustaining advanced packaging processes to ensure high-quality and high-yield manufacturing. This is an excellent opportunity for a hands-on engineer to make a significant impact on cutting-edge semiconductor packaging technologies within a dynamic and innovative environment.

Responsibilities:

Package Development

  • Develop, optimize, and characterize packaging processes for WLCSP technologies, including but not limited to bumping, re-distribution layer (RDL) formation, underfill, dicing…
  • Perform root cause analysis and implement corrective and preventive actions (8D methodology) for process-related issues and defects.
  • Collaborate with R&D, design, equipment, and manufacturing teams to ensure seamless process transfer from development to high-volume manufacturing.
  • Lead or participate in cross-functional teams for new product introduction (NPI) and process improvement projects.
  • Evaluate and qualify new materials, equipment, and processes to support technology roadmaps and production requirements.
  • Stay updated with the latest industry trends and advancements in packaging technologies.

Package Manufacture and Sustaining

  • Conduct process capability analysis (Cp/Cpk), implement statistical process control (SPC), and drive continuous improvement initiatives to enhance yield, quality, and cost-efficiency.
  • Define and maintain process specifications, control plans, and standard operating procedures (SOPs).
  • Provide technical support and training for manufacturing operators and technicians.

Desired Characteristics & Attributes:

  • Core Skills:
    • Make things more efficient: They should be able to improve how the packaging line works. This means reducing waste, getting more products out the door, and fixing issues that cause shutdowns.
    • Know their stuff: They need to understand different materials like plastic, glass, and cardboard, and how to work with a wide range of machines—from fillers and sealers to labelers.
    • Keep quality high: A great candidate is dedicated to safety and quality standards, following rules like Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP).
  • Personal Traits
    • Problem-solver: They can find and fix complex issues on their own. They're proactive and don't just wait for problems to get worse.
    • Detailed and thorough: They pay close attention to every detail to prevent errors that could lead to wasted products or costly mistakes.
    • Good communicator: They can work well with everyone on the team—from the factory floor crew to the R&D department. They can explain technical problems clearly to anyone.

Compensation Range:

At SiTime, we believe great work deserves great rewards. We offer a comprehensive and highly competitive compensation package designed to attract top talent.

In addition to base salary, this role is eligible for a quarterly bonus tied to the achievement of innovation goals—reflecting our commitment to recognizing meaningful impact. We also offer equity grants, providing a meaningful opportunity to share in the company’s future growth and success.

SiTime is committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants. Employment decisions are based on qualifications, merit, and business needs. We do not discriminate on the basis of any characteristic protected by applicable law.

raw.description:
We are EnerMech, a specialist service company that delivers safe, integrated solutions for complex energy projects.

For over 50 years, we've been energizing our clients across the world with unrivalled expertise, equipment, and technology that supports the entire asset life-cycle - offshore and on land.

We enable progress through our three global business lines: Energy Solutions, Infrastructure & Industrial Solutions, and Lifting Solutions.

Within these areas, we offer a wide range of services, including cranes, lifting, fluid power, training, equipment rental, pipeline and subsea, process, and valves - all designed to help our clients optimize performance, enhance reliability, and improve efficiency.

With a focus on operational excellence, we deliver value through our customized integrated solutions. This approach reduces risk and enhances efficiencies making us a leading and trusted partner every step of the way.

The Role & Responsibilities

The role will be responsible for taking technical ownership of key workstreams on EnerMech's Azure Databricks data platform, operating across the full platform stack: data modelling and pipeline development in Databricks, the underlying Azure infrastructure, and the CI/CD, DevOps and DataOps practices that keep the platform reliable, secure and scalable.

The role holder operates with a high degree of autonomy, makes and documents architectural decisions, resolves complex platform issues, and is a technical point of contact for the global EBS Team, and business stakeholders.

This is a fully remote role in the UK,supporting our Enterprise Business Systems (EBS) function in the Mumbai Shared Service Centre.

Key reponsibilities will include:

    • Design, build, quality and reliable operation of assigned workstreams on the Azure Databricks data platform, from scoping through to production deployment.
    • Integrity of the medallion data model (bronze/silver/gold) for assigned data domains, ensuring data is modelled, validated, documented and certified for downstream reporting and analytics.
    • Build and optimise Delta tables and materialized views, with attention to performance at scale.
    • Design and implement data quality frameworks (preferably DQX or equivalent), including quarantine/error handling and validation against data contracts.
    • Define job-specific compute configurations appropriate to each workload, balancing performance and cost.
    • Contribute to and troubleshoot Terraform-managed infrastructure (networking, storage, Key Vaults, Managed DevOps Pools, Dev Centers).
    • Own and maintain Azure DevOps build and release pipelines, variable groups/libraries, and repository security, permissions and branch policies.
    • Support environment-level Azure configuration, including subscription-level access, RBAC for user and pipeline (service principal) identities, and Terraform state backend management across multiple storage accounts and environments.
    • Operate autonomously across a workstream, from scoping through to production deployment.
    • Use AI-assisted tooling to support day-to-day development, validating outputs against authoritative sources (architecture decisions, technical leads, documentation) before acting on them.
    • Communicate clearly with technical and non-technical stakeholders, including across time zones with colleagues in the UK, Americas, Middle East and Asia Pacific.

The Requirements

Essential

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Typically 6+ years in data engineering, including 3+ years hands-on with Azure Databricks in production.
  • Demonstrated ownership of medallion architecture design and data modelling.
  • Implemented data quality frameworks and data contracts in production.
  • Implemented PII protection (masking, tokenisation or access tiering) across environments.
  • Platform engineering experience: diagnosing infrastructure issues, not just consuming platform services.
  • Track record of autonomous delivery, including direct stakeholder engagement.
  • Databricks Certified Data Engineer Associate (minimum).

The Opportunity

We’re seeking an experienced, security-focused IT Infrastructure and Security Manager to oversee our internal technology infrastructure, cybersecurity operations, and external technology partnerships.

In this role, you'll manage critical IT systems, strengthen security practices, oversee technology vendors, and support cloud infrastructure initiatives. You'll work closely with Product and Technology leadership to ensure our technology environment remains secure, reliable, and efficient.

This is an ideal opportunity for someone who combines hands-on technical expertise with strong vendor management skills, enjoys solving complex challenges, and takes ownership of technology improvements.

What You’ll Do

Cybersecurity & Incident Response

  • Oversee the company's information security standards and ensure appropriate security controls are maintained

Technology Vendor Management

  • Lead vendor selection processes, including RFP development, proposal evaluations, and contract negotiations

IT Infrastructure & Cloud Management

Identity, Access & Security Compliance

  • Oversee software license assignments and access permissions
  • Manage cybersecurity insurance requirements, carrier relationships, and policy renewals
  • Coordinate with technology vendors to ensure security controls meet insurance coverage requirements

Employee IT Support & Collaboration

  • Serve as the escalation point for complex, sensitive, or security-related employee IT issues
  • Coordinate with external IT providers to ensure timely resolution of technology concerns
  • Provide direct employee IT support when first-level support is unavailable
  • Collaborate with internal teams, leadership, and vendors to support technology operations

What You Bring

  • 5+ years of progressive IT experience, including hands-on administration of Microsoft 365, Azure, networking, and endpoint management
  • Direct experience managing managed service providers (MSPs) and coordinating multiple technology vendors
  • Experience leading vendor RFP processes, evaluating proposals, and negotiating contracts
  • Strong understanding of cybersecurity practices, incident response, and information security controls

  • Experience creating and maintaining clear technical documentation
  • Strong organizational, project management, and problem-solving skills
  • Ability to communicate technical risks and solutions clearly to non-technical stakeholders and senior leadership
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities, work independently, and take ownership of projects
  • Experience with Asana or similar project management tools and standard IT service management systems
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite and the ability to learn new technology platforms
  • Experience transitioning IT operations between outsourced providers or bringing services in-house is preferred
  • Direct experience managing cybersecurity insurance renewals is preferred

Additional Details

Benefits

Senior Paid Media & Growth Strategist

Salary: £50,000–£65,000 per year (DOE)
Contract type: Full-time
Location: Remote — UK/EU hours

About our client

Our client is a digital advertising agency for high-consideration products. We help businesses with complex offerings increase their sales by combining the power of algorithms with human empathy, storytelling and style.

Our core service is Paid Media Management, which sits at the heart of our business. We also offer creative strategy and social-first content production through our in-house Creative Studio.

Spekk was named one of the UK's Top 100 Companies to Work For in 2025 by the Culture 100 Awards and recognised as one of the UK's fastest-growing paid social and creative agencies in 2026.

About the role

We are hiring a Senior Paid Media & Growth Strategist to run paid social, hands-on, for up to five premium e-commerce brands.

You will work directly with founders and C-level stakeholders, shape the strategy — not just the ads — and look beyond the ad account to identify what else may be holding growth back: the website, offer, pricing, creative, CRM or brand.

Our clients sell high-consideration products across premium homeware, tech and high-end fashion. This means that ads are rarely the only factor determining results; sometimes the blocker sits outside the paid media account.

We run accounts more like a boutique strategy consultancy than a traditional performance agency: fewer clients, more time to think, and senior colleagues who will challenge and support your work.

What you'll do

Running your accounts

  • Develop the strategy for each account directly with Spekk Partners, then own its implementation and iteration with the client.
  • Own how accounts are structured, budgeted and optimised across paid social, including Advantage+ and manual funnel campaigns.
  • Direct day-to-day execution on larger accounts and carry out some of it yourself on mid-sized accounts.
  • Plan structured tests and decide what to scale, fix or stop.
  • Read results properly, looking beyond ROAS to measurement, attribution, reach, frequency, creative fatigue and long buying journeys.

Looking beyond the ad account

  • Diagnose growth blockers outside paid media, including website, offer, pricing, CRM and brand.
  • Connect paid media spend to commercial outcomes such as margin, LTV, payback, budget scenarios and forecasts.
  • Bring new angles, tests and ideas from a 360-degree view of marketing, from funnel structure to sharper messaging.
  • Recommend spend levels that can be defended commercially.

Working with clients and creative

  • Act as the client's day-to-day lead, including regular conversations with founders and C-level stakeholders.
  • Balance brand priorities against short-term performance goals.
  • Prepare monthly reporting and recommendations that people outside paid media can understand and act on.
  • Brief our in-house Creative Studio or the client's creative team with a prioritised asset request list.
  • Analyse creative performance and recommend what to make next.

Who we're looking for

Experience

  • 5+ years running paid social professionally across several e-commerce brands, preferably in an agency environment.
  • Strong, hands-on expertise in Meta Ads Manager and performance account management.
  • A genuinely good understanding of Google Ads, including campaign types, bidding and attribution. You do not need to know every setting, but you should be able to plan, review and challenge a search strategy with confidence.
  • Experience growing premium e-commerce accounts, particularly high-end fashion, high-priced homeware or tech with long buying journeys.
  • Experience in small, fast-moving teams is a plus, particularly within an independent or boutique agency.
  • A credible understanding of the wider levers that affect paid performance, such as landing pages, pricing, email, brand, PR and influencer activity.
  • The ability to turn complex performance and creative data into clear, actionable recommendations.

Who you are

  • Naturally authoritative with clients: clear, confident and persuasive in senior-level conversations.
  • Curious and proactive, with a strong instinct for root-cause analysis.
  • Driven, with high personal standards and genuine pride in your results.
  • Resilient and open to feedback, staying calm when tests underperform or clients escalate.
  • Fluent in English (C2 or equivalent).
  • Based in the UK or EU and able to work UK/EU hours.

What you'll get

  • Premium brands and real influence over commercial decisions.
  • A genuine meritocracy, with no red tape or barriers to your development.
  • Practical AI upskilling through our Chief AI Officer and the opportunity to help shape Spekk OS, our internal AI and data system.
  • Fully remote working across the UK and EU.
  • Team trips two to three times a year, with previous destinations including Tuscany, the French Riviera, Mallorca, Austria, Lisbon and Sweden.
  • Access to Casa Spekk, our brand home in Barcelona.
  • A £500 one-off allowance for your home office setup.

As Senior Manager, Pre-Sales you support complex software sales cycles by delivering compelling product demonstrations, responding to technical and functional requirements, and building reusable pre-sales assets. You combine solid product knowledge with strong client-facing skills to accelerate pipeline conversion — working across direct client engagements, partner-supported opportunities and industry events.

What You Will Do:

Pre-sales support and solution delivery

  • Support the end-to-end pre-sales process for assigned opportunities: discovery, demos, RFP responses, solution scoping and proposal preparation.

Partner and event support

Asset development and enablement

Collaboration and reporting

  • Maintain accurate records of pre-sales activities and solution configurations; support pipeline reporting as required.
  • Participate in win/loss reviews and apply learnings to improve proposal quality and demo effectiveness.

PRODUCT AND INDUSTRY FIT

  • Ability to demonstrate ALIP end-to-end across a core scenario — new business submission, policy issue, mid-term adjustment, claim and annuity payout — tailored to the prospect's product portfolio.
  • Understanding of life and annuity product complexity: variable products, unit-linked funds, guaranteed benefit riders, with-profits smoothing and how ALIP's product factory handles each.
  • Ability to design and present a solution architecture for an ALIP implementation, including integration with distribution systems, actuarial tools, general ledger, document management and customer portals.
  • Experience engaging technical and actuarial buyers: CTO, Head of IT, Chief Actuary, Head of Product Development — able to run deep-dive workshops on data model, calculation engine and migration approach.
  • Familiarity with data migration strategy for legacy policy portfolios: extraction patterns, data quality remediation, parallel run validation and cut-over planning.
  • Understanding of IFRS 17 and Solvency II reporting requirements and how ALIP's financial engine supports compliant reporting without manual adjustment.
  • Ability to configure and demo ALIP's agentic workflow capabilities: automated underwriting rules, straight-through processing for standard cases and exception routing for complex cases.
  • Familiarity with cloud deployment patterns for ALIP on Azure and AWS, including multi-tenancy, disaster recovery, data residency and performance benchmarks for large policy books.
  • Experience scoping and running proof-of-concept engagements for core system replacements: defining the representative policy set, configuring the test environment and presenting results to an actuary-led evaluation panel.

Travel may be required for role - 0-80% depending on client and business needs

Here's What You Need:


  • Minimum 8+ years of pre-sales, solution consulting or technical sales support experience in enterprise software including a track record of contributing to complex sales opportunities, including RFP responses and solution demonstrations.
  • Minimum 8+ years of enterprise software delivery models (SaaS, license, managed services) and integration approaches.
  • Minimum 12 months of demonstrated experience supporting pre-sales for AI-native software products — solutions built on LLMs, agentic workflows or machine learning platforms — with evidence of demos delivered or RFP contributions.
  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent (minimum 12 years) work experience. (If Associate’s Degree, must have minimum 6 years work experience)

Professional Skills:

  • Experience presenting technical solutions to mid-level and C-suite stakeholders.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills; able to produce high-quality proposal content under time pressure.
  • Organized and detail-oriented; comfortable managing multiple concurrent opportunities.
  • Self-motivated and resilient; able to thrive in a fast-paced environment

Bonus Points if You have:

  • AI certifications (e.g. Microsoft AI-900/AI-102, Google Cloud Professional ML Engineer, AWS Certified ML Specialty, DeepLearning.AI specialisations) are valued.

raw.description:
JOB SUMMARY

The QA Specialist plays an integral role in the review process as they are responsible for communicating with the customer, reviewer, and management to ensure a completed report is delivered by the customer requested due date.

The QA Specialist is responsible for the timely completion and overall completeness of a reviewer report. Completeness is determined by customer requirements, company best practices, and clinical accuracy. In addition, the QA Specialist participates in improving DS processes and works with the Manager to ensure high efficiencies are achieved.

Dane Street’s success relies on individual and team contributions every day. We care for our customers, each other and Dane Street. It is the responsibility for all of us to maintain a positive working environment that promotes client satisfaction and results.

MAJOR DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES

Client Interaction

  • Provides regular report status updates to the client.
  • Evaluates the Quality of physician’s report and determines if the report will meet all client and jurisdictional standards; the QA Specialist is also responsible for ensuring that the clinical rationale supports the physician’s determinations.
  • Clarifies ambiguous report questions with clients.
  • Distribute final report back to client according to client specific requirements.
  • Receives, coordinates & executes all aspects of clarification & addendum requests from the client.
  • Participates in phone calls OR meetings with client(s) when a report is in question.
  • Follow up with the client for any missing information that is pertinent to the referral.

Physician Interaction

  • Works directly with physicians to ensure that all client questions are answered and supported by clinical rationale.
  • Conduct regular follow up with the physician or their office staff to ensure an on-time delivery of the report.
  • Compose and provide verbal or written feedback to the doctor regarding report quality.
  • Compose and provide verbal or written requests to the physician or their office staff for clarifications.
  • Receive written or verbal confirmation from the physician that a report has the doctor’s approval and ensures the doctor provides his/her signature for the final report.

Report Analysis

  • Review each physician report for data accuracy including spelling, grammar & punctuation.
  • Responsible for ensuring that all state requirements for reporting are met.
  • Responsible for report format and adhering to each client’s specific requirements.
  • Must ensure that all client special handling instructions with regard to report completion and delivery are met.

Additional Duties

  • May provide oversight to the work of the team members.
  • Continuously improves processes that help to facilitate better turnaround time, peer to peer success rates and lessens returned reports by clients for clarification purposes, ultimately resulting in higher client satisfaction.
  • Responsible for the final approval on cases for release to the client.
  • Will act as a liaison and coordinate quality issue reports along with all new reviewer reports with the VP of Clinical Operations.

Other duties & special projects, as assigned and based on business needs.

Requirements

EDUCATION/CREDENTIALS:

Associate’s or Bachelor’s Degree preferred. LPN or RN license required for this role..

JOB RELEVANT EXPERIENCE:

Business experience in a healthcare and/or insurance setting is preferred.

JOB RELATED SKILLS/COMPETENCIES:

Present exceptional communication skills with a clear understanding of company business lines. The ability to apply critical thinking, manage time efficiently and meet specific deadlines. Computer literacy and typing skills are essential.

WORKING CONDITIONS/PHYSICAL DEMANDS:

Any lifting, bending, traveling, etc. required to do the job duties listed above. Long periods of sitting and computer work.

WORK FROM HOME TECHNICAL REQUIREMENTS:

Supply and support their own internet services.

Maintaining an uninterrupted internet connection is a requirement of all work from home position.

This job description is subject to change at any time.

Benefits

Join our team at Dane Street and enjoy a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well-being and peace of mind. We offer a range of benefits including medical, dental, and vision coverage for you and your family. Additionally, we offer voluntary life insurance options for you, your spouse, and your children. We also offer other voluntary benefits which include hospital indemnity, critical illness, accident indemnity, and pet insurance plans. Employees receive basic life insurance, short-term disability, and long-term disability coverage at no cost. Our generous paid time off policy ensures you have time to relax and recharge, while our 401k plan with a company match helps you plan for your future. Apple equipment and a media stipend are provided for remote workspace.

ABOUT DANE STREET:

A fast-paced, Inc. 500 Company with a high-performance culture, is seeking insightful forward-thinking professionals. We process over 200,000 insurance claims annually for leading national and regional Workers’ Compensation, Disability, Auto, and Group Health Carriers, Third-Party Administrators, Managed Care Organizations, Employers, and Pharmacy Benefit Managers. We provide customized Independent Medical Exams and Peer Review programs that assist our clients in reaching the appropriate medical determination as part of the claims management process.

raw.title: Career Development Specialist, NVPPA
raw.excerpt: The International Rescue Committee (IRC) responds to the world's worst humanitarian crises, helping to restore health, safety, education, economic wellbeing, and power to people devastated by conflict and disaster.
raw.description:
The International Rescue Committee (IRC) responds to the world's worst humanitarian crises, helping to restore health, safety, education, economic wellbeing, and power to people devastated by conflict and disaster. Founded in 1933 at the call of Albert Einstein, the IRC is one of the world's largest international humanitarian non-governmental organizations (INGO), at work in more than 40 countries and 29 U.S. cities helping people to survive, reclaim control of their future and strengthen their communities. A force for humanity, IRC employees deliver lasting impact by restoring safety, dignity and hope to millions. If you're a solutions-driven, passionate change-maker, come join us in positively impacting the lives of millions of people world-wide for a better future.

This position is open to candidates with existing work authorization in the location where the position is advertised.

Program Background:

The National Virtual Program for Professional Advancement (NVPPA) is a nationwide, fully virtual program through which the International Rescue Committee (IRC) serves newly arrived refugees under a cooperative agreement with the Office of Refugee Resettlement (ORR). Participants receive career navigation, training, job placement support, and direct financial assistance to advance an individualized career goal. NVPPA operates alongside other federally funded programs, such as initial resettlement services and Matching Grant, and is designed to complement rather than replace or duplicate these programs.

Job Overview

The Career Development Specialist is the participant's primary point of contact in the program, working remotely with refugees across the country by phone, video, and online tools. From intake and eligibility verification through an approved Professional Advancement Plan (PAP), this position guides each participant toward their career goal, whether that means finding a training partner, completing credential evaluation and recertification, or moving forward with an approved vehicle purchase. The role coordinates closely with the Economic Empowerment Technical Unit, administrative and job development staff, and external resettlement partners to ensure participants move smoothly between services, while maintaining accurate case records and documentation in Efforts to Outcomes (ETO) in line with ORR reporting requirements and IRC financial controls.


Major responsibilities:

Outreach and Intake

  • Conduct virtual outreach, intake, and enrollment for eligible participants, including verifying eligibility documentation.
  • Coordinate with IRC offices, resettlement agencies, and local partners to identify and connect with eligible participants.

Career Navigation

  • Complete a skills assessment with each participant and develop an individualized Professional Advancement Plan (PAP) that defines their career goal, pathway, and planned use of direct financial assistance.
  • Review the PAP with each participant, provide feedback on the career goal, and confirm that proposed use of funds meets ORR eligible-use requirements.
  • Provide ongoing navigation by phone and video to help participants access training, credential evaluation and recertification, and other approved supports.

Position Title: IoT Engineer - Special Projects & Innovation

Position Location: Remote - work virtually from anywhere in the United States, with travel to job sites and lab environments

JOB SUMMARY

Smart Tech Contracting delivers turnkey BAS & EPMS solutions for mission-critical colocation and hyperscale data centers operating at national program scale. As a Master Systems Integrator (MSI), we unify controls construction (DDC, PLC, SCADA) with software engineering, optimized graphics / UI standards, and program-level governance. The Special Projects & Innovation (SPI) group is where we pursue the ideas that do not fit inside a standard project: rapid proofs of concept, emerging technology evaluations, and first-of-their-kind monitoring and analytics platforms for critical facilities.

As a IoT Engineer - Special Projects & Innovation you will architect, build, and deliver the connected systems behind SPI initiatives, from the field instrumentation and edge infrastructure behind AI-enabled data center monitoring to IoT sensor networks that stand up in the field in hours. You will take initiatives from whiteboard concept through lab prototype to field pilot, working across the physical stack: sensors and instrumentation, gateways and edge compute, industrial networks and protocols, controls integration, and the monitoring platforms they feed.

The IoT Engineer - Special Projects & Innovation will receive limited direction on day-to-day work and general instruction on new projects, tasks or assignments. Will execute and assist team leadership on projects, tasks or assignments of complex scope. Will work independently or under limited supervision.

This person will communicate and operate in line with organizational goals and values, as well as departmental objectives.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS

IoT Systems Design and Prototyping (40%)

  • Architect end-to-end IoT systems: sensor selection, gateway and edge compute design, network topology, and device-to-platform data flows
  • Select, configure, and commission sensors, gateways, and edge devices supporting rapid proof-of-concept and pilot deployments
  • Stand up wireless and wired sensing networks and validate data quality end to end, from device to dashboard
  • Configure HMIs, dashboards, and alarming on established monitoring platforms and visualization tools

Research and Feasibility (20%)

  • Ingest and evaluate unique initiatives; research and compare hardware and software solution options
  • Develop system architecture diagrams using UML (ISO/IEC 19501)
  • Estimate budgets using BOMs, parts lists, resource options, schedules, and human resource requirements

Implementation and Integration (20%)

  • Build and test physical systems in lab environments, including sensors, gateways, network equipment, edge compute, and controls hardware
  • Travel to job sites to assist with site surveys, system integration, and field pilots
  • Connect devices and systems using industrial and network protocols (Modbus, BACnet/IP, MQTT, OPC UA, LoRaWAN)

Documentation, Reporting, and Lifecycle (10%)

  • Draft summary reports and present during regular project updates
  • Document solutions for product delivery and facilitate handoff of mature initiatives to long-term owners
  • Support project postmortems and lessons-learned reviews for continuous program improvement

Technology, Digital Tools & AI-Enabled Efficiency (10%)

  • Leverage AI-enabled and digital tools to enhance efficiency, reduce manual effort, and support consistent, high-quality work output.
  • Identify opportunities to improve processes and demonstrate a continuous learning mindset, seeking out new technologies, skills, and methods that elevate individual and team performance.
  • Adapt to emerging technologies and evolving digital workflows, actively supporting the integration and adoption of innovative tools across the organization.
  • Completion of Assigned Tasks and Deliverables on Time and on Budget
  • Performs Other Related Duties as Assigned

Completion of assigned tasks and deliverables on time with strong attention to detail

Performs Other Related Duties as Assigned

POSITION REQUIREMENTS (INTERMEDIATE LEVEL FOR ALL THE FOLLOWING)

  • IoT system architecture: end-to-end design of sensing, gateway, edge compute, and device-to-platform data flows
  • Scripting (Python preferred) sufficient to configure devices, transform sensor data, and automate routine tasks
  • Systems integration using standard protocols: Modbus, BACnet/IP, MQTT (Sparkplug B), OPC UA, and LoRaWAN
  • Network fundamentals: TCP/IP, HTTP/REST, routing, VLANs, VPNs, and multi-WAN connectivity
  • Hands-on experience with SCADA / BAS / controls platforms (DDC, PLC), including field devices, wiring, and point integration
  • Sensing and instrumentation: selecting, installing, and calibrating sensors (temperature, humidity, power, pressure, vibration) and validating their data
  • System architecture diagramming using tools such as draw.io or Lucidchart
  • Workflow automation software such as n8n or Microsoft Power Automate
  • Source control (Git), ticketing (Jira/Azure DevOps), basic Linux/Windows server admin
  • Controls wiring and hands-on hardware prototyping in lab environments
  • Knowledge of VLANs, LANs, VPNs and RSTP
  • Knowledge of IoT and smart building solutions
  • Skilled at using MS Office Suite (Excel, Word, Outlook, PowerPoint, Teams), knowledge of file management
  • Ability to work successfully in a remote environment through effective communication and organizational skills, self-motivation, proactiveness and resourcefulness in a distraction free workspace
  • Ability to follow company and site safety requirements
  • Ability to leverage AI and emerging technologies to streamline workflows, optimize operational processes, and contribute to company-wide innovation
  • Ability to analyze and prepare documents, reports and correspondence
  • Ability to communicate effectively in both oral and written form (technical and non-technical information)
  • Ability to communicate effectively directly with stakeholders and at times serve as primary point of client contact
  • Ability to work successfully as a member of a team and independently with moderate supervision
  • Ability to work under pressure and meet close deadlines
  • Ability to effectively plan and delegate the work of others
  • Ability to achieve certification for NFPA70E and / or OSHA training as / if required
  • Organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple tasks simultaneously

PHYSICAL DEMANDS

The following physical demands must be met by the employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is

  • Frequently manipulating, moving or grasping small parts, devices or tools
  • Frequently required to remain in a stationary position
  • Frequently moving through office, critical facility and other environments (such as low temperatures, high temperatures and outdoor elements such as precipitation and wind), including tight and confined spaces
  • Frequently descending / ascending stairs and ladders to access equipment
  • On occasion the employee may be required to position self under or over equipment
  • On occasion the employee may move equipment weighing up to 50 pounds

TRAVEL / RELOCATION REQUIREMENTS

EDUCATION / EXPERIENCE REQUIREMENTS

PLUS

raw.description:
About ACLED:

Armed Conflict Location & Event Data (ACLED) is an independent, impartial conflict and protest monitoring organization providing real-time data and analysis on violent conflict and protest in all countries and territories across the world.

The consultancy opportunity:

ACLED is looking for a Iraq Researcher to assist in the collection, review and management of political violence and protest data across Iraq. Researchers must be available for a minimum of 25hours per week. This opportunity is fully remote and can be done from any location with reliable internet service.

This is an entry-level, independent consultant opportunity, and may require submissions mid-week and on weekends.

This opportunity is open to nationals of any country. For more information, please review the Applicant FAQs.

Collection of data is conducted by reviewing news, international organization, NGO and security reports on a list of assigned countries, and recording the incidents of political violence into an Excel template. Researchers will focus on coding events to provide holistic coverage of current political violence, ranging from protests to battles.

Review and management of data involves ensuring the quality, consistency and reliability of the data produced. The researcher provides team members with experience conducting detail-oriented tasks, and producing and managing quantitative data.

Please note that this opportunity involves working with conflict-related media and reading about violent events.

Specific deliverables:

Candidates who are selected will undergo extensive ACLED training. The training consists of several exercises. Candidates' exercises will be scrutinized and only those who are delivering at the required level will be retained as Researchers.

For those selected, the initial consultancy period will be from November 2026 to June 2027. After this, continuation may be possible, pending evaluation of quality of deliverables and availability of funding.

Remuneration:

Remuneration is 20 USD per hour.

Skills and competencies:

ACLED is seeking applicants who have the following skills and experience:

  • Familiarity with Excel (essential);

About SiTime

SiTime is the Precision Timing company.

Timing is the heartbeat of all electronics, ensuring performance, resilience and scalability. For decades, quartz devices, non-silicon technology, have kept systems in sync, but they struggle in harsher, more demanding environments. MEMS-based Precision Timing delivers greater accuracy, smaller size and resilience. Today, MEMS timing powers over 400 applications, including high-growth ones in AI datacenters, automated driving, industrial and humanoid robots, wearables and IoT.

Our semiconductor MEMS programmable solutions offer a rich feature set that enables customers to differentiate their products with higher performance, smaller size, lower power, and better reliability. With more than 4 billion devices shipped, SiTime is changing the timing industry. For more information, visit: www.sitime.com.

Job Summary:

  • We are looking for a qualified Senior Sales Manager to join our team, based in Korea. This role combines direct ownership of assigned accounts and channel management with full responsibility for the region’s growth strategy and market expansion. You will be accountable for building a scalable, long-term growth plan while executing with the discipline and agility required to disrupt the timing market and over-achieve business objectives.
  • It is not necessary to meet all job requirements to be a qualified candidate for the position.

Responsibilities:

  • Sales – Primary responsibility is to generate revenue and increase market share by identifying and winning prospective accounts through research and networking. Activities include program management, account development, and establishing and maintaining key relationships for new and existing accounts. Meet assigned revenue and profitability targets.
  • Account Management – Maintain relationships for new and existing accounts in order to protect and grow existing business. Develop key account plans that align internal resources to major customer opportunities. Ability to engage with senior-level engagement at accounts and navigate complex commercial terms to unblock design-in opportunities.
  • Channel Development – Manage and motivate distribution partners. Implement KPIs, conduct regular business reviews, and ensure the distributor sales force is technically proficient in SiTime products.
  • OEM Engagement – Build and maintain direct, on-the-ground relationships.
  • Product – Identify requirements for new products. Work with Marketing, Design Engineering, Manufacturing, and R&D to support new product development initiatives targeted to the needs of key accounts, particularly in clocking and timing.
  • Operational Excellence – Generate both short-term and long-term rolling forecasts for revenue and product/volume mix with high accuracy.
  • Marketing Communications – Provide input to the marketing group to support the development and execution of promotional, advertising, and communication strategies for key markets or applications.
  • Competition – Benchmark our products against the competition from both a technical and business perspective. Monitor competitive TAM and identify opportunities to grow share.

Qualifications & Requirements:

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or a related technical field.
  • Experience: 10+ years experience in semiconductor sales.
  • Industry Knowledge: Deep understanding of the Korean semiconductor market, specifically within the timing and analog sectors.
  • Channel Management: Proven experience working through distribution channels.
  • Communication: Excellent verbal and written communication skills in both Korean and English are mandatory to bridge the gap between local customers and US-based HQ teams.

Desired Characteristics & Attributes:

  • Accountable: Ability to acknowledge failures, make changes, and take responsibility for revenue results.
  • Resilience: The ability to overcome obstacles and difficult situations day in and day out by using logic or intuition to understand customer rejections, and then adjusting their strategy accordingly.
  • Curiosity: Possesses a certain humility to ask questions and actively seek out new information or verify existing assumptions.
  • Collaborative: Works seamlessly with global cross-functional teams and channel partners to deliver superior customer support and operational alignment.

Compensation:

At SiTime, we believe great work deserves great rewards. We offer a comprehensive and highly competitive compensation package designed to attract top talent.

In addition to base salary, this role is eligible for the Sales Commission Plan, paid out quarterly based on achievement of sales objectives and goals. We also offer equity grants, providing a meaningful opportunity to share in the company’s future growth and success.

SiTime is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We treat each person fairly and we do not tolerate discrimination or harassment against anyone on the basis of any protected characteristics, including race, color, religion, national or ethnic origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, disability, pregnancy, political affiliation, protected veteran status, protected genetic information, or marital status or other characteristics protected by law. SiTime participates in the E-Verify program.

raw.description:
Company Details

Berkley Medical Management Solutions (BMMS) provides a different kind of managed-care service for W.R. Berkley Corporation. We believe focusing on an injured worker’s successful and speedy return to work is good for people and good for Berkley’s insurance operating units. BMMS was first started in 2014 by reimagining the relationship between medical need and technology to deliver the best outcome for injured workers and Berkley’s operating units. Our goal was clear: combine solid clinical practices, proven return-to-work strategies and robust software into one system for seamless management of workers’ compensation cases.

To get it right, we started with a flexible technology platform that allowed for impressive customization without sacrificing the ability for expansion and continued innovation. We deploy integrated systems to give W.R. Berkley Companies recommendations and professional services for managing each individual case in an efficient and appropriate manner. The power of our technology takes medical bill-review services and clinical advisory services to a new level. Our unique marriage of technology, software platforms, data analytics and professional services ensures we provide Berkley’s operating units with reliable results, and reduced time and expenses associated with case management.

Responsibilities

As a Telephonic Nurse Case Manager, you will assess, plan, coordinate, monitor, evaluate and implement options and services to facilitate timely medical care and return to work outcomes of injured workers.

  • Coordinate and implement medical case management to facilitate case closure
  • Timely and comprehensive communication with with employers, adjusters and the injured workers.
  • Assess appropriate utilization of medical treatment and services available through contact with physicians and other specialist to ensure cost effective quality care
  • Review and analyze medical records and assess data to ensure appropriate case management process occurs while providing recommendations to achieve case progress and movement to closure
  • Responsible for assigned caseloads, which may vary in numbers, territory and/or by state jurisdiction
  • Acquire and maintain nursing licensure for all jurisdictions as business needs require
  • Coordinate services to include home services, durable medical equipment, IMEs, admissions, discharges, and vocational services when appropriate and evaluate cost effectiveness and quality of services
  • Document activities and case progress using appropriate methods and tools following best practices for quality improvement
  • Reviewing job analysis/job description with all providers to coordinate and implement disability case management. This includes coordinating job analysis with employer to facilitate return to work.
  • Engage and participate in special projects as assigned by case management leadership team
  • Occasionally attend on site meetings and professional programs
  • Foster a teamwork environment
  • Maintaining and updating evidence based medical guidelines (such as Official Disability Guidelines, MD Guidelines and all required state regulated guidelines) in reference to the injured worker treatment plan and work status.
  • Obtain and maintain applicable state certifications and/or licensures in the state where job duties are performed.
  • Obtain case management professional certification (CCM) within 2 years of hire date
  • Earn Continuing Education Units to maintain certifications and licensures

Qualifications

  • Minimum 2 years of experience in workers compensation insurance and medical case management preferred
  • Ability to work Pacific Standard Time business hours
  • California RN license greatly preferred
  • Minimum of 4 years medical/surgical clinical experience required
  • Exhibit strong communication skills, professionalism, flexibility and adaptability
  • Possess working knowledge of medical and vocational resources available to the Workers’ Compensation industry
  • Demonstrate evidence of self-motivation and the ability to perform case management duties independently
  • Demonstrate evidence of computer and technology skills
  • Oral and written fluency in both Spanish and English a plus

Education

  • Graduate of an accredited school of nursing and possess a current RN license.
  • *RN compact license preferred, CCM preferred, Bachelor of Nursing preferred*

Additional Company Details

The Company is an equal employment opportunity employer. Important Outside Agency Notice: Only solicited resumes/candidate profiles that are submitted by a Berkley Preferred Agency Partner that have been requested by Berkley Internal Recruiting to engage in a particular search will be subject to the payment of Agency fees as defined in the formal agency agreement. Any unsolicited resumes/candidate profiles are not subject to payment of the agency fees. The company offers a competitive compensation plan and robust benefits package for full time regular employees • Salary Range: 83k - 88k • Benefits: Health, Dental, Vision, Life, Disability, Wellness, Paid Time Off, 401(k) and Profit-Sharing plans. The actual salary for this position will be determined by a number of factors, including the scope, complexity and location of the role; the skills, education, training, credentials and experience of the candidate; and other conditions of employment.

Additional Requirements

Domestic U.S. travel required (up to 10% of time)

raw.description:
Position Overview

Power your future with Qualus as a Senior Consultant - Transmission Planning supporting our Resource Integration Advisory group with a primary focus on performing interconnection feasibility studies for new generation, storage, demand, and transmission projects.

Responsibilities

  • Perform Interconnection feasibility studies for new generation, storage, demand and transmission projects.
  • Optimize the size and location of new generation, storage, demand and transmission projects.
  • Prepare interconnection applications for new generation, storage, demand and transmission projects including development of power flow, dynamic and short circuit study models.
  • Guide generation, storage, demand and transmission interconnection applications through the full interconnection study process.
  • Interface with the host transmission operator throughout the interconnection study process and review and scrutinize their interconnection study reports.
  • Perform general power system studies.

Minimum Qualifications

  • BS Degree in Electrical Engineering with emphasis on Electrical Power Systems
  • 5 years of grid planning experience. 3 years in North America.
  • 2 years of consulting experience
  • MS Degree in Electrical Engineering with emphasis in Electrical Power Systems is preferred.
  • Intimate knowledge of the PSSE and/or PSLF power systems analysis tools and their associated models and utilities
  • Knowledge of transmission systems in Eastern Interconnection, ERCOT and/or WECC
  • Extensive experience with power system studies
  • Experience with resource interconnection studies in Eastern Interconnection, ERCOT, or WECC
  • Experience with generation delivery assessment in RTO service territories, particularly CAISO, using TARA very highly valued.
  • Familiarity with EMT modeling using PSCAD for protection, control interaction, or IBR-focused studies (strongly preferred)

Benefits & Compensation

Qualus offers a competitive benefits package for eligible employees, which may include Medical, Dental, Vision, Life Insurance, Short- and Long-Term Disability coverage, Retirement Savings Plans (including employer matching where applicable), Flexible Spending and/or Health Spending Accounts, Employee Assistance Programs (EAP), Parental Leave, Paid Time Off, and Company Holidays. Benefits offerings may vary based on position, work location, and eligibility requirements. The compensation range for this position is provided in accordance with applicable laws and market practices. The final base salary offered may vary based on factors including, but not limited to, education, qualifications, certifications, experience, skills, seniority, geographic location, internal equity, performance, and business needs. Compensation ranges are subject to change at the Company's discretion and as permitted by applicable law.

Company Overview

Qualus is a leading pure-play power solutions firm and innovator at the forefront of power infrastructure transformation, with differentiated capabilities across grid modernization, resiliency, security, and sustainability. The firm partners with utilities, commercial, industrial, data center, and government clients, and renewable and energy storage developers, offering comprehensive solutions through boutique and integrated advisory, planning, engineering, digital solutions, program management, energy efficiency and specialized field services. Qualus also provides software and technology enabled services and develops breakthrough solutions for critical power industry challenges such as distributed and variable resource integration, emergency management, and secure data exchange. The firm has over 2,000 professionals, with offices throughout the U.S. and Canada.

Equal Opportunity Employer

We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity. We are committed to providing an inclusive workplace and do not discriminate on any grounds protected by applicable human rights legislation across Canada and the US.

We are committed to a secure and transparent hiring process. We do not request payment or sensitive personal information, such as Social Security numbers or banking details, during the application process. Please use caution and verify opportunities through our official channels.
