raw.excerpt: About PhorestPhorest started in 2002 on a busy salon reception desk as a simple text-reminder tool.
raw.description:
About Phorest

Phorest started in 2002 on a busy salon reception desk as a simple text-reminder tool.

Today, Phorest builds software and AI-powered tools used by more than 155,000 hair, beauty, and medspa professionals worldwide. We're a product-led SaaS company solving real-world problems across bookings, payments, marketing, and business management, with a big focus on building great experiences for both the businesses we serve and the people who use our products. Everything we build helps the salon and medspa industry thrive.

We're also a Certified B Corp, and 25% of the company is owned by Phoresters. When the company grows, everyone has a stake in that.

The Opportunity

We're building something exciting at Phorest. With an established presence in the hair and beauty industry, we're now investing in our next big growth opportunity: the North American medspa market.

We're looking for a commercially driven, entrepreneurial Account Executive – MedSpa to help us grow our presence, build relationships, and turn opportunities into long-term customers.

You'll own the full sales cycle, from qualifying leads generated through Marketing, Partnerships, and industry events to delivering engaging product demos, negotiating, and closing deals. You'll also get out into the medspa community, attending conferences and events across the US to build relationships and establish Phorest as a trusted technology partner.

This is an opportunity to help shape our sales approach in a growing market. We're looking for a self-starter who's curious, resilient, and comfortable working without an established playbook. Someone who learns quickly, takes ownership, and isn't afraid to test new ideas.

If you're excited by the opportunity to build something, make a real impact, and help drive Phorest's next phase of growth, we'd love to hear from you.

What You'll Do

Own the sales journey from start to finish

  • Manage the full sales cycle, from qualifying inbound, partner-sourced, and event-generated leads through discovery, product demonstrations, negotiations, and closing new business.

  • Build and maintain a healthy pipeline of opportunities, prioritizing established, multi-provider medspas that align with Phorest's ideal customer profile.

  • Respond promptly to new leads, understand their needs and buying timelines, and guide prospects through a thoughtful, consultative sales process.

  • Take ownership of your sales performance, consistently working toward monthly, quarterly, and annual recurring revenue targets.

  • Identify opportunities to improve conversion rates, strengthen pipeline performance, and create a positive experience for prospective customers.

Deliver engaging, consultative sales experiences

  • Lead discovery conversations with medspa owners, operators, clinicians, and practice leaders to understand their business models, challenges, and growth ambitions.

  • Deliver compelling, tailored product demonstrations that show how Phorest can help medspa businesses improve efficiency, build client loyalty, and drive growth.

  • Translate technical product capabilities into clear, relevant business benefits that resonate with different decision-makers.

  • Confidently navigate objections, competitive comparisons, and commercial negotiations to build trust and close deals.

  • Position Phorest as more than just software, demonstrating how we can be a valuable technology and growth partner.

Build relationships within the medspa community

  • Represent Phorest at medspa conferences, trade shows, partner events, and industry gatherings across the US.

  • Build meaningful relationships with prospective customers, industry professionals, and partners to strengthen our presence and credibility in the market.

  • Work closely with Marketing and Partnerships to maximize opportunities generated through events, campaigns, and partner relationships.

  • Follow up on event and partner-sourced leads, turning initial conversations into qualified opportunities and new customers.

  • Bring insights from industry events and customer conversations back into the business to help shape our sales and marketing approach.

Collaborate and help shape our approach

  • Partner closely with our MedSpa Marketing, Partnerships, Customer Success, and Product teams to deliver a seamless experience from initial engagement through onboarding.

  • Share insights on customer needs, market trends, competitor activity, and lead quality to help refine how we position and sell Phorest.

  • Work with our Partner Development team to maximize partner-sourced opportunities and build strong relationships across the medspa ecosystem.

  • Ensure smooth customer handovers by maintaining accurate information and clear communication with our onboarding teams.

raw.description:
D-Wave Quantum Inc. (NASDAQ: QBTS)is a leader in the development and delivery of quantum computing systems, software, and services. It is the world’s first commercial supplier of quantum computers, and the first and only to offer dual-platform quantum computing products and services, spanning both annealing and gate-model quantum computing technologies. D-Wave’s mission is to help customers realize the value of quantum today through enterprise-grade systems available on-premises and via its Leap™ quantum cloud service, which offers 99.9% availability and uptime. More than 100 organizations across commercial, government, and research sectors trust D-Wave to address complex computational challenges using quantum computing. Learn more about realizing the value of quantum computing today and how D-Wave is shaping the quantum-driven industrial and societal advancements of tomorrow: .

About the role

The VP, Global HR Operations will lead the evolution of the Company's global HR operation model, ensuring HR operations, technology, governance, and service delivery scale effectively as the business grows globally.

Building on a strong foundation, this leader will modernize HR through technology, process simplification, strong governance, and operational excellence, delivering a seamless employee experience across the global workforce.

As a member of the HR Leadership Team, you will partner closely with HR, Finance, Legal, IT, Payroll, and business leaders to align HR operations, technology, and service delivery with enterprise priorities.

This is a hands-on leadership role requiring both strategic thinking and execution. The successful candidate will be an experienced builder who has led HR operations at scale and can pragmatically implement leading practices in a lean, high-growth environment.

What you'll do

Advance the Global HR Operating Model

  • Define and execute the global HR Operations strategy aligned with business priorities.
  • Evolve the HR operating model, governance, and service delivery to support a growing global workforce.
  • Lead operational readiness for global expansion, acquisitions, reorganizations, and other strategic initiatives.
  • Drive continuous improvement, standardization, and operational excellence across HR.

Lead HR Technology & Operations

  • Own the roadmap for the HR technology ecosystem, including HRIS and supporting platforms.
  • Drive automation, AI adoption, self-service, and process improvements that enhance efficiency and employee experience.
  • Partner with IT, Finance, and Payroll to deliver integrated systems, reliable people data, and actionable analytics.
  • Ensure strong governance of HR systems, employee data, reporting, security, and compliance.

Deliver Exceptional Employee Services

  • Lead global employee lifecycle operations, including onboarding, internal mobility, immigration, leaves, relocations, and offboarding.
  • Standardize global processes while ensuring compliance with local employment requirements.
  • Continuously improve HR service delivery for employees and managers.

Strengthen Governance & Enterprise Execution

  • Ensure compliant HR operations globally through strong partnerships with Legal, Finance, Payroll, IT, Security, and external providers.
  • Maintain audit readiness, operational controls, and oversight of HR data and transactions.
  • Lead cross-functional initiatives that improve organizational effectiveness and champion the responsible use of AI across HR.

Build a High-Performing Team

  • Lead, develop, and inspire a high-performing global HR Operations team.
  • Establish clear priorities, service standards, metrics, and accountability.
  • Balance strategic leadership with hands-on execution to deliver measurable business outcomes.

About You

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience; advanced degree preferred.
  • 12+ years of progressive HR experience, including 5+ years leading global HR Operations, HR technology, HRIS, or shared services in complex multinational organizations.
  • Proven success building and scaling global HR operating models and transforming HR service delivery in high-growth environments.
  • Deep expertise in global HR operations, compliance, governance, workforce administration, data privacy, and HR technology.
  • Demonstrated experience leading HR technology strategy, HRIS modernization, automation, AI, and digital transformation initiatives.
  • Experience leading global teams and supporting employees across multiple countries and employment models.
  • Strong executive partnership and influence across HR, IT, Finance, Legal, Payroll, and business leaders.
  • Experience managing enterprise HR technology portfolios, strategic vendors, and operational budgets.
  • Experience supporting global expansion, acquisitions, organizational change, or business transformation is preferred.
  • Experience in technology, software, deep tech, or other high-growth global organizations is preferred.

A D-Waver's DNA

  • We look at the future and say “why not”; we see possibilities where others see problems or routines. We show the way ahead and are committed to achieving ambitious goals.
  • We practice straight talk and listen generously to each other with empathy. We value different opinions and points of views. We ensure that we connect outside as well as inside to learn from others and inspire each other.
  • We hold ourselves accountable for delivering results. We make decisions & take responsibility so that we can act & support each other.
  • As leaders we motivate & engage our teams to undertake beyond what they originally thought possible, by developing our teams & creating the conditions for people to grow and empower themselves through enabling & coaching.

Our Compensation Philosophy is Simple but Powerful:

We believe providing D-Wavers with company ownership, competitive pay, and a range of meaningful benefits is the start of creating a culture where people want to give the best they’ve got — not because they’re simply making money, but because they’ve fallen in love with our vision, mission, values, and team.

During the interview process, your Recruiter will review our total rewards (base, equity, bonus, perks, benefit, culture) . The final offer is determined by your proficiencies within this level.

Inclusion:

We celebrate diverse perspectives to drive innovation in our pursuit. Our employees range from distinguished domain experts with decades of experience in their respective fields, to bright and motivated graduates eager to make their mark. Our diverse and innovative team will make you feel appreciated, supported and empower your career growth at D-Wave.

The Fine Print:

No 3rd party candidates will be accepted

It is D-Wave Systems Inc. policy to provide equal employment opportunity (EEO) to all persons regardless of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, genetic information, physical or mental disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state/provincial, local law.

Job seekers should be aware of fraudulent job offers from online scammers and only apply to roles listed on D-Wave Careers site using our applicant system. Note: We do not use text messaging or third-party messaging apps to communicate with applicants and will never ask for fees or financial commitment, so please exercise caution if you are approached in this way. Authentic communications will come from an @dwavesys.com email.

For more information, please read our full Statement Regarding Job Recruiting Fraud Scams.

The base pay range for this role is:

$206,000 - 290,000 USD per year

What you'll do

raw.description:
Peraton Overview

Peraton is a next-generation national security company that drives missions of consequence spanning the globe and extending to the farthest reaches of the galaxy. As the world’s leading mission capability integrator and transformative enterprise IT provider, we deliver trusted, highly differentiated solutions and technologies to protect our nation and allies. Peraton operates at the critical nexus between traditional and nontraditional threats across all domains: land, sea, space, air, and cyberspace. The company serves as a valued partner to essential government agencies and supports every branch of the U.S. armed forces. Each day, our employees do the can’t be done by solving the most daunting challenges facing our customers. Visit peraton.com to learn how we’re keeping people around the world safe and secure.

Responsibilities

Peraton is seeking a Penetration Testing Lead to join our Team. This person will be responsible for leading and executing comprehensive offensive security assessments to identify, validate, and help remediate security vulnerabilities across the organization’s applications, infrastructure, networks, cloud environments, and systems. This role provides technical leadership for penetration testing activities, develops testing strategies and methodologies, and oversees the delivery of high-quality security assessments aligned with industry best practices and organizational risk management objectives.

Work Location: This is a remote position, but candidate must be willing to work during the hours of 8am - 5pm EST

What You Will Do:

  • Lead and execute penetration testing assessments across network infrastructure, applications, APIs, and AWS cloud environments to identify, validate, and assess security vulnerabilities.
  • Plan and conduct red team exercises to simulate real-world adversary tactics, techniques, and procedures and evaluate the organization’s ability to detect and respond to threats.
  • Apply industry-recognized testing methodologies and standards, including NIST SP 800-115, MITRE ATT&CK, and DHS Risk and Vulnerability Assessment (RVA) standards, to ensure consistent and comprehensive security assessments.
  • Analyze testing results, validate findings, assess potential business impact, and provide actionable, risk-based remediation recommendations to technical teams and stakeholders.
  • Maintain, configure, and optimize penetration testing tools, frameworks, and supporting technologies to support effective and efficient security assessments.
  • Collaborate with security, cloud, application development, and infrastructure teams to communicate findings, support remediation efforts, and improve the organization’s overall security posture.
  • Mentor and provide technical guidance to junior penetration testers, fostering technical growth, knowledge sharing, and adherence to established testing methodologies and best practices.
  • Continuously evaluate emerging attack techniques, vulnerabilities, and offensive security tools to enhance penetration testing capabilities and address evolving threats.

Qualifications

Basic Qualifications:

  • Must be a U.S. Citizen with the ability to obtain and maintain the required Public Trust level clearance
  • Bachelors Degree and 12 years of experience, a Masters Degree and 10 years of experience, an Associates Degree and 14 years, or a High School Diploma or equivalent and 16 years of experience
  • One (or more) of the following certifications: OSCP, OSCE, GXPN or CEH
  • Demonstrated experience conducting penetration testing across network infrastructure, web applications, APIs, and AWS cloud environments.
  • Experience planning and executing red team exercises, adversary emulation, and attack simulations to identify security weaknesses and evaluate defensive capabilities.
  • Working knowledge of established penetration testing methodologies and security frameworks, including NIST SP 800-115, MITRE ATT&CK, and Department of Homeland Security (DHS) Risk and Vulnerability Assessment (RVA) standards.
  • Experience configuring, maintaining, and optimizing penetration testing tools, frameworks, and automated security validation platforms.
  • Ability to identify and validate vulnerabilities, assess risk and potential business impact, and communicate actionable remediation recommendations to technical teams and stakeholders.
  • Experience mentoring junior penetration testers, providing technical guidance, and promoting adherence to testing methodologies and security best practices.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and technical documentation skills, with the ability to translate complex security findings into clear, actionable recommendations.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience with automated penetration testing and security validation platforms such as Pentera, Cymulate, Picus Security, Intruder, or similar

Target Salary Range

$104,000 - $166,000. This represents the typical salary range for this position. Salary is determined by various factors, including but not limited to, the scope and responsibilities of the position, the individual’s experience, education, knowledge, skills, and competencies, as well as geographic location and business and contract considerations. Depending on the position, employees may be eligible for overtime, shift differential, and a discretionary bonus in addition to base pay.

Benefits Statement

Peraton offers eligible employees a variety of benefits including medical, dental, vision, life, health savings account, short/long term disability, EAP, parental leave, 401(k), paid time off (PTO) for vacation, and company paid holidays. A full listing of available benefits can be viewed at

The application period for the job is estimated to be 30 days from the job posting date. However, this timeline may be shortened or extended depending on business needs and the availability of qualified candidates. By applying to this job, you are expressing interest in the role and the Company. Use of artificial intelligence (AI) tools of any kind during Peraton interviews is strictly prohibited unless the candidate has obtained prior written authorization. All interview responses must be the candidate’s own.

EEO: Equal opportunity employer, including disability and protected veterans, or other characteristics protected by law.

What's in it for You Financial Wellbeing Compensation $175K-$200K / year, commensurate with experience commensurate with experience Competitive pay with ongoing performance review and merit increase 401(k) with company match & Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP) Flexible spending account (Healthcare & Dependent care) Health & Wellness Medical, Dental, and Vision insurance (plan choice) - coverage for spouse, domestic partner, and children Diabetes Management, Telehealth Coverage, Prescription Drug Plan, Pet Insurance, Weight Management Drug Discount Discounted National Gym Membership Network Family & Lifestyle Paid Time Off, Paid Holidays, Bereavement Leave Military Leave, including Benefits Continuation Employee Assistance Program Planning for the Unexpected Short and long-term disability, life insurance, and accidental death & dismemberment Voluntary life insurance, accident, critical illness, hospital indemnity coverage Emergency Travel Assistance Program Group legal plan Position may be subject to pre-employment screening, which may include background check and drug testing. Accessibility: If you need accommodation as part of the employment process, contact . Due to the high volume of applications received, we are unable to respond to individual requests regarding application status. Please log into your candidate profile for up-to-date information. MasTec, Inc. is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer. The Company's policy is not to unlawfully discriminate against any applicant or employee on the basis of race, color, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, religion, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, military status, or any other consideration made unlawful by applicable federal, state, or local laws. The Company also prohibits harassment of applicants and employees based on any of these protected categories. It is also MasTec's policy to comply with all applicable state, federal and local laws respecting consideration of unemployment status in making hiring decisions. Disclaimer: MasTec and our Subsidiaries will never ask prospective employees for any form of payment or money transfer as part of job application or onboarding. We do not ask prospective employees for information about credit cards or personal passwords, and it does not require applicants to purchase equipment or software. Ensure that all recruiter email addresses end in @mastec.com or @talent.icims.com. If you suspect you are the target of a scam, we advise you to contact your local law enforcement agency and report fraud at MasTec Clean Energy & Infrastructure and our subsidiaries do not work with any third-party recruiters or agencies without a valid signed agreement and partnership with the Corporate Talent Acquisition Team.

raw.description:
About Phorest

Phorest started in 2002 on a busy salon reception desk as a simple text-reminder tool.

Today, Phorest builds software and AI-powered tools used by more than 155,000 hair, beauty, and medspa professionals worldwide. We're a product-led SaaS company solving real-world problems across bookings, payments, marketing, and business management, with a big focus on building great experiences for both the businesses we serve and the people who use our products. Everything we build helps the salon and medspa industry thrive.

We're also a Certified B Corp, and 25% of the company is owned by Phoresters. When the company grows, everyone has a stake in that.

The Opportunity

We're growing our presence in the North American medspa market, and we're looking for a creative, organized, and proactive Events Executive – MedSpa to help bring our marketing plans to life.

This is an exciting opportunity to be part of a growing area of Phorest's business, helping us build relationships, create awareness, and connect with medspa owners and operators across the US.

You'll play a key role in planning and delivering industry conferences, trade shows, partner events, and other marketing activities that help build Phorest's presence in the medspa community. Alongside events, you'll also support marketing campaigns, content, partnerships, and lead generation initiatives.

Working closely with our Marketing, Sales, and Partnerships teams, you'll help ensure we're showing up in the right places, reaching the right audiences, and creating meaningful opportunities for Phorest to grow.

We're looking for someone who enjoys variety, loves getting into the details, and takes pride in making things happen. You'll be comfortable coordinating everything from event logistics and vendor relationships to on-site execution, while bringing fresh ideas and enthusiasm to a growing area of our business.

What You'll Do

Bring our events and partnerships to life

  • Help plan and deliver medspa conferences, trade shows, webinars, partner events, and regional marketing activities.

  • Coordinate end-to-end event logistics, including materials, shipping, scheduling, vendor communication, setup, and on-site execution.

  • Work with industry partners, including skincare brands, device manufacturers, and professional associations, to support joint events, webinars, and co-marketing initiatives.

  • Support targeted marketing campaigns and gifting initiatives designed to engage medspa owners and decision-makers.

  • Help ensure leads generated through events and partnerships are captured accurately and followed up on promptly.

  • Support post-event reporting and evaluation, identifying opportunities to improve future events.

Support campaigns that drive growth

  • Help coordinate and execute marketing campaigns across email, social media, digital advertising, and events.

  • Work with global and regional marketing teams to adapt campaigns and messaging for the North American medspa audience.

  • Manage campaign timelines, materials, and deliverables to ensure activities launch smoothly and on schedule.

  • Track campaign performance, share insights, and identify opportunities to improve results.

Create content that connects with our audience

  • Support the creation and distribution of engaging content, including blog posts, customer stories, newsletters, social media posts, and promotional materials.

  • Help deliver partner webinars, educational resources, and marketing initiatives that demonstrate Phorest's value to medspa businesses.

  • Collaborate with our design and content specialists to develop high-quality, on-brand marketing materials.

  • Coordinate updates to medspa website content and landing pages.

  • Stay curious about the medspa industry, keeping up with trends, competitors, and what matters most to medspa owners and operators.

Keep our marketing running smoothly

  • Support the creation, scheduling, and testing of email campaigns to improve engagement and lead generation.

  • Work with Sales and Marketing teams to maintain accurate CRM data, track leads, and measure campaign effectiveness.

  • Monitor key marketing metrics, including event engagement, leads generated, and conversion rates.

  • Help manage event and marketing budgets, expenses, campaign assets, and reporting.

  • Look for opportunities to improve processes and make our event and marketing activities more efficient and effective.

What We're Looking For

We're looking for someone who's enthusiastic about events and marketing, enjoys working with people, and is excited to help grow a brand in a new market.

You'll ideally bring:

  • 1–3 years of experience in events, marketing, or a related field, ideally within a SaaS, B2B, or similarly fast-paced environment.

  • Experience planning or supporting conferences, trade shows, corporate events, or marketing campaigns, including coordinating logistics and working with vendors or partners.

  • Strong organizational and project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities, deadlines, and event details.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the confidence to build relationships with event organizers, partners, and internal teams.

  • A good understanding of digital marketing channels, including email, social media, paid advertising, and SEO.

  • Familiarity with marketing and CRM platforms such as Salesforce, HubSpot, Google Analytics, or similar tools.

  • Confidence using Google Workspace, Microsoft Office, and tools such as Canva or similar design platforms.

  • A proactive, flexible approach and the ability to solve problems when priorities or event requirements change.

  • Willingness and ability to travel across North America to support conferences, trade shows, partner events, and other industry activities, including event setup and on-site coordination.

Even better if you have:

  • Experience in the medspa, aesthetics, skincare, beauty, wellness, or healthcare technology industries.

  • Experience working with industry partners or supporting co-marketing campaigns.

  • Knowledge of Account-Based Marketing (ABM) or targeted B2B lead generation campaigns.

  • An understanding of the US medspa market and the needs of medspa owners, clinicians, and practice managers.

Benefits

🧘 Phorest currently offers a range of fully employer-paid benefits including Medical, Dental, Life, AD&D, Short Term Disability, an EAP, and wellness perks.

💰 Employees also have access to optional extras, such as a 401(k) and a range of upgraded insurance options.

🤓 Career development is important to us. We even have our own in-house Learning and Development/Business coach and many online resources including LinkedIn learning.

😎 We like to have fun, build camaraderie through regular social events.

👯 Phorest also encourages Employee Resource Groups, you will have the opportunity to join or champion a club, society, or group.

Phorest is an equal opportunities employer. We value diversity at our company and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

Research shows that while men apply to jobs when they meet an average of 60% of the criteria, women and other marginalized folks tend to only apply when they check every box. So if you think you have what it takes, but don't necessarily meet every single point on the job description, please still get in touch. We'd love to have a chat and see if you could be a great fit.

raw.description:
Job Overview:

ARB, Inc. is seeking an experienced Project Manager to lead the execution of large, complex EPC projects within the power generation and oil & gas sectors. The Project Manager is responsible for full lifecycle project execution and provides single-point accountability for safety, cost, schedule, quality, and contractual performance from project start-up through commissioning and project closeout.

The Project Manager would own the project, manage multi-disciplinary teams as well as coordinate engineering, procurement, construction, and commissioning activities. The position interfaces directly with owners, subcontractors, vendors, and regulatory agencies, and ensures disciplined execution consistent with EPC best practices while aligning with corporate objectives, policies, and governance.

Key Responsibilities

  • Be the single point of accountability for overall project execution, outcomes, and client satisfaction.
  • Establish and maintain a strong safety culture where safety is the highest priority across all phases of execution.
  • Build, lead, mentor, and develop a high-performing, multi-disciplinary project team across engineering, construction, procurement, commissioning, and project controls.
  • Develop and manage strong, collaborative client relationships and act as the primary interface with customers and key stakeholders.
  • Lead upfront project planning, execution strategy development, and constructability reviews.
  • Ensure development, integration, and adherence to engineering, procurement, construction, and commissioning schedules.
  • Own and manage all financial aspects of the project, including budgeting, cost forecasting, contingency management, cost control, and change control.
  • Administer and enforce the EPC contract and all related subcontracts and purchase orders.
  • Review engineering changes, field modifications, and design adjustments for cost, schedule, and contractual impacts.
  • Coordinate procurement of long-lead equipment, bulk materials, and specialty services to support execution and commissioning.
  • Proactively identify and resolve execution issues, evaluate alternatives, and drive timely, aligned decisions.
  • Ensure that commissioning, planning and readiness are integrated early and executed effectively through system turnover, testing, and final acceptance.
  • Communicate clearly and consistently with executive leadership regarding project status, risks, and opportunities.
  • Ensure compliance with corporate policies, procedures, regulatory requirements, and governance standards.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Construction Management, or a related technical discipline.
  • 10-15 years of progressive experience in engineering, construction, and project management within EPC delivery of power generation, energy infrastructure, or heavy industrial projects.
  • Extensive experience managing EPC projects through full lifecycle execution with direct responsibility for cost, schedule, safety, quality, and commercial performance.
  • Strong understanding of EPC contracting models, project controls, cost management, and schedule management.
  • Proficiency with Primavera P6, MS Project, and MS Office tools.
  • Professional Engineer (PE) license preferred, but not required.
  • Master’s degree or MBA preferred, but not required.

Leadership Profile

  • Safety-driven, accountable, and decisive.
  • Commercially astute with a strong execution mindset.
  • Trusted to operate independently with limited oversight.
  • Effective in high-visibility, high-pressure environments.
  • Collaborative, pragmatic, and solutions-oriented.

Compensation & Benefits

  • Salary Range: $145,000 – $185,000 annually
  • Per Diem: Available if eligible
  • Competitive benefits package including medical, dental, vision, 401(k), and paid time off

Company Overview:

ARB, Inc. has a long history of providing maintenance, construction, fabrication, and EPC services throughout the U.S., with safety and quality as our highest value proposition. We self-perform and deliver turnkey construction and EPC services to our clients within the energy infrastructure industry (gas processing, product storage and transportation, chemical/petrochemical, power generation, renewables, refining, and mining).

Benefits:

  • Competitive compensation, paid weekly.

  • Best-in-class medical, dental, vision, and LTD/STD coverage.

  • 401(k) with company match, vested on day one.

  • Employee Stock Purchase Plan [ESPP].

  • Pet coverage for your furry friends.

  • Legal assistance coverage.

  • Award-winning safety programs.

Our clients include both tech startups and big players in various industries and geographic locations (US, Japan, Israel, Europe).

While no longer a startup - we have 250+ people on board and have been operating since 2011 we’ve kept our people-oriented culture. Our values are simple:

  • Act to deliver.

  • Disrupt to grow.

  • Team up to win.

The project and the team

We are seeking an experienced Senior Software Engineer with Rust to join our project team. The project involves development of a new suite of tools that empowers organizations to build and deploy Physical Agents on their physical assets, whether it's a factory, a piece of manufacturing equipment, a street intersection, or a fleet of vehicles.

What else you should know:

  • We use Agile methodology.

  • The team operates within a startup environment.

  • Validating the solution with the client (demo)

  • Fixing discovered bugs efficiently and effectively

  • Working in the agile methodology and collaborating with a team

  • 7+ years of professional experience as a Software Engineer

  • Experience in designing and developing distributed applications, including RESTful APIs and inter-service communication

  • Knowledge of containerization including Docker, Kubernetes

  • Knowledge of Git

  • Experience with CI/CD tools and processes

  • Knowledge of public clouds

  • Working knowledge of Linux systems

Nice-to-Have Tools & Technologies

  • Experience with AI system engineering, including building LLM-based applications and agentic AI solutions

More reasons to join us

  • Flexible working hours and approach to work: fully remotely, in the office or hybrid

  • Professional growth supported by internal training sessions and a training budget

  • Solid onboarding with a hands-on approach to give you an easy start

  • A great atmosphere among professionals who are passionate about their work

Solution Architect

💸Salary: £80,000 - £110,000 (depending on experience)

📍Location: Remote – must be based within the UK. Occasional visits to see customers and the team.

🧠Interview process: Two rounds. 1: Get to know you chat with one of Talent Team; 2: Technical competency with two of the technical team; 3: Final Interview with our Chief Architect

🤝Our Values:  Advancing, Come as you are, Zero burnout, We all level up together and Transparency

Learn more about us:YouTube, read ourBlogs& understand ourvalues!

Who Are We?

Advancing Analytics are a market leader in delivering pioneering analytical solutions for customers all over the world. To thrive in today's market, businesses need to implement AI built on a solid, reliable Data Platform, and we are looking for you to help us build it!

Who are we looking for?

The Solution Architect is a sales-focused role and you will own the technical win across our pipeline. You will work alongside Sales, Senior Leadership, and Delivery Leads to turn opportunities into signed work.

You will qualify opportunities, shape the solution, build the demo, and present it to the client. As the trusted Databricks expert in the room, you will guide clients from the first technical conversation to a signed SoW.

You will work closely with clients to understand their challenges, shape the right solutions, and help them make the most of modern data and AI technologies.

You will play a key role in our most strategic engagements, supporting complex programmes and influencing how we leverage Agentic AI, automation, data platforms, and self-serve analytics to drive client outcomes.

Key Responsibilities:
Solution Design & Architecture

  • Design and document end-to-end data and AI solutions using Azure, Databricks, and related services.

  • Translate business and technical requirements into clear architecture designs that delivery teams can build.

  • Apply our existing standards, patterns, and reference architectures.

  • Identify technical risks early, own them on the project risk register and be accountable for their mitigation and resolution.

  • Produce design artefacts and present them at architectural forums, from engineering teams through to senior executives.

  • Shape and guide the design of intelligent data platform projects using Lakehouse architectures, making data available for reporting, AI, and analytics.

Pre-Sales & Commercial

  • Get involved early in client conversations to qualify opportunities and recommend the right approach.

  • Run structured discovery workshops with data, analytics, and platform teams. Capture requirements, current state, workloads, governance constraints, and target outcomes.

  • Shape the solution with subject matter experts across the business. Make designs scalable, supportable, cost-effective, and aligned with our standards.

  • Own the technical content of RFP and RFI responses, proposals, architecture diagrams, and Statements of Work.

  • Own the technical view on scope, effort, and delivery risk for opportunities.

  • Run technical pitches and demos. Handle deep technical and business-value questions.

  • Work with Databricks field teams on joint pursuits and co-selling.

Client & Stakeholder Engagement

  • Build strong relationships with clients and become a trusted technical advisor.

  • Take complex technical concepts and translate them into plain language and clear business outcomes for senior business leaders, technology leads, and internal sales teams.

  • Hand each won opportunity to delivery with a clear, complete design. Walk the Solution Architect through scope, assumptions, risks, and estimates.

Skills / Approaches:
Technical

  • Proven experience in technical pre-sales, designing cloud data architectures, with hands-on consulting on Azure and Databricks.

  • Working knowledge of data engineering, ML/AI engineering, data governance, and platform design.

  • Experience designing and presenting scalable, secure, and cost-effective solutions using established patterns and standards.

Pre-sales & Commercial

  • Track record running discovery, demos, POCs, and RFP responses for complex data and AI deals.

  • Comfortable working in ambiguous environments and helping clients shape problems as well as solutions.

  • Strong commercial awareness, comfortable shaping Statements of Work, T-shirt-size estimates, and linking technical choices to business value, total cost of ownership, and time to value.

Commercial & Stakeholder

  • Strong communication and presentation skills with technical and non-technical people at all levels, up to C-level.

  • Confident running demos, technical pitches, client workshops, and negotiations.

  • Able to influence technical and business stakeholders without relying solely on formal authority.

  • Previous consulting experience is required, you understand the difference between working for one business and working across many.

Certifications

  • Databricks Professional certification is required, or able to demonstrate equivalent knowledge through real project experience.

  • Azure certifications (such as Azure Data Engineer Associate or Azure Solutions Architect Expert) are a strong plus.

What will it be like to work for Advancing Analytics?

As a consultancy with strong partnerships across Microsoft, Databricks, AWS, Sigma, Tabular Editor and dbt Labs, you’ll get hands-on access to some of the most exciting technology and learning opportunities in the industry. We know this market moves quickly, so we invest in our people for the long term, giving you the space to build real expertise, keep developing, and stay ahead of what’s next.

We’re also genuinely active in the wider data and AI community. That means speaking at events, sponsoring major industry moments like Big Data London, and showing up at some of the biggest stages in the space, including Databricks Data+AI Summit, Data+AI World Tour, and the Global AI AgentCon London.

We encourage our team to get involved in the community, whether that’s in the form of a personal blog or an initiative you are passionate about advocating, we will support you!

Aside from offering a competitive salary, we have a great set of benefits and perks including, but not limited to:

  • Industry matching Maternity & Paternity policy 🐣

  • Private Medical & Dental Care plus Eye care scheme 👁️

  • Health & Well-being fund 🩺

  • 25 Days Annual Leave, Birthday Leave & Charity Leave 🌴

  • Away days with the team 🚃

  • Flexible Working Hours

  • Electric Car Scheme 🚗

  • Databricks Champion Status Bonus! 🌟

Our company values define us:

🚀 Advancing– Being part of a team that drives innovation and pushing boundaries of what’s possible. Our work redefines industry standards and challenges the status quo in the data world every day.

❤️ Come as you are – we are an inclusive company. When you work with us, rest assured you're working in a safe environment.

❌ Zero burnout – We have seen it happen, and we never want to be a company that pushes our staff to breaking point.

⬆️ We all level up together – we have each seen the benefit that being part of a community can have, it is transformational.

💡 Transparency– We are big believers that there are no secrets in Advancing Analytics, and we try to live this day to day.

You can read about our values in more detail here -

Equal opportunities for everyone

At Advancing Analytics both diversity and inclusion are a priority. We are all committed to creating an inclusive environment where everyone feels valued, respected and empowered to be their authentic selves.

We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer; all applicants will be considered without regard to age, ethnicity, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, veteran status, neurodiversity or disability status.

Über Stoïk

Stoïk schützt kleine und mittelständische Unternehmen in Europa vor Cyberrisiken. Der 2021 gegründete Cyberversicherer verbindet Cyberversicherung mit eigenen Sicherheitstools, Managed Services und einem internen Incident-Response-Team (CERT). So begleiten wir Unternehmen vor, während und nach einem Angriff. Unser CERT sieht täglich, welche Angriffe Unternehmen Geld kosten, und genau das prägt die Prävention, die wir entwickeln.

Unser Ziel: der CISO Europas zu werden.

  • 15.000+ geschützte Unternehmen in 7 europäischen Märkten

  • 2.000+ Maklerpartner

  • 300+ Sicherheitsvorfälle pro Monat, bearbeitet von unserem CERT

  • 200+ Mitarbeitende, unterstützt durch über 70 Mio. € von a16z, Alven und Munich Re

Das Team

Als Teil unseres Customer Success Teams baust du starke Beziehungen zu unseren Kunden im deutschen und österreichischen Markt auf.

Deine Aufgaben

Da wir weiter wachsen, suchen wir einen dynamischen Customer Success Manager (CSM) für unser Team. Du bist cyber-affine, vertriebsorientiert und hast richtig Lust darauf, unseren Kunden weiterzuhelfen? Dann wollen wir dich unbedingt kennenlernen!

In dieser Rolle dreht sich alles darum, unseren Kunden das beste Onboarding für unsere Cyber-Tools über unsere App Stoïk Protect zu bieten.

Außerdem sorgst du für einen reibungslosen Produkt-Feedback-Loop und koordinierst den erfolgreichen Launch neuer Features.

Customer Onboarding & Success

  • Onboarding: Du übernimmst den Onboarding-Prozess für neue Kunden und sorgst für ein nahtloses Erlebnis – je nach Kundengröße im Webinar-Format oder als 1:1-Session. Wiederkehrende Aufgaben im Onboarding-Alltag gehst du dabei mit einer positiven Einstellung an.

  • Basic Support: Du bearbeitest Anfragen rund um die Implementierung von Stoïk Protect über unser Ticketing-System. Du meisterst ein hohes Volumen an Kundenkontakten, hältst unsere SLAs zuverlässig ein und sicherst so eine Top-Kundenzufriedenheit.

  • Advanced Support: Gemeinsam mit unserem Cyber-Team leistest du fortgeschrittenen Support zu Cyber-Tools und versicherungstechnischen Voraussetzungen, um das Sicherheitsniveau unserer Kunden spürbar zu erhöhen.

Sales Promotion

  • Kunden halten: Du trägst direkt zur Retention-Rate bei Stoïk bei, indem du das Cyber-Präventionsversprechen einlöst, das unser Sales-Team gegeben hat.

  • Makler überzeugen: Du schärfst bei Versicherungsmaklern das Bewusstsein dafür, wie wichtig Stoïk Protect für unsere gemeinsamen Kunden ist.

  • Cross-Selling erkennen: In den Onboarding-Sessions erkennst du Chancen für unsere Managed Detection and Response (MDR) Services und koordinierst das Follow-up eng mit den Cyber- und Sales-Teams.

Projektmanagement

  • Prozesse skalieren: Du hilfst dabei, den Onboarding-Prozess stetig zu verbessern, um die Implementierungsrate unserer Cyber-Tools zu steigern. Dem Product-Team lieferst du wertvolles Feedback und konkrete Empfehlungen.

  • Content erstellen: Du erstellst Leitfäden, Dokumente und Schulungsmaterialien, die das Onboarding einfacher und schneller machen.

  • Schnittstellen nutzen: Du durchdringst unsere Unternehmensstruktur und arbeitest eng mit verschiedenen Teams (Cyber, Tech, Product, Marketing) zusammen, um Kundenbedürfnisse schnell und effizient zu lösen.

Das bringst du mit

  • Cybersecurity-Erfahrung: Erste Erfahrung im Bereich Cybersicherheit ist bei uns ein absolutes Must-have.

  • Kommunikationstalent: Stark in Kommunikation und Präsentation, empathisch im Umgang mit Menschen und erfahren in der Zusammenarbeit in internationalen Teams.

  • Umsetzungsstärke: Prozessorientierte Denkweise mit einer klaren "Hands-on"-Mentalität – du lernst schnell und bringst Dinge einfach über die Ziellinie.

  • Vertriebs-Gespür: Eine leichte Vertriebsorientierung und das Händchen dafür, Zusatzleistungen überzeugend einzubringen.

  • Sprachen: Fließendes Deutsch und Englisch in Wort und Schrift.

raw.title: Google Ads Media Buyer / Growth Strategist
raw.excerpt: Everyone can run a search campaign.  Almost nobody can tell you whether it worked.
raw.description:
Everyone can run a search campaign. Almost nobody can tell you whether it worked.

That is the whole job.

Google will happily show you a 6x ROAS built almost entirely out of people who already knew your client's name. It will auto apply assets you did not ask for. It will report a number that makes a client feel great and tells you nothing about whether you grew the business.

So we do not hire people to manage Google Ads. We hire marketers who can tell the difference between demand they created and demand they harvested, and who can prove it to a client's face.

At Sweat Pants Agency we work with around 50 DTC and eCommerce brands, 20 to 25 of them on paid media. We spend $6 to $9M a month on Meta and $1 to $2M a month on Google. We are the only agency behind two INC #1 fastest growing brands, both from zero.

You would own a set of our Google accounts end to end.

Here is what "end to end" actually means.

You are the account manager. We do not have any. You talk to the client directly. You write the updates, you run the calls, and you defend the call you made. The reason we do it this way is ownership. When you are the person answering for the account, it is your result, not somebody else's summary of your result.

You own the whole funnel, not the campaign. Feed and Merchant Center, search and Shopping and PMax, Demand Gen and YouTube, the landing page, and the conversion tracking underneath all of it. If the feed is why Shopping is starving, that is yours. If the page is why the clicks do not convert, that is yours too. Our team ships advertorials, comparison pages, and PDPs in Claude Code, deploys them to Vercel, points a subdomain at them, and tests them live before anything touches the client's Shopify theme.

You are expected to have an opinion about attribution and to defend it. We optimize to NC-CPA and NC-ROAS, not blended and not last click. We have turned brand search off to see what actually shifts to organic. We run geo holdouts. If a campaign is not incremental, we would rather know than keep the number.

You can live anywhere. We are remote and we hire worldwide. The one hard requirement is that you can take client calls during US Eastern business hours, because you are the client's point of contact. The rest of your day is yours. Nobody here is on a time clock. We judge you on output.

If you want a lane, a ticket queue, and a scope document, this is a bad fit and we will both know it fast.

If you want to own the whole picture and be judged on whether the number moved, keep reading.

Requirements

What the job looks like

  • Own a set of DTC accounts as the strategist, the buyer, and the client's direct point of contact. Budgets run from $5k/mo to well into six figures a month.
  • Own the client relationship. There is no account manager between you and them. You present the results, the plan, and the reasoning, and you are the one who answers when something is not working.
  • Audit before you touch anything. Every account we take over gets a real review first: campaign and ad group structure, keywords versus search terms, negatives, bidding strategy per campaign type, impression share, feed health, landing pages, audiences, and conversion tracking. Then a Loom walking the client through what you found. That Loom is how we sell and it is how we keep people.
  • Run brand and non brand as different businesses. Brand is mostly assisted conversion and it usually belongs on target impression share, not target CPA. Non brand is where the growth is and where the waste is. Report them separately or you are reporting nothing.
  • Know what PMax is actually doing. The most common mistake we see is optimizing PMax against an incremental CAC when half the volume inside it is branded. If you cannot separate those two, you cannot set a target.
  • Keep Google's automation on a leash. Auto applied recommendations, auto applied assets, and auto created sitelinks have cost our clients real money. We audit for them on a schedule.
  • Own the feed. Merchant Center hygiene, product titles, disapprovals, promotions, and what the feed does to Shopping and PMax delivery.
  • Own the tracking. GA4, GTM, Shopify goal imports versus a raw Google Ads tag, enhanced conversions, offline conversion imports for the lead gen accounts. When the numbers do not reconcile, you are the one who finds out why.
  • Diagnose the bottleneck, then go fix it. Creative, offer, AOV, landing page, checkout, tracking. Nobody is going to reassign it to another team.
  • Build the things the account needs. Landing pages, scripts, reporting, whatever removes the constraint. We are heavy AI users and we expect you to build, not just prompt.

You are a fit if

  • You have done this with real money. Hands on Google Ads at meaningful spend on DTC and eCommerce, with results you can walk us through: CPA, ROAS, revenue, and what you actually changed to get them. Shopping and PMax specifically, not just search.
  • You are fluent in the whole stack, not one campaign type. Search, Shopping, PMax, Demand Gen, YouTube, Merchant Center, GA4, GTM. Bing is a nice to have.
  • You are AI native, and you build. This is a requirement, not a bonus. You should already be using Claude or equivalent as a working tool rather than a novelty, and you should be able to build and ship a landing page with it.
  • You can communicate your ideas in English at a native or near native level. You will be in front of clients constantly. You need to explain your thinking clearly, sell an idea on its merits, push back when a client is about to force the account into mediocrity, and raise a problem before it becomes a fire. This matters as much as anything else on this list.
  • You are skeptical of your own numbers. You would rather run the holdout than protect the dashboard.
  • You can work US Eastern business hours for client calls. Where you live is up to you.
  • Bonus: you have built or operated your own Shopify store, or you have run Meta at spend too.

You are not a fit if

  • "That was not my role" is in your vocabulary. It is the fastest way to end an interview here. If the feed was the problem on an account you ran, you should have done something about the feed.
  • You want to be told what to do this week.
  • You need a ticketing system to know what matters.
  • You quote blended ROAS as if it settles the question.

Benefits

Why this role is exciting

This is not a maintenance job. You would have real influence over how we run Google across the agency.

You will work on real brands with real budgets. We test aggressively. We learn quickly. We build frameworks that scale.

You get trust on day one. You get a lot of autonomy. Some people thrive with it. You will get feedback fast either way, and if you make it through the first 30 days you will probably be here for a long time. Our retention on this team is very good and that is not an accident.

You will grow into senior strategy. We want people who want more responsibility. If you perform, you will grow.

About OpenMined

OpenMined is a 501(c)(3) non-profit foundation that brings together leading minds in AI, security, and privacy technology to develop open-source solutions that transform how data can be accessed and shared. Founded in 2017, we've grown into a global community of over 18,000 members working to ensure that privacy protection and AI innovation reinforce each other rather than undermine one another. We are driven by a simple challenge: the most valuable data for solving humanity's greatest challenges remains locked away due to privacy concerns, and we can change that through technology rather than compromise.

About the Role

We're looking for a Senior / Staff Software Engineer to join OpenMined, a nonprofit building open-source infrastructure for federated AI.

You’ll lead our 😱 ScreamingFace squad, the team that makes this vision real by building the internet's first leaderboard for fusion models (ensembles) and the open toolkit supporting benchmark evaluations for fusion models. Today, claims that the newest solo LLM beats the others are everywhere, and almost none of them can be checked or compared with the performance achieved by combining LLMs into more powerful fusion models. Results are self-reported, expensive to rerun, and hard to pick apart. We think there’s a better standard: every fusion and benchmark run compiles to a single line of text that anyone can replay for almost nothing, and a score counts only once someone else can reproduce it. The ScreamingFace toolkit is the open-source Python library and engine, leveraging our URL4 protocol, to let any researcher (a frontier lab, a university group, an independent builder) compose ensembles and routers across open and closed models, using their own keys, and grade them against pinned benchmarks. The ScreamingFace leaderboard is the public map of the quality–cost frontier, backed by a shared cache that makes every result on it cheap to verify and easy to build on.

This is a hands-on technical leadership role. You understand the long term vision. You write code. You make architecture decisions. You set engineering standards by example. You're the most experienced engineer on the squad, the person others look to for production-quality judgment, and the voice that connects this team's decisions with the organization's broader platform strategy.

The squad is talented and mission-driven and looking to strengthen its ability to continuously ship production software. You bring this production muscle: the instinct for what scales, the judgment about what to build and what to kill, and the craft to raise the team's standard through code review, pairing, and architectural guidance rather than mandates.

If you're motivated by building distributed systems that matter, mentoring brilliant people who are just getting started, and making hard technical calls in a fast-moving nonprofit that's trying to change how the world shares data — we'd love to hear from you.

You'll report to Kevin McDonough, Head of Engineering.

This is a fully remote role for people based in the United States, working within one hour of US Eastern Time.

Responsibilities

  • Own the ScreamingFace squad technical architecture end to end — align design, engineering, and deployment across the stack to deliver reliable technical capabilities and user experience from current implementation through product roadmap evolution.
  • Drive production readiness through deployment monitoring, error handling, graceful degradation, and operational runbooks.
  • Be a force multiplier by establishing, demonstrating, and mentoring the team to establish norms around engineering best practices (including system design for modularity, security, reliability, & scalability), code quality, and delivery to production.
  • Collaborate on core technology stack strategy through architectural review and identification of components that should become shared organizational primitives and defining standard interfaces that prevent tight coupling.
  • Partner with product lead to develop and execute on realistic roadmaps that balance what is desired with what is feasible, scalable, and architecturally sound.
  • Own the delivery of engineering’s quarterly goals, ensuring consistent, high-impact delivery while effectively managing resources.
  • Own team output, delivery, and success (productivity, timeliness, morale) through appropriately matching team members and work to properly balance interest, learning opportunities, capacity, and capability.
  • Champion high-quality software delivery through the establishment of robust tools, processes, & methodologies, and by providing hands-on technical leadership via individual development contributions and code reviews.
  • Create technical documentation and processes that support high velocity and knowledge transfer.

Requirements

Must-Haves

  • 8+ years of professional software engineering experience with a track record of personally building, shipping, and operating production systems at meaningful scale
  • Hands-on experience building production software with AI coding agents (e.g., Claude Code, Cursor) and helping a team manage their agentic workflows
  • Strong Python (3.12+) proficiency — FastAPI services, async orchestration of concurrent model calls, typed SDK design and packaging, and a working comfort with parsers, ASTs, and DAG execution
  • Distributed systems and API design experience including design & evolution of interfaces consumed by multiple independent teams
  • Technical leadership experience: has introduced engineering quality practices (code review, testing, CI/CD) to one or more teams and mentored or managed at least 2 engineers (direct reports not required)
  • Comfort with ambiguity and resource constraints
  • Commitment, accountability, ownership — this isn’t just a job, the release gets shipped and outages get restored
  • Async-fluent with strong written communication and capacity to build high-trust working relationships across 6hr+ time zone spread
  • Cross-functional collaboration & communication to facilitate and improve understanding/context sharing between engineers and non-engineering/non-technical stakeholders

Preferred

  • Practical RAG and information retrieval experience with vector databases, retrieval pipelines, embedding strategies, and aggregation
  • Vue 3 / TypeScript, Rust / Tauri, or cross-platform desktop app experience extremely beneficial
  • Networking/P2P application experience beneficial

Compensation

  • Salary Range: $125,000 - $258,000 per year.
  • Actual offers will be determined based on the candidate's skills, level of experience, and location.

Benefits

    • Mission-Driven Work: Be part of a 501(c)(3) nonprofit organization, focused on social impact rather than profit, offering the chance to make a meaningful difference in the world.
    • US employee benefits: Medical, dental, and vision insurance with company contributions; Retirement: 403(b) plan, the 401(k) equivalent for non-profits
    • Open Source Contribution: Make a real impact by contributing to an Open Source project that benefits a broad community.
    • Collaborative Global Team: Join a dynamic, international team that values collaboration and diversity.
    • Flexible Work Hours: Enjoy the autonomy to structure your work hours around what best fits your life and productivity.
    • Fully Remote Work: Work remotely within the location requirements for this role.
    • Flexible Paid Time Off: Take the time you need with flexible vacation days, alongside recognition of local national holidays.

D-Wave Quantum Inc. (NASDAQ: QBTS) is a leader in the development and delivery of quantum computing systems, software, and services. It is the world’s first commercial supplier of quantum computers, and the first and only to offer dual-platform quantum computing products and services, spanning both annealing and gate-model quantum computing technologies. D-Wave’s mission is to help customers realize the value of quantum today through enterprise-grade systems available on-premises and via its Leap™ quantum cloud service, which offers 99.9% availability and uptime. More than 100 organizations across commercial, government, and research sectors trust D-Wave to address complex computational challenges using quantum computing. Learn more about realizing the value of quantum computing today and how D-Wave is shaping the quantum-driven industrial and societal advancements of tomorrow: .

About the role

An exciting opportunity for a Senior Solutions Architect based in the UK or Ireland! In this role, you will build and deliver quantum optimization solutions for customer applications while working with delivery leads, applications developers, and other solutions architects within the professional services department. 

Additionally, you will work with our internal teams and external customers to review customer business problems, map these problems to D-Wave’s hybrid solvers and advanced quantum systems, formulate solutions, build and test prototypes, and build applications that run-in production for our customers.

What you'll do

  • Build customer applications on the D-Wave quantum computer and internal tools
  • Ensure successful delivery of projects to achieve business value for customers
  • Communicate capabilities with customers and ask probing questions to understand the problem and propose solutions
  • Gather requirements on customer use cases, lead brainstorming sessions, consult with customers on potential solutions, model use cases mathematically, and design and develop quantum hybrid applications
  • Build and maintain relationships with leaders across various groups within D-Wave  
  • Share customer and project-related insights with D-Wave's tools and product teams and help prioritize new product features
  • Organize, prepare, and present technical information in a clear and effective manner
  • Participate in the development of an inclusive, helpful, fun environment

About You

  • Masters, PhD, or equivalent in Operations Research, Data Science, Mathematics, Statistics, Computer Science, or related technical field preferred
  • A professional with 5+ years experience with Python. Knowledge of NumPy, Pandas, Scikit-learn, and Networkx is an extra bonus! 
  • Experienced working directly with external customers (ideally in a consulting role) to identify requirements and consult on solutions to complex business problems
  • Experienced using leading optimisation/optimization tools and techniques including Gurobi, CPLEX, genetic algorithms, and simulated annealing
  • Practical with a view of what it means to solve customer problems, with a strong sense of urgency and an understanding of project delivery requirements
  • Strong knowledge of mathematical modeling and optimisation/optimization solution techniques
  • Experience with a version control software such as Git     
  • Experience building applications to solve complex business problems for customers in a production environment
  • Collaborative mindset and solid interpersonal skills 
  • Passionate for writing state-of-the-art Python code
  • Experience providing technical leadership from business problem definition, functional requirements specifications, to solution design and implementation
  • Proven record of successful on-time delivery of projects with a high degree of predictability and quality
  • Preferably experienced within industries such as Manufacturing, Logistics, Retail, Services

Inclusion:

We celebrate diverse perspectives to drive innovation in our pursuit. Our employees range from distinguished domain experts with decades of experience in their respective fields, to bright and motivated graduates eager to make their mark. Our diverse and innovative team will make you feel appreciated, supported and empower your career growth at D-Wave.

A D-Waver's DNA

  • We look at the future and say “why not”; we see possibilities where others see problems or routines. We show the way ahead and are committed to achieving ambitious goals.
  • We practice straight talk and listen generously to each other with empathy. We value different opinions and points of views. We ensure that we connect outside as well as inside to learn from others and inspire each other.
  • We hold ourselves accountable for delivering results. We make decisions & take responsibility so that we can act & support each other.
  • As leaders we motivate & engage our teams to undertake beyond what they originally thought possible, by developing our teams & creating the conditions for people to grow and empower themselves through enabling & coaching.

Our Compensation Philosophy is Simple but Powerful:

We believe providing D-Wavers with company ownership, competitive pay, and a range of meaningful benefits is the start of creating a culture where people want to give the best they’ve got — not because they’re simply making money, but because they’ve fallen in love with our vision, mission, values, and team.

During the interview process, your Recruiter will review our total rewards (base, equity, bonus, perks, benefit, culture) offerings. The final offer is determined by your proficiencies within this level.

The Fine Print:

No 3rd party candidates will be accepted

It is D-Wave Systems Inc. policy to provide equal employment opportunity (EEO) to all persons regardless of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, genetic information, physical or mental disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state/provincial, local law.

Job seekers should be aware of fraudulent job offers from online scammers and only apply to roles listed on D-Wave Careers site using our applicant system. Note: We do not use text messaging or third-party messaging apps to communicate with applicants and will never ask for fees or financial commitment, so please exercise caution if you are approached in this way. Position: Technical Business Analyst – Guatemala

Location: Full-time remote (Guatemala)

Reports to: Solutions Engineer & BA Manager

About Ntara:

Ntara is a leading PXM (product experience management) consultancy that helps manufacturers and brands modernize their digital ecosystems. With deep expertise in PIM, DAM, and ecommerce strategy, we empower brands and product-focused companies to deliver consistent, trustworthy product experiences across digital channels by simplifying systems, centralizing data, and implementing solutions that drive growth and value.

Why join Ntara?

Our work spans consulting, technology, and process optimization, giving you the chance to tackle complex challenges that truly impact our clients’ businesses. If you thrive in a collaborative environment, love solving problems, and want to make a measurable difference, Ntara might be the place for you.

Position summary:

As a Technical Business Analyst, you must have the ability to plan and document large scale technical projects in our product experience management (PXM) practices to range from websites for commerce or content management systems (CMS), digital asset management (DAM), and product information management (PIM). The systems you build will reside on platforms that we implement for our clients. A successful analyst at Ntara will demonstrate proficiency in all aspects of the digital ecosystem (systems architecture to data analysis) —and you’ll join our growing PXM practice at Ntara with room for growth and expansion of your skills. In fact, our team received top honors at last year’s PIMpoint Digital 2024. We were honored as inRiver’s 2024 North American Partner of the Year—and we’re home to three inRiver Champions in North America.

This job is full-time, remote. Must be able to work in the GMT-4 time zone.

Must be fluent in both spoken and written English.

What you’ll own:

  • Build relationships with clients. Understand their goals, workflows, and processes. Use your deep system knowledge to drive system strategy.
  • Work closely with client teams to prioritize and build the digital roadmap and inform long-range planning.
  • Run systems improvement projects. Work directly with system users to collect requirements, implement, test, and deploy new features periodically.
  • Problem-solving all aspects of PXM implementations
  • Documentation and planning for client solutions
  • Implementation support for PIM systems, DAM systems, ecommerce websites, and possibly other applications
  • Interviewing stakeholders to dig into what they really are trying to convey
  • Diagrams of complex systems, business processes, and integrations
  • Schema-level documentation to detail the attributes the systems need to track
  • Attribute mappings between systems for integrations
  • Requirements gathering and writing
  • Writing and designing technical specifications
  • Ensuring quality deliverables for our clients
  • Develop process improvements with a seasoned team
  • Template development to improve processes
  • Change management for customers and possibly our own team

Skills + experience:

  • Product Information Management (PIM) platform experience, such as inRiver, Akeneo, Salsify, Censhare, etc
  • Digital Asset Management (DAM) platform experience, such as Aprimo, Bynder, Keyshot / Digizuite, Censhare, etc
  • Experience analyzing large sets of data
  • Leadership capabilities
  • Familiarity with Azure infrastructure and hosting
  • Master Data Management (MDM) experience
  • Ecommerce platform experience
  • Ecommerce implementation, deployment, and integrations
  • Knowledge of multi-tier web application development
  • Content Management System (CMS) experience (Kentico, EpiServer, Sitefinity, etc.)
  • Knowledge of how to implement 3rd party APIs and SDKs
  • Writing and interacting with SOAP and REST web services
  • Knowledge of ASP.NET C#
  • Experience in a consulting environment is preferred. Must be comfortable managing billable and non-billable hours expectations.

Who you are committed to being:

  • Life-long learner. You have a learner’s mindset, proactively seek feedback, and see opportunities to learn from every task, situation, and interaction.
  • Outcome-focused. You tackle problems head-on, seek help when needed, prioritize based on impact, and deliver tangible results.
  • Data-informed. You form perspectives and generate outcomes by seeking out data and context.
  • Systems thinker. You see the big picture, understand how different pieces fit together, and can articulate how your work delivers business outcomes.
  • Effective communicator. You’re intentional about what you communicate, distill complex ideas into straightforward language, and present with confidence.
  • Capable multitasker. You juggle a set of diverse projects with a strong track record of prioritizing and delivering against deadlines.
  • Team player. You empower others to success. You understand the value of a team.

Team culture + values:

  • Empathy: We seek to understand.
  • Clarity: We cut through the noise.
  • Ownership: We own outcomes.
  • Ambition: We push boundaries with purpose.
  • Integrity: We do what’s right, even when it’s hard.
  • Teamwork: We face everything as one team.

Perks + benefits:

  • This is a remote, Guatemala-based role. While the position is remote‑first, there may be occasional travel for key client meetings, project workshops, or team gatherings. These instances are limited and scheduled with plenty of notice. (Working schedule in EST is preferred).
  • Competitive salary
  • Collaborative, growth-oriented culture
  • Paid vacation days, holidays, and personal days
  • Opportunity to make a measurable impact
