Revolution Medicines is a global, commercial-state oncology company dedicated to discovering, developing and delivering innovative medicines for patients with RAS-addicted cancers. Leveraging its differentiated RAS(ON) tri-complex inhibitor platform, the company is advancing a broad, integrated portfolio of oral RAS(ON) inhibitors designed to directly target the active, cancer-driving state of RAS. Founded on rigorous scientific inquiry and a willingness to challenge long-held assumptions, Revolution Medicines is committed to changing the trajectory of disease for patients with RAS-addicted cancers worldwide.

Our people are united by a shared way of working: follow the science, challenge assumptions, act with urgency and hold ourselves to a high standard of rigor—all in service of patients.

The Opportunity:

Reporting directly to the Senior Director, Provider Accounts, the National Account Director, Community Oncology (NAD) is responsible for establishing and maintaining strategic relationships to secure optimal market access for our innovative oncology medicines with Group Purchasing Organizations (GPO), key community oncology stakeholders and provider-driven clinical pathways. The NAD will develop and execute account plans and strategies that drive rapid pathway and protocol inclusions to support rapid access while representing the company's interests with key decision-makers. The NAD will help to coordinate cross-functional workstreams to ensure products are included when appropriate in provider-driven clinical pathways. This is a field-based remote position.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Translate national, brand-level strategy to key accounts across community oncology key stakeholders and group purchasing organizations (GPOs).

  • Lead and oversee account activities such as driving rapid, clinical pathway and treatment protocol inclusion post launch in close collaboration with Medical Affairs.

  • Lead all Business to Business and C-Suite relationships with key accounts to support speaker programs, access activities and company partnerships.

  • Build and maintain strong KOL and C-level relationships with aligned GPO and large aggregator accounts.

  • Lead cross-functional team across commercial Field to pro-actively identify and resolve access barrier issues.

  • Track and Analyze business opportunities to proactively provide strategic and tactical guidance.

  • Negotiate favorable contracts and agreements in alignment with strategic business objectives.

  • Champion voice of customer to internal stakeholders and commercial leadership.

  • Provide strategic insights and feedback to brands, field, and market access.

  • Create medium to long term strategic engagement plan spanning multiple product and indication launches and focuses on engaging beyond transactional approaches.

  • Facilitate executive exchanges to create opportunities for Rev Med leaders and GPO/Large Account C-Suite leaders to meet and align.

  • Consistently strong appropriate engagement with GPO, GPO account filed-based managers, Aggregator Account leadership and formulary decision makers.

  • Proactively communicate when important opportunities arise.

  • Activate resources to support opportunities and challenges.

  • Ability to design and lead pull through projects with commercial field.

  • Conduct quarterly business reviews with key systems and internal stakeholders.

Required Skills, Experience and Education:

  • Bachelor’s degree required.

  • 10+ years’ progressive experience in strategic account management.

  • Strong established relationships within community oncology GPOs and the C-level leadership at large oncology clinics.

  • Demonstrated understanding of reimbursement, economic flows, and oral oncolytic trends within group purchasing organization key customer stakeholders.

  • Strong communication skills to educate and influence other stakeholders, including the commercial executive leadership team and US Market Access.

  • Ability to clearly and efficiently communicate the value proposition of novel oncology therapies to customers.

  • Excellent negotiation skills and strategic alignment with enterprise P&L objectives.

  • Prior experience with pipeline products and product launches.

  • Ability to partner effectively with Medical Affairs, Sales, Marketing and Field Reimbursement teams.

  • 50% travel required to customer meetings, industry conferences, and RevMed’s home office in Redwood City, CA.

Preferred Skills:

  • Advanced degree (MBA, Master’s, PharmD, PhD).

  • Comprehensive experience and understanding of community GPOs and the clinic market.

  • Experience in GI oncology, PDAC and/or NSCLC, including oral targeted therapies.

  • Successful coordination of leadership exchanges and strategic partnerships beyond traditional contracting and rebate agreements.

  • Previous oncology launch experience.

  • Proved ability to stay abreast of the evolving healthcare landscape.

  • Expertise in establishing high-functioning, collaborative relationships with new and rapidly growing teams.

  • Prior people leadership experience and ability to build team as company grows.

Alkira is reinventing networking for the AI era. We're looking for a Sr. Software Engineer - Backend Engineer who wants to own products from blank page to production — and operate what you ship. You'll build net-new capabilities and maintain the distributed systems behind Alkira's CSX (Cloud Services Exchange). Ownership here means both shipping the 0→1 and maintaining them.

To learn more about our product and who we are, we invite you to take a look at a quick demonstration or visit our website.

What you'll do

  • Take product ideas from 0 to 1: scope, design, build, ship, and own them in production.
  • Build and maintain large-scale distributed systems for multi-cloud networking — resiliency, scale, and correctness under real customer load.
  • Use AI as a core part of how you ship and operate: agentic workflows, LLM-powered dev loops, and AI tooling to move 5–10x faster than a traditional engineer. We expect you to leverage AI, not just tolerate it.
  • Design, build, and maintain APIs and microservices (Java/Spring and Go, PostgreSQL, Kubernetes) — treating the stack as a means to ship and sustain product, not the job itself.
  • Operate what you build: customer escalations, on-call, telemetry, and bug fixes are part of ownership, not a separate team's problem. You'll also pick up and maintain existing services in your area.

What we're looking for

  • B.S./M.S. (or equivalent) in CS, EE, or a related field, plus 4 - 7 years of software engineering experience.
  • A builder's instinct: you've taken something from zero to shipped before — and you're also comfortable inheriting, understanding, and improving an existing codebase.
  • AI-native workflow: you use tools like Claude Code / Cursor / Copilot daily and have a point of view on how to ship faster with AI.
  • Strong CS fundamentals and hands-on Java/Spring and Go, distributed systems, REST API design, DB schema design,
  • multithreading.
  • Linux/kernel fluency and comfort with container + Kubernetes deployment.
  • Security-first thinking for distributed, multi-tenant systems.
  • Product and customer empathy — you care about why a feature matters, not just how to build it.

Alkira, a Lumen company, is building the future of enterprise networking: one programmable platform to connect, secure, and operate every cloud, site, partner, data center, and AI workload.

Our platform helps customers move faster without managing hardware, stitching together providers, or operating fragmented cloud networks. Teams can build and scale connectivity on demand, apply consistent security and segmentation, and gain visibility across distributed environments from one place.

At Alkira, you’ll help shape the next chapter of networking: cloud-like consumption, private-network performance, and total control across the enterprise. We move fast, solve hard problems, and build technology that changes how global businesses connect.

Join us and help build the future of networking.

Senior Systems Administrator

POSITION DESCRIPTION

Eutelsat Network Solutions is seeking a dedicated and growth-oriented Senior Systems Administrator to join our
collaborative Technology team. Our mission is to deliver secure, reliable, and scalable technology services that empower the organization. In this role, you’ll support day-to-day operations by managing Microsoft 365 and Azure Gov Cloud environments, responding to helpdesk tickets, performing system patching, and maintaining configurations across hybrid systems. We are a team that values curiosity, accountability, and continuous improvement. The ideal candidate is someone who enjoys solving problems, improving processes, and contributing to a culture of operational excellence.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES

  • Provide Tier 2/Tier 3 technical support and act as the primary escalation point for complex infrastructure,
    authentication, M365, access, and system-level issues.
    • Troubleshoot and resolve advanced user, system, and performance issues across hybrid environments.
    • Execute onboarding, offboarding, and lifecycle management tasks across identity, applications, and devices.
    • Deploy, configure, and maintain hybrid server, storage, networking, and endpoint infrastructure across all sites.
    • Configure and deploy applications using centralized management tools such as Company Portal.
    • Develop, maintain, and optimize automation scripts using PowerShell, Python, Bash, or similar technologies to

streamline operational processes.

  • Manage, monitor, and validate backup, restore, and disaster recovery solutions for hybrid systems.

    compliance.
    • Support container deployments, updates, troubleshooting, and availability management.

    across teams.

    environments.

    governance teams.

    • Implement and administer monitoring and observability solutions such as Azure Monitor and Zabbix.

    testing, integration, cutover, and ongoing maintenance.
    • Configure and deploy hardware, including servers, storage, networking, and endpoint devices at all organizational
    sites to support projects and operational needs.
    • Establishes and maintains cyber security posture for entrusted systems through application of sound cyber security
    engineering principles such as implementation of access control, utilization of least privilege principles, central
    authentication mechanism deployment, as well as following vendor recommendations.
    • Perform other job-related duties assigned by manager.

SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • There are no supervisory responsibilities for this role.

QUALIFICATIONS

Required Education & Experience:

  • Bachelor's degree in a related field or equivalent experience in lieu of a degree
    • Minimum 6 years of relevant systems administration experience
    • Security+ CE certification or equivalent
    • Scripting experience in Python, PowerShell, Bash, or similar languages
    • Knowledge of five or more of the following areas:
    o Windows Server 2019, 2022
    o Windows 11
    o Ubuntu 22.04 LTS
    o iDRAC and iLO
    o Docker
    o Enterprise networking
    o Endpoint Security
    o Vulnerability remediation
    • Knowledge of five or more of the following cloud technologies:
    o Virtual Machines

    o SharePoint
    o Exchange
    o Entra ID
    o Azure Virtual Desktop
    o Azure Update Manager
    o Key Vaults, Storage Accounts, and Managed Identities
    Professional Skills
    • Strong analytical and troubleshooting abilities
    • Excellent communication skills for technical and non-technical audiences
    • Ability to work in fast-paced environments and manage multiple priorities
    • Strong attention to detail and commitment to operational excellence
    Preferred Qualifications
    • Familiarity with logging and monitoring tools (Zabbix, Azure Monitor, Log Analytics)
    • Background in cybersecurity and compliance frameworks (NIST SP 800-171, CMMC 2.0, NIST SP 800-53, RMF)
    • Familiarity with secure baselines and hardening guidelines such as DISA STIGs and CIS Benchmarks
    Technical Environment
    • Cloud Platforms: Azure Gov, Microsoft 365 GCC-High
    • Operating Systems: Linux (Ubuntu), Windows Server
    • Automation Tools: Ansible, PowerShell, Python
    • Monitoring: Azure Monitor, Grafana, Zabbix
    • Containerization: Docker, Docker Compose
    • End Users: 80
    • Scripting: Python, PowerShell, Bash

    Travel

Sourcing Specialist

The Sourcing Specialist owns the front end of the hiring pipeline, moving quickly to identify, engage, and deliver strong candidates for open roles. The Sourcing Specialist coordinates with the Staffing Specialists and TA Managers to actively source candidates for openings using a variety of resources, including but not limited to job boards, resume databases, news outlets, social media websites, colleges/universities, and community organizations. This role takes a highly analytical, data-driven approach to managing our sourcing partners, aggressively tracking performance metrics and holding partners accountable for results. The Sourcing Specialist will work closely with representatives from our recruitment marketing agency to monitor ad placement and performance between campaigns, identify underperforming channels, and drive improvements.

Essential Duties & Responsibilities

  • Source prospective candidates using Applicant Tracking System, job boards, and community-based organizations
  • Builds applicant sources by researching and contacting community services, colleges, employment agencies, recruiters, media, and internet sites; providing organization information, opportunities, and benefits; making presentations; maintaining rapport
  • Attracts applicants by placing job advertisements; contacting recruiters, using newsgroups and job sites
  • Proactively build talent pipelines for high-volume and hard-to-fill roles before openings occur
  • Reviews resumes for appropriate skill sets to qualify candidates
  • Evaluates candidates against job requirements, engages candidate in the opportunity, and presents qualified candidates to the Staffing Specialist or TA Manager
  • Aggressively track, analyze, and report on sourcing partner performance metrics, including applicant volume, applicant quality, cost per applicant, cost per hire, conversion rates, and time to fill
  • Hold sourcing partners and our recruitment marketing agency accountable to performance expectations; proactively escalate underperformance and push for corrective action
  • Analyze campaign and channel data to identify trends, gaps, and areas of opportunity, and recommend reallocating spend toward the highest-performing sources
  • Continuously identify, test, and evaluate new sourcing channels and strategies, bringing recommendations to TA leadership
  • Understand and demonstrate safe work practices at all times to ensure a safe work environment
  • Comply with all company policies and procedures
  • Complete special projects and other duties as assigned by your supervisor

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

  • Strong analytical skills with a data-driven mindset and the ability to turn metrics into actionable recommendations
  • Assertive and results-focused, comfortable challenging vendors and partners when performance falls short
  • Effective communication skills both written and verbal
  • Able to work both independently and as part of a team
  • Excellent organizational skills and ability to prioritize effectively
  • Great interpersonal skills
  • Excellent problem-solving abilities
  • Able to independently research new and trending practices in the industry
  • Able to work to agreed deadlines and targets
  • Attention to detail and accuracy in work
  • Service-oriented with a history of building excellent customer and candidate relationships

Experience and Credentials

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent work experience

  • Good knowledge of HR procedures and best practices

📌 Votre mission

Au sein d'une équipe multidisciplinaire réunissant des data engineers, des architectes, des analystes, des experts en intelligence artificielle, des spécialistes BI, des chefs de projet ainsi que des experts en gouvernance et en qualité des données, vous contribuez à valoriser les données au service des politiques publiques, de la qualité des soins et du contrôle médical.

Votre mission consiste à mettre en œuvre et à coordonner la gouvernance des données au sein de l'organisation. Vous animez les communautés de data stewards, favorisez l'adoption des outils de gouvernance et pilotez les initiatives liées à la qualité des données, conformément aux priorités définies par le Data Governance Manager.

Vous rapportez au Data Governance Manager et collaborez étroitement avec les équipes métiers, BI et IA ainsi qu'avec les data stewards.

Responsabilités clés

Data stewardship et communauté

  • Définir les rôles et les responsabilités des data stewards et des data owners.
  • Accompagner et coacher les data stewards et les data owners.
  • Animer la communauté des data stewards, notamment au moyen de réunions, du suivi des actions et du partage de bonnes pratiques.
  • Contribuer activement au développement de la culture data au sein de l'organisation.

Catalogue de données et métadonnées

  • Coordonner et suivre l'alimentation du catalogue de données et du glossaire métier.
  • Veiller à la qualité, à la cohérence et à la complétude des métadonnées, conformément aux standards définis.
  • Favoriser l'adoption des outils de gouvernance des données.

Qualité des données

  • Initier et coordonner les travaux des data stewards dans le cadre de projets d'amélioration de la qualité des données.
  • Contribuer à la définition des règles, à la priorisation des actions, au reporting et au suivi des résultats.

Politiques et guidelines

  • Contribuer à la définition des politiques et des guidelines de gouvernance des données.

Data literacy

  • Contribuer à l'amélioration de la maturité data au moyen d'un programme de data literacy, notamment par la sélection des formations et le suivi de leur mise en œuvre.

Dans le cadre de ces activités, vous êtes en contact avec l'équipe chargée de la gestion des référentiels et des données de référence ainsi qu'avec l'équipe de validation des données, qui vous apporte son soutien.

📝 Votre profil

  • Diplôme de niveau Master en data, informatique, économie, gestion ou dans un domaine équivalent.
  • Au moins 10 ans d'expérience dans un rôle lié aux données, dont au moins 10 ans d'expérience pratique en gouvernance des données au sein d'une grande organisation.
  • Expérience pratique de la mise en œuvre et de la gestion d'un catalogue de données.
  • Connaissances de base en SQL.
  • La connaissance de DataBricks constitue un atout.
  • Connaissance pratique des outils de qualité des données et des outils de gouvernance des données.
  • Connaissance du RGPD.
  • Autonomie et motivation.
  • Excellentes aptitudes à la communication orale et écrite.
  • Néerlandais ou français comme langue maternelle, avec une connaissance de l'autre langue nationale.

Domaines d'expertise attendus

  • Data Governance : 10 ans d'expérience.
  • Data quality management : 10 ans d'expérience.
  • Management of glossaries of business terms : 5 ans d'expérience.
  • Meta data management : 5 ans d'expérience.
  • Working knowledge of data governance tools : 5 ans d'expérience.
  • Change Management : 3 ans d'expérience.
  • Master Data Management (MDM) : 3 ans d'expérience.
  • Project Management : 3 ans d'expérience.
  • SQL : niveau débutant, avec une pratique indiquée de 3 ans.

Vous ferez partie d'une PME belge en pleine croissance, où l’initiative et le développement personnel sont encouragés. Nous vous offrirons un environnement de travail agréable, entouré(e) de collègues sympathiques. Vous pouvez compter sur un salaire attractif, complété par des avantages extra-légaux, y compris une voiture de société.

Job Summary:
We are seeking an experienced Windchill Integration Developer to design, build, and operate integrations connecting PTC Windchill with ERP, MES, CAD, and other engineering and manufacturing systems. In this role you will own the technical integration layer between Windchill and the broader enterprise systems landscape. The ideal candidate will bring deep hands-on Windchill integration experience and a strong understanding of enterprise integration patterns, middleware platforms, and PLM-to-ERP data flows. In this role you will work closely with cross-functional partners — product, design, engineering, operations, and business stakeholders — to translate ambiguous requirements into well-engineered solutions, and will be expected to raise the bar through code review, design review, and mentorship of more junior engineers. The successful candidate brings strong engineering discipline, a clear communication style, and a track record of shipping meaningful work that holds up well in production.
Key Responsibilities
  • Design and develop integrations between Windchill and ERP systems (SAP, Oracle EBS, Oracle Cloud) using Info*Engine, web services, and middleware platforms.
  • Build CAD integrations for Creo, SolidWorks, AutoCAD, Catia, and NX with Windchill, including check-in/check-out workflows and metadata mapping.
  • Develop integrations between Windchill and MES, MOM, and quality systems.
  • Build REST and SOAP services for Windchill data using OData, Info*Engine, or custom Java services.
  • Implement message-based and event-driven integrations using middleware (MuleSoft, Boomi, OIC, SAP CPI).

About us

Hi, we are Ten Square Games, and we live games! No, not a typo - but a level up from loving! We are on a mission of giving players excellent outdoor experiences on their mobiles. With global hits, such as Fishing Clash, we know how to make the best of technology, fun, and fair play. With 77 million registered players in 2025 and 300+ people on board, we keep growing and learning, having the insatiable hunger for the next success. If you also like to explore the unknown and know how to own it, we want to work with you!

We are looking for a Game Designer (f/m/d) who can help make Rortos games even more engaging, rewarding and fun for players.

We create mobile games for players around the world, with a focus on immersive experiences, engaging gameplay and continuous improvement. We believe there are plenty of opportunities to improve the player experience and bring fresh ideas to our games.

What is this job all about?

We are looking for a hands-on Game Designer (f/m/d) to help us develop and improve gameplay features in Rortos games.

In this role, you will take ownership of individual features, from initial ideas and research through design, implementation and iteration. You will work with existing game systems, identify opportunities for improvement and turn ideas into practical solutions that make the game more enjoyable for players.

We are looking for someone who can work independently on well-defined areas, communicate ideas clearly and take responsibility for delivering high-quality gameplay experiences while continuing to grow as a Game Designer.

Requirements

What will you be doing?

  • Designing and improving gameplay features, taking them from concept through implementation and iteration;

  • Analysing competitor games and features to identify opportunities and propose improvements for Rortos games;

  • Defining hypotheses and measurable KPIs to evaluate the success of designed features;

  • Collaborating with developers, artists, UX designers, analysts and other team members to align implementation details and deliver features;

  • Creating prototypes, testing solutions and iterating on features based on data, player feedback and product goals;

  • Balancing gameplay mechanics, progression, rewards and economy elements to create engaging and satisfying player experiences;

  • Regularly playing and testing the games to evaluate feature quality, usability and overall player experience;

  • Preparing clear and actionable design documentation, including feature specifications, tickets, spreadsheets and configuration details;

  • Communicating task progress, sharing findings and presenting conclusions from analyses and feature evaluations;

  • Following established development processes and contributing to effective collaboration within the team.

What are we looking for?

  • Practical experience as a Game Designer, ideally in mobile F2P or live-service games;

  • Good understanding of gameplay mechanics, progression systems, player motivation and engagement loops;

  • Ability to independently design and deliver gameplay features within an established game and product direction;

  • Understanding of game economy and balancing principles, including rewards, progression and difficulty;

  • Ability to use data, player feedback and competitor analysis to make informed design decisions;

  • Familiarity with game design KPIs and the ability to define measurable goals for features;

  • Experience preparing clear design specifications and working with documentation tools and spreadsheets;

  • Good communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively across disciplines;

  • A proactive, problem-solving mindset and willingness to learn, experiment and improve existing solutions.

Amaze us with:

  • Experience working on a live mobile F2P game;

  • Familiarity with mobile game KPIs such as retention, engagement, conversion and monetization;

  • Experience balancing in-game economies, rewards or progression systems;

  • Experience creating prototypes, working with game configurations or using basic scripting tools;

  • Knowledge of tools such as spreadsheets, version control systems or game engines;

  • Interest in aviation, flight simulation or simulation-based games.

Please submit your CV in English.

raw.description:
Intetics Inc., a global technology company providing custom software application development, distributed professional teams, software product quality assessment, and “all-things-digital” solutions, is seeking a highly skilled and experienced Staff Data Scientist / Machine Learning Engineer to join our dynamic team on a full-time basis.

Responsibilities: - Design, build, and maintain predictive Lifetime Value (pLTV) models using machine learning techniques such as XGBoost, CatBoost, and probabilistic forecasting methods.

- Develop and manage a tiered scoring framework that assigns users to different prediction models based on data availability and signal quality.

- Create and optimize calibration frameworks that transform raw model outputs into business-ready values through normalization, scaling, and custom loss optimization strategies.

- Own feature engineering processes, building and maintaining scalable feature datasets from transactional, behavioral, and engagement data.

- Define and enforce feature quality standards, ensuring model inputs are reliable, relevant, and suitable for production use. - Monitor model performance, drift, and data distribution changes, proactively identifying when retraining or model adjustments are required.

- Analyze the impact of deployed models on downstream outcomes and detect feedback loops that may affect future model accuracy.

- Develop and improve identity resolution processes to unify behavioral and transactional data across multiple data sources.

- Build, test, and maintain production-grade Python services and data pipelines for model training, scoring, and signal delivery.

- Implement robust software engineering practices, including automated testing, CI/CD, monitoring, idempotent processing, and deployment safeguards.

- Collaborate with data, engineering, and product stakeholders to improve data quality, model effectiveness, and platform scalability.

- Operate and optimize ML workflows in cloud environments using orchestration, scheduling, and distributed processing tools.

- Ensure the reliability, accuracy, and scalability of machine learning systems that support critical business decision-making and performance optimization.

Requirements

  • 5+ years of hands-on ML engineering in Python with production-deployed models (not just Jupyter notebooks). You should be comfortable writing production-grade code, not just prototypes.
  • Experience with gradient boosted trees (XGBoost, CatBoost, or LightGBM) in a production setting, including hyperparameter tuning, feature importance analysis, and model evaluation beyond default metrics.
  • Strong SQL and BigQuery fluency. You will write complex feature engineering queries, scheduled transformations, and data validation logic directly in BigQuery.
  • GCP production experience. Cloud Run, Airflow/Composer, Vertex AI, Pub/Sub. You have deployed and maintained ML workloads on GCP, not just completed certification exercises.
  • Understanding of model calibration. You know the difference between a model that minimizes RMSE and a model that maximizes business value. You have experience with or strong intuition about how prediction errors compound when consumed by a downstream optimization system.
  • Outbound API integration experience. You have pushed model outputs into external systems that act on them (ad platforms, recommendation engines, pricing systems, bidding systems).

Strongly Preferred:

  • E-commerce or DTC domain experience. Customer lifetime value, purchase prediction, churn modeling, or customer segmentation for retail or subscription businesses.
  • Familiarity with probabilistic customer models (BG/NBD, Gamma-Gamma, or similar frameworks). If you haven't used these specifically, strong Bayesian statistics foundations are equally valuable.
  • Ad platform signal engineering. Experience with Google Ads API (ConversionUploadService, Enhanced Conversions), Meta Conversions API (CAPI), or similar server-side event dispatch systems.
  • Identity resolution or entity matching. Graph-based identity stitching, probabilistic matching, or CDP-style cross-device identity work.

Nice-to-have:

  • Terraform, CI/CD pipeline design, Docker containerization for ML workloads.
  • Experience with causal inference methods, A/B testing in ad spend environments, or multi-armed bandit allocation.
  • Familiarity with agentic development workflows (Claude Code, Cursor, or similar AI-assisted coding tools).

Department Name:

The future is full of possibilities. At Banner Health, we’re excited about what the future holds for health care. That’s why we’re changing the industry to make the experience the best it can be. Our team has come together with the common goal: Make health care easier, so life can be better. The future of health care starts here. If you’re ready to change lives, we want to hear from you.

We are seeking a highly strategic and results-driven Senior Strategic Sourcing Administer to lead sourcing, contract negotiation, and supplier management initiatives across high-spend clinical categories, including Cardiology, Interventional Radiology, and Imaging.


This role manages a $100M contract portfolio consisting of procurement contracts, outsourced services programs, and purchasing initiatives. The successful candidate will be responsible for maximizing organizational value while minimizing costs through effective supplier negotiations, strategic sourcing initiatives, and strong stakeholder partnerships.

This position plays a critical role in collaborating with physicians, clinical leadership, and operational leaders to develop sourcing strategies for products with a high degree of physician preference, ensuring both financial stewardship and positive patient outcomes.


Apply today to help shape the future of healthcare procurement and supply chain excellence.

Location: Remote, Banner provides equipment
Schedule: Monday-Friday, 7am - 4pm


*​This can be a remote position if you live in the following state(s) only: AZ, CA, NV, CO, NB & WY*

Within Banner Health Corporate, you will have the opportunity to apply your unique experience and expertise in support of a nationally-recognized healthcare leader. We offer stimulating and rewarding careers in a wide array of disciplines. Whether your background is in Human Resources, Finance, Information Technology, Legal, Managed Care Programs or Public Relations, you'll find many options for contributing to our award-winning patient care.

POSITION SUMMARY

This position is responsible for a $100M contract portfolio of procurement contracts, outsourced services programs, and purchasing programs, maximizing value to the company while minimizing cost from vendors and suppliers; provides high quality procurement services to meet the needs of internal customers. The incumbent is accountable for developing efficiencies and for finding new opportunities to reduce supply cost through effective vendor negotiations, and for promoting sound and ethical contracting and purchasing practices between the company and the vendor community; and for developing and maintaining positive vendor relationships based on mutual respect and trust. This position directs and leads the overall sourcing strategy for high spend product categories with a high degree of physician preference which will require collaboration with physicians and other key clinical decision makers.

CORE FUNCTIONS

1. Monitors, assesses and re-bids or re-negotiates existing contracts and vendor agreements in assigned areas as appropriate every one to three years. Regularly evaluates and revises as appropriate company participation in programs such as medical supply agreements, service agreements, capital equipment agreements and pooled purchase agreements. Monitors vendor and company/facility contract compliance and performance.

2. Identifies and develops new cost savings sources and vendor agreement opportunities through market monitoring, product research, usage, source and cost analysis, and participation in hospital or assigned area procurement association and education. Conducts analysis of products, prices and usage opportunities; prepares spreadsheets and executive summaries of contracts and presents recommendations to the Supply Chain Governance Team.

3. Manages the contracting processes for assigned areas: The development of specifications, performance of due diligence work (such as research and financial analysis) the development and writing of Requests for Proposals (RFPs), and the writing and editing of contract documents. Independently reviews complex terms and conditions, develops alternative language, performs risk analysis/mitigation, and provides recommendations while ensuring compliance with legal requirements, customer requirements. Coordinates legal review of contracts as appropriate.

4. Provides enterprise leadership and consultation to company facilities in the contracting, procurement and utilization of supplies, products and equipment for assigned service lines. Uses a variety of methods to collect collaborative input of end users and purchasers, builds detail of specification, and develops group consensus. Demonstrates ability to influence and deal tactfully and confidentially with internal and external customers at all organizational levels in a dynamic environment.

5. Facilitates implementation of new procurement processes, policies, procedures and agreements. Develops and communicates work plans to all affected parties.

6. Collects, consolidates and provides contract and procurement information to senior management in the form of reports, financial analysis, supply utilization, capital expenditures, etc. as required or appropriate.

7. Monitors usage of products under Contract Management Agreements. Assures accurate vendor payments of rebates and dividends. Serves as key contact for Supplier Relationship Management and coordinates ongoing business reviews with key suppliers.

8. Provides technical and expert counsel to other staff members in matters of assigned procurement area(s).

9. Annual dollar contracting exceeds $100 million dollars. Enterprise authority for contracting. Manages contracts for equipment, supplies and services for all company facilities.

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS

Requires the degree of skills, knowledge and ability normally demonstrated by a Bachelor’s degree in Business or a related field.

Requires seven or more years of similar purchasing experience, including capital equipment purchase, Request For Proposal development, bid analysis, contract negotiation and contracting. Requires extensive knowledge of products, procurement and contracting processes in healthcare, and demonstrated skills in the areas of planning, directing, communications, negotiations and statistical analysis. Effective organizational, communication and human relation skills are necessary, as is the ability to coordinate several projects simultaneously and effectively to meet multiple priorities. Requires the ability to travel to any company facility for meetings and product or service assessment.

Must be proficient in word processing and spreadsheet computer software applications.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

Experience working with Lawson or similar Materials Management information systems is desirable. Supervisory experience is preferred. Certified Purchasing Manager (CPM) certification is preferred. Master's degree in Supply Chain Management preferred.

Additional related education and/or experience preferred.

$44.65 - $74.41 / hourBanner Health is committed to pay equity and transparency. The posted compensation range is a reasonable estimate that extends from the lowest to the highest pay Banner Health in good faith believes it might pay for this particular job, based on the circumstances at the time of posting.This range is based on possible base salaries and does not include the value of our total rewards package. Actual pay determined at offer will be based on years of relevant work experience, education, certifications, skills, and geographic location, along with a review of current employees in similar roles to ensure pay equity is achieved and maintained.

raw.description:
At Sysdig, we believe cloud security isn't a compromise - it's a promise. From the start, our mission has been clear: to help organizations secure innovation in the cloud, the right way.
We created Falco, the open standard for cloud threat detection, and continue to lead the cloud security market with runtime insights, open innovation, and agentic Al. Creators of technology trusted by over 60% of the Fortune 500, Sysdig gives teams the real-time clarity to move fast and defend what matters most.
Culture matters here. We believe diversity fuels stronger ideas, and open dialogue drives sharper decisions. Recognized as a Best Place to Work and one of Deloitte's fastest-growing companies for the past 5 years, we're here to raise the standard for what cloud security and workplace culture should be.
If you have the passion to dig deeper, the desire to challenge convention, and the curiosity to build something better, Sysdig is the right place for you.

What you will do

  • Own hosting/cloud cost transparency: build reporting and dashboards on unit economics and cost drivers by product, team, and workload.
  • Partner with engineering to identify and execute cost-saving opportunities, including rightsizing, reserved capacity, architecture changes, and non-production environment efficiency.
  • Build cost governance for AI/GPU compute and security telemetry pipelines as they scale with our AI-driven detection capabilities, including data retention and lifecycle decisions made in partnership with Security and Compliance.
  • Manage cost and pricing tradeoffs across our multi-cloud, multi-region infrastructure, including data transfer, residency, and compliance costs.
  • Translate infrastructure costs into cost-to-serve and gross-margin metrics that inform pricing and competitive strategy.
  • Partner with engineering leadership through a regular cadence to keep cost initiatives moving to closure, and report on savings delivered.
  • Embed directly with engineering teams to establish cost-aware architecture patterns, automated tagging hygiene, and regular cost-review cadences.

What you will bring with you

  • 8+ years in FinOps, cloud cost optimization, or operational cost management, with proven experience leading enterprise-wide cost initiatives and influencing cross-functional leaders.
  • Demonstrated track record of reducing cloud/hosting spend at scale (AWS, GCP, or Azure).
  • Strong grasp of unit economics, with the ability to translate technical infrastructure costs into metrics that finance and business leaders act on.
  • Experience building governance processes and cross-functional accountability, and comfortable operating with significant autonomy in a highly visible role.
  • Proven ability to establish cross-functional governance structures across Finance, Product, and Engineering leadership to drive accountability.
  • Experience with GPU/AI compute cost optimization and/or high-volume data pipeline cost management.
  • Deep familiarity with multi-cloud architectures (AWS, GCP, Azure) and massive-scale data ingestion/telemetry pipelines.

What we look for

  • FinOps Certified Practitioner (FOCP), or equivalent hands-on experience, and familiarity with the FOCUS (FinOps Open Cost and Usage Specification) framework.
  • Experience optimizing the cost of GPU/AI compute, or of high-volume data pipelines.
  • Hands-on experience with multi-cloud architectures (AWS, GCP, Azure) and large-scale telemetry or data ingestion pipelines.

When you join Sysdig, you can expect

  • Extra days off to prioritize your well-being
  • 401(k) Retirement Savings Plan with a 3% company match
  • Maternity and Parental Leave
  • Mental health support for you and your family through the Modern Health app
  • Full health benefits package for you and your family
The U.S. annual salary range for this full-time position is between 198,000 and 247,000 USD/year. Actual offers may be higher or lower than this range based on a variety of factors, including your work location, job-related experience and education.
We would love for you to join us! Please reach out even if your experience doesn't perfectly match the job description. We can always explore other options after starting the conversation. Your background and passion will set you apart, especially if your career path is different.
Sysdig values a diverse workplace and encourages women, people of color, LGBTQIA+ individuals, people with disabilities, members of ethnic minorities, foreign-born residents, and veterans to apply. Sysdig is an equal-opportunity employer. raw.description:
Bright Vision Technologies is a forward-thinking software development company dedicated to building innovative solutions that help businesses automate and optimize their operations. We leverage cutting-edge technologies to create scalable, secure, and user-friendly applications.

As we continue to grow, we’re looking for a skilled CRM Integration Architect to join our dynamic team and contribute to our mission of transforming business processes through technology.

This is a fantastic opportunity to join an established and well-respected organization offering tremendous career growth potential.

Job Title: CRM Integration Architect

Location: 100% Remote (Continental United States)
Position Type: In-house Bright Vision Technologies SOW engagement (no third-party client or vendor)
Salary: $100K - $150K
Experience: 8+ years

Employment Terms & Visa Policy
This is a 100% remote, full-time, direct W2 position with Bright Vision Technologies.
This role is part of Bright Vision Technologies’ in-house Statement of Work (SOW) engagement. The client, end customer, and employer for this position is Bright Vision Technologies — there is no third-party client, vendor, or implementation partner involved.
We do not engage in C2C, 1099, or third-party arrangements for this role.

Candidates must be willing to work directly as a full-time W2 employee of Bright Vision Technologies and contribute to our in-house SOW deliverables.
No new H1B sponsorship is available for this role.

However, candidates who are currently on a valid H1B visa and require a transfer are welcome to apply. We will support H1B transfers for qualified candidates.
For every role, a technical coding assessment is mandatory. Please apply only if you are confident in your technical abilities and hands-on experience.

Job Summary
We are seeking a CRM Integration Architect to design and govern integrations between Salesforce and the broader enterprise application landscape. The role focuses on integration architecture, middleware selection, API strategy, and event-driven patterns that connect Salesforce reliably with ERP, data, marketing, and operational systems. The ideal candidate has architected Salesforce integration solutions at meaningful scale and brings deep familiarity with both Salesforce-native and enterprise middleware approaches. In this role you will work closely with cross-functional partners — product, design, engineering, operations, and business stakeholders — to translate ambiguous requirements into well-engineered solutions, and will be expected to raise the bar through code review, design review, and mentorship of more junior engineers. The successful candidate brings strong engineering discipline, a clear communication style, and a track record of shipping meaningful work that holds up well in production.

Key Responsibilities
  • Define the end-to-end integration architecture for Salesforce ecosystems spanning Sales, Service, Marketing, and Industry Clouds.
  • Select and apply appropriate integration patterns including request-reply, fire-and-forget, batch, and event-driven approaches.
  • Design integrations using Salesforce-native capabilities (Platform Events, Change Data Capture, Connect, Composite APIs) alongside enterprise middleware such as MuleSoft, Boomi, or Informatica.
  • Lead integration design reviews and approve technical designs across Salesforce programs.
  • Define API strategy, contract management, and versioning standards for Salesforce-related integrations.
  • Architect data synchronization patterns for high-volume integrations with ERP, billing, and operational systems.
  • Design identity and access patterns for Salesforce integrations including OAuth flows and connected app management.
  • Establish error handling, retry, and dead-letter strategies that ensure reliable integration operations.
  • Drive performance, scalability, and governor-limit management for integration-heavy Salesforce implementations, designing patterns that stay safely within platform limits even as transaction volumes grow over time.
  • Collaborate with security teams to ensure integrations meet enterprise security requirements.
  • Mentor and coach junior and mid-level engineers through code review, design review, pair programming, and structured knowledge sharing, helping the broader team grow in technical maturity and confidence over time.
  • Produce high-quality architecture artifacts — context diagrams, sequence diagrams, decision records, and reference designs — that capture key technical decisions clearly enough to be understood months or years later.
  • Collaborate closely with vendors to evaluate and onboard integration platforms, gathering requirements, aligning on technical approach, and ensuring that delivered solutions meet both functional needs and broader engineering and operational standards.
  • Stay current with Salesforce integration capabilities and broader iPaaS evolution.

Required Qualifications
  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science or a related field.
  • Eight or more years of Salesforce experience, with significant time on complex integrations.
  • Deep understanding of Salesforce APIs, Platform Events, and Change Data Capture.
  • Hands-on experience with at least one major iPaaS such as MuleSoft, Boomi, or Informatica.
  • Strong understanding of integration patterns and enterprise application architecture.
  • Experience designing data synchronization strategies with ERP and operational systems.
  • Strong understanding of identity, OAuth, and integration security.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
  • Salesforce Certified Integration Architect credential.
  • Track record of leading large Salesforce integration programs.

Preferred Qualifications
  • MuleSoft Certified Platform Architect.
  • Experience with event-driven integration platforms (Kafka, Solace, Confluent).
  • Familiarity with Industry Clouds and their data-integration nuances.
  • Exposure to high-volume integration scenarios (10M+ records/day).
  • Experience integrating Salesforce with SAP, Oracle, or NetSuite ERP systems.

How to Apply
Would you like to know more about this opportunity?
For immediate consideration, please send your resume to or contact us at (908) 505-3544. Learn more about Bright Vision Technologies at www.bvteck.com.
We recognize that our people are our strength, and the diverse talents they bring to our global workforce are directly linked to our success. We are an equal opportunity employer and place a high value on diversity and inclusion at our company.
We do not discriminate on the basis of any protected attribute, including race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, marital or veteran status, pregnancy or disability, or any other basis protected under applicable law. We also make reasonable accommodations for applicants’ and employees’ religious practices and beliefs, as well as mental health or physical disability needs.
Bright Vision Technologies is an Equal Opportunity Employer, including Disability/Veterans.
Position offered by “No Fee Agency.”

Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO) Statement

Bright Vision Technologies (BV Teck) is committed to equal employment opportunity (EEO) for all employees and applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, genetic information, disability, veteran status, or any other protected status as defined by applicable federal, state, or local laws. This commitment extends to all aspects of employment, including recruitment, hiring, training, compensation, promotion, transfer, leaves of absence, termination, layoffs, and recall.

raw.description:
Get to know us better

CodiLime is a software and network engineering industry expert and the first-choice service partner for top global networking hardware providers, software providers and telecoms. We create proofs-of-concept, help our clients build new products, nurture existing ones and provide services in production environments. Our clients include both tech startups and big players in various industries and geographic locations (US, Japan, Israel, Europe).

While no longer a startup - we have 250+ people on board and have been operating since 2011 we’ve kept our people-oriented culture. Our values are simple:

  • Act to deliver.

  • Disrupt to grow.

  • Team up to win.

The project and the team

You will join a team co-developing a unified network security management platform from a leading cybersecurity vendor. You will be building functionality that automates and facilitates the conversion and onboarding of existing network security estate configurations within that platform.

The solution's foundation rests on several years of experience delivering large-scale migration projects that would not have been possible without specialized automation software. That expertise, together with AI-assisted development, helps the team move fast and consistently land high-quality results.

As the software keeps expanding and becoming a fully-fledged product, we're looking for another Senior Software Engineer to help build what's next. It is as much a product engineering challenge as a technical one.

Other things to know:

  • The team consists of software engineers and network security SMEs who share strong ownership of code and product quality

  • AI tools are part of the daily workflow

  • This is a backend-focused role

  • We are a distributed, fully remote team

We work on multiple interesting projects at a time, so it may happen that we'll invite you to an interview for another project if we see that your competencies and profile are well suited for it.

Your role

As a part of the project team, you will be responsible for:

  • Designing, building, and maintaining the software product and the underlying libraries

  • Building a self-service product: with actionable errors, predictable behavior, and a path a customer can complete without specialized assistance

  • Deciding what gets generalized and what gets built once - some capability is shared, some is specific, and keeping that cost curve falling is the central architectural judgment in this role

  • Owning and leading technical initiatives to successful delivery, from the design document through to release

  • Acting as the technical counterpart to the teams around you - raising dependencies early and in writing, rather than discovering them at integration time

  • Maintaining appropriate test coverage and helping shape the overall testing strategy

  • Applying AI-assisted engineering practices and setting the standard for how they are used - across the entire SDLC, not only in code generation

  • Contributing to architecture and design decisions as the solution scales in different dimensions

  • Proposing and helping ship your own ideas for improving the product, beyond your core delivery work

Do we have a match?

As a Senior Software Engineer, you must meet the following criteria:

  • Strong, 7+ years professional experience with modern Python - we run 3.14 and stay close to the latest release

  • Experience building and maintaining software products for external customers

  • Experience owning an architecture end to end, including the part where you align teams you have no authority over

  • Hands-on, everyday use of AI coding tools in your engineering workflow, with a considered view of where they earn their keep and where they do not

  • Solid testing experience and ability to pick the right testing strategy

  • Experience building and maintaining integrations or API clients

  • Experience with data modeling and transformation - parsers, intermediate representations, schema-driven conversion or similar

  • Fluency with Pydantic and with strict static typing (mypy or equivalent) as a daily discipline

  • CI/CD experience

  • Comfortable in a fast-paced environment where priorities are set as much by customers as by the backlog

  • Open for technical challenges and open-mindedly looking for technical solutions to business problems

  • Very good command of English (ideally C1 level) - spoken and written

Beyond the criteria above, we would appreciate the following:

  • Experience with workflow or orchestration engines (e.g. Temporal)

  • Experience with Docker and Kubernetes

  • Experience with SQLAlchemy, or ORM-based data modeling more broadly

  • Experience with migration, import or ETL-style tooling

  • Experience with asynchronous Python

  • Experience with XML at scale, or grammar-based configuration parsing (e.g. TextFSM)

  • Experience with Go

  • Experience with observability tooling (e.g. OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, Grafana)

  • Experience with modern Python packaging and tooling (uv, ruff)

  • Working understanding of core networking concepts (TCP/IP, VLAN, NAT, ACL, firewalls, routing)

More reasons to join us

  • Flexible working hours and approach to work: fully remotely, in the office or hybrid

  • Professional growth supported by internal training sessions and a training budget

  • Solid onboarding with a hands-on approach to give you an easy start

  • A great atmosphere among professionals who are passionate about their work

  • The ability to change the project you work on

raw.description:
Revolution Medicines is a global, commercial-state oncology company dedicated to discovering, developing and delivering innovative medicines for patients with RAS-addicted cancers. Leveraging its differentiated RAS(ON) tri-complex inhibitor platform, the company is advancing a broad, integrated portfolio of oral RAS(ON) inhibitors designed to directly target the active, cancer-driving state of RAS. Founded on rigorous scientific inquiry and a willingness to challenge long-held assumptions, Revolution Medicines is committed to changing the trajectory of disease for patients with RAS-addicted cancers worldwide.

Our people are united by a shared way of working: follow the science, challenge assumptions, act with urgency and hold ourselves to a high standard of rigor—all in service of patients.

The Opportunity:

Reporting to the Country Manager Poland, the Director, Medical Affairs, Poland is the medical leader responsible for defining and executing the local medical strategy RevMed portfolio and launches. This role serves as the medical voice within the Poland Leadership Team, ensuring scientific excellence, compliant medical engagement, and strong alignment between global strategy and local patient, physician, and healthcare system needs.

This leader will ensure that Poland medical considerations are embedded in the regional medical strategy and plans and will partner with the Country Manager and crossfunctional teams, as well as the Sr Dir Medical Affairs Midsized Markets and VP Head of Europe Medical Affairs and their leadership team. The incumbent will contribute to building the Poland medical team and work closely with the Midsized Markets crossfunctional and cross-country teams, Global and Regional Medical Affairs teams across Med Affairs functions.

Required Experience:

  • Act as the Medical Affairs lead for Poland, accountable for local medical strategy, execution, and impact across the oncology portfolio.

  • Translate global medical and clinical strategies into locally relevant medical plans aligned with country regulations and clinical practice .

  • Build and maintain strong relationships with national and regional key opinion leaders, oncology networks, academic institutions, and scientific societies.

  • Lead scientific exchange, advisory boards, investigator and other external meetings, press conferences, and congress engagement at country level.

  • Collaborate effectively with Midsized Markets, Regional and Global teams by contributing to overall medical affairs strategy, strongly partnering with local, regional and global clinical development and operations teams.

  • Drive local medical strategy across pre-launch, launch, and post-launch phases.

  • Provide local medical expertise on evidence generation activities including local studies, real-world evidence initiatives, and investigator-initiated research (where permitted).

  • Ensure effective execution of publication plans and scientific communication activities.

  • Lead medical launch readiness for oncology products, including training, scientific materials, and field medical engagement plans.

  • Partner with Market Access and Commercial teams to support value communication and reimbursement-related interactions from a medical perspective, e.g. representing and defining evidence and value of innovation at oral HTA hearings.

  • Support lifecycle management activities including new indications, label updates, and competitive positioning.

  • Work closely with Market Access, Commercial, Regulatory, Safety, and Corporate Affairs teams to ensure aligned and compliant execution of country plans.

  • Provide medical review and approval of non-promotional materials in accordance with local regulations and company policies.

  • Build, lead, and develop the country Medical Affairs team when/if applicable, including Medical advisors and MSLs.

  • Establish medical processes, governance, and ways of working as part of the country build-out.

  • Foster a culture of scientific rigor, compliance, and collaboration.

  • Ensure all medical activities comply with local regulations, national and regional codes, and internal company policies.

  • Represent Medical Affairs in country governance and risk management forums.

Required Skills:

  • Advanced degree required (MD, PhD, or PharmD).

  • Strong background and experience in oncology required.

  • 10+ years’ experience in Medical Affairs with a track record of country leadership.

  • Proven value and benefit assessment experience, with deep understanding of Poland payer decision-making.

  • Strong stakeholder management and ability to collaborate with internal and external partners.

  • Proven experience supporting oncology product launches in Poland.

  • Strong understanding of the local healthcare system, clinical practice, and regulatory environment.

  • Experience in a biotech and/or in a build-out.

  • Excellent communication skills, both in person and virtual.

  • Proven leadership and people management capabilities; demonstrated success in small but fast growing, entrepreneurial environment.

  • Scientific and solution-orientated mindset and capability to move and execute in a rapidly changing, ambiguous environment.

  • Strong understanding of local healthcare systems, customer dynamics, and reimbursement environments.

  • Willingness to travel nationally and internationally.

Revolution Medicines takes protection and security of personal data very seriously and respects your right to privacy while using our website and when contacting us by email or phone. raw.description:
Our client in the US is a 10+ year old, family-founded childrens learning brand. They believe learning should be fun, beautiful, and screen-free. Millions of parents and teachers trust their products to spark curiosity and confidence in children, and they are growing fast through authentic creator partnerships that share that mission.

They are looking for an Affiliate and Influencer Program Manager who has already built and scaled affiliate programs for e-commerce brands and is ready to do it again with them. You'll design the program, set the economics, build the systems, and turn hundreds of creators and affiliates into a reliable source of sales across TikTok Shop, Amazon, and Shopify. You'll also be the coach their creators rally around, running their creator calls, supporting their success, and keeping the excitement high.

This role is half program builder and half creator coach, and it is not tied to one platform. TikTok Shop carries most of their affiliate sales today, Amazon is growing fast, and Shopify comes next. Affiliate is changing fast, and they want the person who knows what great programs have looked like so far and has a clear view of what the next great one looks like. You'll report to the CEO and have the room to build a multimillion-dollar program across every channel they sell on.

What You'll Own

  • Program design. Build one affiliate and creator program across TikTok Shop, Amazon, and Shopify, with each channel's role, economics, and tracking set deliberately, and clear tiers, commissions, and incentives.
  • Creator coaching. Coach the creators and oversee their success, run the creator calls, give clear feedback, and keep the community excited and posting.
  • Where affiliate goes next. Watch platform changes, new affiliate and creator models, and AI tools, and test them in small bets before they matter.
  • Program economics. Own sample spend, commissions, and retainers, and measure what every dollar returns in sales and margin.
  • Creator pipeline at scale. Direct a sourcing team to keep a steady flow of creators who fit their ideal creator profile.
  • Top affiliates. Recruit, grow, and keep the affiliates and creators who drive the most sales.
  • Content that keeps working. Get the best creator content into their paid media so it keeps selling on Amazon and Shopify.
  • Systems. Run the program on a clean CRM, documented processes, and AI-powered workflows that don't need daily hand-holding.

How Success Is Measured

  • Affiliate-driven sales growing month over month across channels.
  • Program profitability after samples, commissions, retainers, and product costs.
  • Growth in sales from their top affiliates.
  • Creators posting consistently and growing their results under your coaching.
  • A program that runs on systems, not on one person.

Requirements

Who You Are

You are a clear communicator who can build trust fast. You care about excellence, follow through, and data driven decisions. You understand affiliate marketing and know how to motivate creators without hand holding. You thrive on structure, relationships, and momentum.

You have:

  • 3+ years of experience in affiliate or influencer marketing for e-commerce brands.
  • Built and scaled an affiliate or creator program for at least one other e-commerce brand, and you can show the numbers.
  • Hands-on experience running affiliate on at least two of TikTok Shop, Amazon, and Shopify, and the range to run all three.
  • A point of view on where affiliate is going next, and one thing you built ahead of the curve.
  • A strong grasp of program economics, from commission structures to cost per creator to margin.
  • Experience coaching creators and leading a sourcing team or virtual assistants.
  • AI capability, a CRM and documented SOPs. You use AI every day to get more done with less, which is a must-have here and a capability rather than any one tool, and you have a clear view of how all three make a program run better now and going.

About Zinier

80% of the workers across the globe are Deskless. These are the people who keep our lights on and gas flowing, build roads and bridges, run our manufacturing factories, ensure that we get healthcare service, and provide us with reliable phone and internet connectivity. As entrepreneurs, have we considered solving their problems and making them more productive?

Zinier is a company on a mission to empower frontline workers - and the people supporting them - to achieve greater things for themselves and the world around them. With the majority of workers worldwide being deskless, Zinier recognizes the need for Technology Equity to improve the lives and productivity of these workers who keep the world up and running.

We have global team headquartered in Silicon Valley, with a hybrid workforce across the United States, Canada, Europe, Latin America, Singapore, and Bangalore, India, with leading investors that include Accel, ICONIQ Capital, Founders Fund, Newfund Capital, NGP Capital, Tiger Global Management, and Qualcomm Ventures LLC.

What we are looking for

Are you passionate about turning technology adoption into measurable business outcomes such as Adoption, GRR and NRR? Do you thrive in the complex dance of managing multiple stakeholders whilst keeping your eye on the strategic prize? Zinier is searching for a hands-on, customer-obsessed Customer Success Manager who sees challenges as opportunities and customer success as the ultimate win.

In this high-impact role, you will be the trusted advisor who ensures our customers don't just implement our platform — they transform their operations with it. A core part of how you do that is through close partnership with our Solution Architects: you will co-own the customer engagement from a technical and strategic standpoint, bridging business outcomes with platform capability. You bring enough of a technical foundation to get into the details, earn credibility with IT and operations teams, and know when to escalate versus when to solve it yourself.

You are also an operator who thinks about leverage. You actively look for ways to automate repeatable parts of your role, experiment with AI tools, and approach workflow efficiency as a professional discipline.

This isn't a passive monitoring role. You will be in the trenches with customers, solving problems in real-time, spotting expansion opportunities, and constantly iterating on how we drive adoption and value realisation. You will need to zoom out to see the strategic vision, then zoom in to troubleshoot a workflow issue — sometimes in the same conversation.

Bring your consulting instincts, your technical curiosity, your hustler mentality, and your genuine passion for customer success with a measurable outcomes driven approach. This is your opportunity to shape how field service organisations transform, one successful deployment at a time.

What the role offers

  • Own post-implementation customer journeys for a portfolio of accounts, driving adoption from go-live through sustained value delivery and measurable ROI achievement
  • Proactively monitor customer health (usage, sentiment, support tickets) and orchestrate interventions before issues escalate into churn risks
  • Lead Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs) that demonstrate ROI, identify expansion opportunities, and strengthen executive relationships
  • Navigate complex stakeholder environments, building trusted relationships across operational teams, IT, and service delivery leadership
  • Facilitate adoption activities (workshops, training, change management) that transform user resistance into platform advocacy and feature utilisation
  • Identify and qualify expansion opportunities based on customer maturity and usage patterns; own or support renewal processes to achieve NRR targets
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with PS on handoffs, Support on escalations, Product on roadmap feedback, and Sales on commercial opportunities
  • Automate your workflows by actively identifying automation opportunities, from health monitoring to engagement cadences and implement AI-driven approaches that improve scale and efficiency
  • Drive continuous improvement by developing repeatable playbooks, experimenting with engagement approaches, and contributing to evolving CS methodology

What you’ll bring to the role

  • 5-8 years in customer success, account management, or consulting within B2B SaaS; proven track record managing complex relationships and delivering measurable outcomes such as GRR, Expansion ARR and Adoption in fast-paced environments
  • Exceptional stakeholder orchestration skills: Navigate multi-layered organisations, influence without authority, and craft compelling narratives for diverse audiences
  • Strategic thinker with bias to action: Balance long-term vision with tactical execution; make decisions with 70% data, zoom in/out as needed
  • First-principles problem solver: Strong business acumen with grasp of operational metrics, ROI modelling, and data-driven decision making
  • Technical fluency and change management expertise: You have a technical foundation that lets you engage credibly in configuration-level conversations, partner effectively with Solution Architects, troubleshoot platform issues without needing a translator and deploy adoption interventions that overcome resistance
  • Field operations experience is a meaningful plus: exposure to field service management, industrial workforce operations, or enterprise operations platforms helps you speak your customers' language from day one
  • Hustler mentality with customer empathy: Resourceful, persistent, opportunistic; genuine passion for customer success with comfort navigating complexity
  • AI-forward mindset: you actively experiment with AI tools, look for automation opportunities within your own workflow, and treat efficiency improvement as a professional discipline, not a future aspiration
  • Excellent communication and facilitation: Experience leading workshops, executive presentations, and training; ability to distil complexity into actionable insights
  • Be Hungry. Be Humble. Be Honest. And Hustle.

Own the customer journey. Drive transformation. Be the reason our customers thrive.

Overview of 66degrees

66degrees is an end-to-end AI transformation partner that guides enterprises from complex business challenges to clear, quantifiable outcomes. Our company is the culmination of several successful firms, each a leader in its own right in cloud, artificial intelligence, and data. This convergence of talent and expertise is how we help businesses reach their own "inflection point," where chaotic data becomes a strategic asset, complexity becomes clarity, and AI becomes an engine for growth. Our ultimate vision is to be the catalyst for a future where every business operates as an intelligent enterprise, with autonomous systems unlocking human potential.

At 66degrees, we believe in thriving through challenges and winning together. These values not only guide us in achieving our goals as a company but also for our people. We are dedicated to creating a significant impact for our employees by fostering a culture that sparks innovation and supports professional and personal growth along the way.

Overview of Role

66degrees’ Managed Cloud Optimization (MCO) team works with some of the largest cloud users in the world to help them transform their businesses with technology. Our Site Reliability Engineers (SREs) combine Google Cloud Platform expertise with a passion for devops methodologies to help our clients maintain, optimize, and scale their cloud implementations.

On a daily basis, our SREs work with varied and exciting customers on topics ranging from solving critical outages to designing and deploying new cloud workloads to building self-healing automation. Our SREs work with cutting-edge Google Cloud technologies like Google Kubernetes Engine (GKE), Anthos, BigQuery and data pipelines, as well as leading 3rd party tools like Prometheus, Datadog, and many others. Our SREs also work with languages like Python and Terraform to create automation, deploy infrastructure, and contribute to open-sourcing.

If you’re looking to continually build and apply your Google Cloud expertise to new and varied environments while acting as a key contributor to building the best Google consulting partner in the industry – let’s talk.

Responsibilities

Our ideal candidate will understand the value of teamwork. We are looking for the right fit with our rapidly growing organization and will invest in training.

We are based in Chicago, Illinois and Denver, Colorado. Remote candidates should not hesitate applying. A 66degrees’ Site Reliability Engineer’s responsibilities and duties are as follows:

  • Ensure near-zero downtime with monitoring and alerting, self-healing automation, and continuous improvement
  • Create highly automated, available and scalable systems by applying software and infrastructure principles
  • Employ and advise clients on DevOps and SRE principles and practices, covering deployment pipelines, HA, service reliability, technical debt, and operational toil for live services running at scale
  • Provide a proactive approach to our clients’ workloads, anticipating failures, automating tasks, ensuring availability, and providing a great customer experience

  • Contribute to ad-hoc initiatives such as writing documentation, open-sourcing, and improving operation, making a huge impact at a rapid-growth Google Premier Partner

Qualifications

  • Minimum 3+ years of cloud and infrastructure experience, including demonstrated expertise with Linux, Windows, k8s, databases, and networking services
  • 2+ years of Google Cloud experience and related certifications strongly preferred but not required
  • Proficiency with Python required. Other programming language experience is a plus
  • Strong provisioning and configuration skills using Terraform
  • Experience with 24x7x365 monitoring, incident response, and on-call support.
  • Experience in troubleshooting that spans systems, network, and code
  • Experience determining & negotiating Error budgets, SLIs, SLOs, and SLAs with product owners
  • Demonstrate the ability to work independently and as a member of a greater team, including cross-team activities
  • Experience working in Agile Scrum, Kanban methodologies in SDLC
  • Proven experience balancing service reliability, metrics, sustainability, technical debt, and operational toil for live services running at scale
  • Strong communication skills, as this is a heavily customer-facing role
  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, electrical engineering, or equivalent required

Please note, we cannot sponsor or transfer any visas, of any kind, at this time.

66degrees is an Equal Opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to actual or perceived race, color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, national origin, age, weight, height, marital status, sexual orientation, veteran status, disability status or other legally protected class.
