Get to know us better

CodiLime is a software and network engineering industry expert and the first-choice service partner for top global networking hardware providers, software providers and telecoms. We create proofs-of-concept, help our clients build new products, nurture existing ones and provide services in production environments. Our clients include both tech startups and big players in various industries and geographic locations (US, Japan, Israel, Europe).

While no longer a startup - we have 250+ people on board and have been operating since 2011 we’ve kept our people-oriented culture. Our values are simple:

  • Act to deliver.

  • Disrupt to grow.

  • Team up to win.

The project and the team

You will join a team co-developing a unified network security management platform from a leading cybersecurity vendor. You will be building functionality that automates and facilitates the conversion and onboarding of existing network security estate configurations within that platform.

The solution's foundation rests on several years of experience delivering large-scale migration projects that would not have been possible without specialized automation software. That expertise, together with AI-assisted development, helps the team move fast and consistently land high-quality results.

As the software keeps expanding and becoming a fully-fledged product, we're looking for another Senior Software Engineer to help build what's next. It is as much a product engineering challenge as a technical one.

Other things to know:

  • The team consists of software engineers and network security SMEs who share strong ownership of code and product quality

  • AI tools are part of the daily workflow

  • This is a backend-focused role

  • We are a distributed, fully remote team

We work on multiple interesting projects at a time, so it may happen that we'll invite you to an interview for another project if we see that your competencies and profile are well suited for it.

Your role

As a part of the project team, you will be responsible for:

  • Designing, building, and maintaining the software product and the underlying libraries

  • Building a self-service product: with actionable errors, predictable behavior, and a path a customer can complete without specialized assistance

  • Deciding what gets generalized and what gets built once - some capability is shared, some is specific, and keeping that cost curve falling is the central architectural judgment in this role

  • Owning and leading technical initiatives to successful delivery, from the design document through to release

  • Acting as the technical counterpart to the teams around you - raising dependencies early and in writing, rather than discovering them at integration time

  • Maintaining appropriate test coverage and helping shape the overall testing strategy

  • Applying AI-assisted engineering practices and setting the standard for how they are used - across the entire SDLC, not only in code generation

  • Contributing to architecture and design decisions as the solution scales in different dimensions

  • Proposing and helping ship your own ideas for improving the product, beyond your core delivery work

Do we have a match?

As a Senior Software Engineer, you must meet the following criteria:

  • Strong, 7+ years professional experience with modern Python - we run 3.14 and stay close to the latest release

  • Experience building and maintaining software products for external customers

  • Experience owning an architecture end to end, including the part where you align teams you have no authority over

  • Hands-on, everyday use of AI coding tools in your engineering workflow, with a considered view of where they earn their keep and where they do not

  • Solid testing experience and ability to pick the right testing strategy

  • Experience building and maintaining integrations or API clients

  • Experience with data modeling and transformation - parsers, intermediate representations, schema-driven conversion or similar

  • Fluency with Pydantic and with strict static typing (mypy or equivalent) as a daily discipline

  • CI/CD experience

  • Comfortable in a fast-paced environment where priorities are set as much by customers as by the backlog

  • Open for technical challenges and open-mindedly looking for technical solutions to business problems

  • Very good command of English (ideally C1 level) - spoken and written

Beyond the criteria above, we would appreciate the following:

  • Experience with workflow or orchestration engines (e.g. Temporal)

  • Experience with Docker and Kubernetes

  • Experience with SQLAlchemy, or ORM-based data modeling more broadly

  • Experience with migration, import or ETL-style tooling

  • Experience with asynchronous Python

  • Experience with XML at scale, or grammar-based configuration parsing (e.g. TextFSM)

  • Experience with Go

  • Experience with observability tooling (e.g. OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, Grafana)

  • Experience with modern Python packaging and tooling (uv, ruff)

  • Working understanding of core networking concepts (TCP/IP, VLAN, NAT, ACL, firewalls, routing)

More reasons to join us

  • Flexible working hours and approach to work: fully remotely, in the office or hybrid

  • Professional growth supported by internal training sessions and a training budget

  • Solid onboarding with a hands-on approach to give you an easy start

  • A great atmosphere among professionals who are passionate about their work

  • The ability to change the project you work on

Clinical Leads ensure clinical delivery to customers, lead clinical teams and partner with Project Leaders and other functional teams ensuring projects meet delivery requirements at all times.

Essential Functions

  • Identify clinical stakeholder landscape for the project and manage both internal and external stakeholders through effective communication and resolution management.

  • Requires 5 years clinical research/monitoring experience or equivalent combination of education, training and experience. Req

  • Knowledge of clinical trials - Knowledge of clinical trial conduct in addition to skill in applying applicable clinical research regulatory requirements i.e. International Conference on Harmonization (ICH) and Good Clinical Practice (GCP) and relevant local laws, regulations and guidelines, towards clinical trial conduct.
  • Communication - Strong written and verbal communication skills including good command of English language.

Remote | United States | Project-Based Independent Contractor

Compensation: $20-$50 USD/hour, based on specialty, experience, and project requirements

Help Shape the Future of AI in Pharmaceutical

What if your expertise in pharmaceutical manufacturing, process optimization, technology transfer, and Manufacturing Science & Technology (MSAT) could help artificial intelligence better understand pharmaceutical production processes, operational excellence, and manufacturing best practices?

At Volga Partners, we're connecting experienced pharmaceutical professionals with opportunities to contribute to the development and evaluation of advanced AI models.

We're seeking experienced Pharmaceutical Manufacturing and MSAT professionals who can apply their manufacturing expertise, technical judgment, and industry knowledge to evaluate AI-generated pharmaceutical content.

Your pharmaceutical expertise is what matters. AI experience is a plus, not a requirement.


Important Note: This is a freelance, task-based role designed for those seeking supplemental income. It’s essential to understand the nature of freelance work—tasks will be assigned as they become available, and work may be irregular or intermittent.

The Opportunity

As a Pharmaceutical Manufacturing / Manufacturing Science & Technology (MSAT) Subject Matter Expert (SME), you'll serve as a subject matter evaluator, helping assess the quality, accuracy, completeness, and scientific validity of Pharmaceutical AI-generated content.

You'll analyze manufacturing, process engineering, technology transfer, operational excellence, facility operations, and quality-related scenarios, identify errors or unsupported conclusions, and provide expert feedback grounded in pharmaceutical manufacturing principles, regulatory expectations, and industry best practices.

Your contributions will help improve how AI systems understand and respond to complex pharmaceutical and biotechnology challenges.

What You'll Do

  • Evaluate AI-generated pharmaceutical content: Assess scientific, technical, and regulatory responses for accuracy, completeness, consistency, and compliance with industry standards.
  • Review scientific and regulatory information: Examine content related to quality systems, manufacturing, validation, submissions, development, and compliance activities.
  • Analyze technical reasoning: Determine whether AI-generated conclusions are supported by relevant scientific principles, regulatory expectations, and industry best practices.
  • Identify errors and inconsistencies: Recognize unsupported claims, technical inaccuracies, missing context, and flawed reasoning.
  • Validate information: Reference relevant FDA requirements, GMP regulations, ICH guidelines, and accepted pharmaceutical industry practices.
  • Provide expert feedback: Clearly explain findings, identify opportunities for improvement, and recommend technically accurate corrections.
  • Support AI quality improvement: Apply project-specific evaluation criteria, scoring guidelines, and quality standards.
  • Complete independent evaluations: Use designated online platforms to complete assignments accurately and within established project timelines.

Why Join Volga Partners?

Apply Your Industry Expertise in a New Way
Use the knowledge you've developed throughout your pharmaceutical or biotechnology career to contribute to advanced AI technologies.

Help Improve Scientific Accuracy
Your evaluations will help strengthen the quality and reliability of AI-generated pharmaceutical and regulatory information.

Work Remotely
Participate in project-based assignments from an eligible location, with flexibility based on project needs and availability.

Explore the Future of Pharmaceutical Technology
Gain experience contributing to AI evaluation initiatives while applying your existing scientific and regulatory expertise.

No AI Background Required
We're looking for professionals who can recognize accurate scientific reasoning, identify errors, and communicate expert assessments with clarity.


Compensation:

Volga Partners offers project-based hourly compensation based on specialization, relevant experience, professional qualifications, geographic location, and assignment requirements.

Pharmaceutical Manufacturing / Manufacturing Science & Technology (MSAT) Subject Matter Expert (SME): $25-$50 USD/hour

Compensation may vary based on experience level, area of expertise, and task complexity.

Project Details

    • Engagement Type: Project-based independent contractor
    • Work Arrangement: Remote
    • Primary Location: United States preferred
    • Additional Markets: Professionals outside the United States may be considered if they possess substantial U.S. pharmaceutical industry experience
    • Schedule: Variable and assignment-based
    • Project Type: Pharmaceutical AI content evaluation
    • Project Duration: Based on project requirements and assignment availability
    • Selection Process: Qualified candidates may be required to complete screening questions and evaluation exercises prior to project selection

Specific assignments, schedules, workloads, and project dates will be communicated as they are confirmed. Hours and future assignments are not guaranteed.

Bring Your Pharmaceutical Expertise to the Future of AI

If you're an experienced pharmaceutical or biotechnology professional who enjoys analyzing complex scientific information, applying regulatory and technical expertise, and contributing to innovative technology, we'd love to hear from you.

Join Volga Partners and help shape the next generation of pharmaceutical AI.

Apply today to be considered for upcoming project opportunities.

Requirements

Who We're Looking For

We're seeking experienced Pharmaceutical Manufacturing and MSAT professionals who bring practical industry expertise and are comfortable reviewing technical information, exercising independent judgment, and clearly explaining their conclusions.

Required Qualifications

    • Minimum of 4 years of professional experience in Pharmaceutical Manufacturing, Manufacturing Science & Technology (MSAT), Technical Operations, Process Engineering, Production Support, or related pharmaceutical functions
    • Bachelor's degree or higher in Pharmaceutical Sciences, Pharmacy, Chemical Engineering, Biotechnology, Chemistry, Biochemistry, Biomedical Engineering, Life Sciences, or a related discipline
    • Experience supporting pharmaceutical manufacturing operations in GMP-regulated environments
    • Experience with process monitoring, process optimization, manufacturing investigations, or technical operations support
    • Understanding of pharmaceutical production processes and manufacturing controls
    • Knowledge of FDA regulations, GMP requirements, and relevant ICH guidelines
    • Experience reviewing manufacturing documentation, batch records, process performance data, or technical reports
    • Ability to critically evaluate technical and regulatory information
    • Strong analytical, research, and problem-solving skills
    • Excellent written English communication skills
    • Ability to work independently and follow detailed review instructions
    • Comfortable working within a task-based freelance engagement model

Preferred Qualifications

We encourage applications from professionals with backgrounds such as:

  • PharmD, MS, MBA, PhD, or other advanced scientific credentials
  • Experience supporting technology transfer from development to commercial manufacturing
  • Experience troubleshooting manufacturing deviations and process issues
  • Experience with process characterization, process validation, and continued process verification
  • Experience supporting sterile, biologic, vaccine, or oral solid dosage manufacturing operations
  • Knowledge of Lean Manufacturing, Six Sigma, Operational Excellence, or Continuous Improvement methodologies
  • Experience collaborating with Quality Assurance, Validation, Regulatory Affairs, Engineering, and Supply Chain teams
  • Experience interpreting process performance metrics and manufacturing trends
  • Experience with technical writing, investigation reports, or manufacturing documentation review
  • Technical writing or document review experience
  • Familiarity with AI evaluation, data annotation, or quality review activities

Experience with AI model evaluation, large language models (LLMs), research, or structured quality assessments is beneficial but not required.

At Presidio, we're at the forefront of a global technology revolution, transforming industries through cutting-edge digital solutions and next-generation AI. We empower businesses - and their internal customers - to achieve more through innovation, automation, and intelligent insights.

This is not just a support role. The person in this position will help users get answers, resolve issues, improve accuracy, reduce friction, and make XaitCPQ easier and more effective for the teams who depend on it.

About OpenMined

OpenMined is a 501(c)(3) non-profit foundation that brings together leading minds in AI, security, and privacy technology to develop open-source solutions that transform how data can be accessed and shared. Founded in 2017, we've grown into a global community of over 18,000 members working to ensure that privacy protection and AI innovation reinforce each other rather than undermine one another. We are driven by a simple challenge: the most valuable data for solving humanity's greatest challenges remains locked away due to privacy concerns, and we can change that through technology rather than compromise.

About the Role

We're looking for a Senior / Staff Software Engineer to join OpenMined, a nonprofit building open-source infrastructure for federated AI.

You’ll lead our 😱 ScreamingFace squad, the team that makes this vision real by building the internet's first leaderboard for fusion models (ensembles) and the open toolkit supporting benchmark evaluations for fusion models. Today, claims that the newest solo LLM beats the others are everywhere, and almost none of them can be checked or compared with the performance achieved by combining LLMs into more powerful fusion models. Results are self-reported, expensive to rerun, and hard to pick apart. We think there’s a better standard: every fusion and benchmark run compiles to a single line of text that anyone can replay for almost nothing, and a score counts only once someone else can reproduce it. The ScreamingFace toolkit is the open-source Python library and engine, leveraging our URL4 protocol, to let any researcher (a frontier lab, a university group, an independent builder) compose ensembles and routers across open and closed models, using their own keys, and grade them against pinned benchmarks. The ScreamingFace leaderboard is the public map of the quality–cost frontier, backed by a shared cache that makes every result on it cheap to verify and easy to build on.

This is a hands-on technical leadership role. You understand the long term vision. You write code. You make architecture decisions. You set engineering standards by example. You're the most experienced engineer on the squad, the person others look to for production-quality judgment, and the voice that connects this team's decisions with the organization's broader platform strategy.

The squad is talented and mission-driven and looking to strengthen its ability to continuously ship production software. You bring this production muscle: the instinct for what scales, the judgment about what to build and what to kill, and the craft to raise the team's standard through code review, pairing, and architectural guidance rather than mandates.

If you're motivated by building distributed systems that matter, mentoring brilliant people who are just getting started, and making hard technical calls in a fast-moving nonprofit that's trying to change how the world shares data — we'd love to hear from you.

You'll work most closely with Kevin McDonough, Head of Engineering.

This is an independent contractor engagement, roughly a full-time commitment, with an initial 12-month term we expect to renew. You set your own schedule, but we need your working hours to overlap substantially with US Eastern business hours (your local time between one hour behind and two hours ahead of ET).

Responsibilities

  • Own the ScreamingFace squad technical architecture end to end — align design, engineering, and deployment across the stack to deliver reliable technical capabilities and user experience from current implementation through product roadmap evolution.
  • Drive production readiness through deployment monitoring, error handling, graceful degradation, and operational runbooks.
  • Be a force multiplier by establishing, demonstrating, and mentoring the team to establish norms around engineering best practices (including system design for modularity, security, reliability, & scalability), code quality, and delivery to production.
  • Collaborate on core technology stack strategy through architectural review and identification of components that should become shared organizational primitives and defining standard interfaces that prevent tight coupling.
  • Partner with product lead to develop and execute on realistic roadmaps that balance what is desired with what is feasible, scalable, and architecturally sound.
  • Own the delivery of engineering’s quarterly goals, ensuring consistent, high-impact delivery while effectively managing resources.
  • Own team output, delivery, and success (productivity, timeliness, morale) through appropriately matching team members and work to properly balance interest, learning opportunities, capacity, and capability.
  • Champion high-quality software delivery through the establishment of robust tools, processes, & methodologies, and by providing hands-on technical leadership via individual development contributions and code reviews.
  • Create technical documentation and processes that support high velocity and knowledge transfer.

Requirements

Must-Haves

  • 8+ years of professional software engineering experience with a track record of personally building, shipping, and operating production systems at meaningful scale
  • Hands-on experience building production software with AI coding agents (e.g., Claude Code, Cursor) and helping a team manage their agentic workflows
  • Strong Python (3.12+) proficiency — FastAPI services, async orchestration of concurrent model calls, typed SDK design and packaging, and a working comfort with parsers, ASTs, and DAG execution
  • Distributed systems and API design experience including design & evolution of interfaces consumed by multiple independent teams
  • Technical leadership experience: has introduced engineering quality practices (code review, testing, CI/CD) to one or more teams and mentored or managed at least 2 engineers (direct reports not required)
  • Comfort with ambiguity and resource constraints
  • Commitment, accountability, ownership — this isn’t just a job, the release gets shipped and outages get restored
  • Async-fluent with strong written communication and capacity to build high-trust working relationships across 6hr+ time zone spread
  • Cross-functional collaboration & communication to facilitate and improve understanding/context sharing between engineers and non-engineering/non-technical stakeholders

Preferred

  • Practical RAG and information retrieval experience with vector databases, retrieval pipelines, embedding strategies, and aggregation
  • Vue 3 / TypeScript, Rust / Tauri, or cross-platform desktop app experience extremely beneficial
  • Networking/P2P application experience beneficial

Compensation

  • Contract fee: $77,000 - $128,000 USD annualized, invoiced monthly.
  • Actual offers will be determined based on the candidate's skills, level of experience, and location.

Benefits

  • Mission-Driven Work: Be part of a 501(c)(3) nonprofit organization, focused on social impact rather than profit, offering the chance to make a meaningful difference in the world.
  • Open Source Contribution: Make a real impact by contributing to an Open Source project that benefits a broad community.
  • Collaborative Global Team: Join a dynamic, international team that values collaboration and diversity.
  • Flexible Work Hours: Enjoy the autonomy to structure your work hours around what best fits your life and productivity.
  • Fully Remote Work: Work remotely within the location requirements for this role.

  • Identify and pursue new business opportunities, customers and applications for the company's product portfolio.

  • Drive the entire commercial process, from initial customer engagement and RFQs through quotations, pricing negotiations, business awards and production launch.

  • Develop account strategies to increase revenue, expand existing programs and grow the company's share of wallet.

  • Lead commercial discussions, negotiate pricing and contractual terms, and ensure sustainable business profitability.

  • Collaborate closely with engineering, R&D, program management, quality, manufacturing and supply chain teams in India.

  • Act as the key commercial link between US customers and the company's international operations.

  • Monitor market developments, identify growth opportunities and maintain a strong sales pipeline.

Your Profile

  • Proven experience in automotive OEM sales, Key Account Management or Business Development within an automotive supplier (OEM/Tier 1).

  • Direct commercial experience managing Ford as a customer is highly preferred.

  • Technical understanding of automotive components, product development and manufacturing processes.

  • Ability to build and maintain relationships with senior-level stakeholders, particularly within OEM purchasing and engineering organizations.

What’s on Offer?

  • Competitive base salary complemented by a performance-based commission structure.

raw.description:
Title:

Software Test Engineer

The Software Test Engineer is responsible for ensuring the quality, reliability, and performance of enterprise software applications through comprehensive testing and validation activities. This role works closely with software developers, product owners, business analysts, and business stakeholders to identify defects, validate requirements, and support the delivery of high-quality technology solutions. The successful candidate will contribute to both manual and automated testing efforts, helping improve testing efficiency, system reliability, and overall software quality throughout the development lifecycle.

Trinzic is being established as an independent public company through the planned separation of KBR's Mission Technology Solutions business, which is expected to be completed on January 4, 2027. This role offers a rare opportunity to join the organization during a pivotal period of growth and transformation, helping build and support technology platforms, software solutions, and digital capabilities that will position the company for long-term success while serving critical government and commercial missions around the world.

Key Responsibilities

  • Perform functional, system, integration, regression, and user acceptance testing for new and existing software applications.
  • Develop, execute, and maintain test plans, test cases, test scripts, and testing documentation based on business and technical requirements.
  • Design, develop, and maintain automated test scripts to improve testing coverage, efficiency, and repeatability.
  • Execute automated test suites and support continuous testing initiatives using established testing frameworks and tools.
  • Collaborate with software developers, business analysts, product owners, and stakeholders to understand requirements and define test scenarios and acceptance criteria.
  • Identify, document, track, and validate software defects through resolution and retesting activities.
  • Support testing activities related to system integrations, data validation, and enterprise application interoperability.
  • Participate in Agile ceremonies, including sprint planning, backlog refinement, daily standups, and sprint reviews.
  • Assist with test environment preparation, test data management, release validation, and deployment readiness activities.
  • Contribute to process improvements, automation initiatives, and quality assurance best practices that enhance product reliability and team effectiveness.

Basic Qualifications

Education & Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Software Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
  • Minimum five (5) years of experience in software quality assurance, software testing, or related technical roles.
  • Experience performing both manual and automated testing across enterprise applications.
  • Experience developing and maintaining automated test scripts and test automation frameworks.
  • Experience working within Agile and Scrum software delivery environments.
  • Understanding of software development lifecycle (SDLC), testing methodologies, and quality assurance best practices.
  • Must be a U.S. Citizen.

Technical & Leadership Skills

  • Strong knowledge of software testing principles, methodologies, and defect management processes.
  • Experience executing functional, integration, regression, and end-to-end testing activities.
  • Ability to design, execute, and maintain automated testing solutions.
  • Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills.
  • Excellent attention to detail and commitment to software quality.
  • Ability to communicate effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities, meet deadlines, and perform effectively in a fast-paced environment.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience integrating automated testing capabilities into CI/CD pipelines and DevOps environments.
  • Experience with API testing tools and service validation techniques.
  • Familiarity with performance, load, or scalability testing approaches and tools.
  • Experience supporting cloud-hosted applications, particularly within Microsoft Azure environments.
  • Experience testing enterprise business systems and complex application integrations.

Additional Compensation: KBR may offer bonuses, commissions, or other forms of compensation to certain job titles or levels, per internal policy or contractual designation. Additional compensation may be in the form of sign on bonus, relocation benefits, short term incentives, long term incentives, or discretionary payments for exceptional performance.

Benefits: KBR offers a selection of competitive lifestyle benefits which could include a 401K plan with company match, medical, dental, vision, life insurance, AD&D, flexible spending account, disability, paid time off, or flexible work schedule. We support career advancement through professional training and development.

Belong, Connect and Grow at KBR

At KBR, we are passionate about our people and our Zero Harm culture. These inform all that we do and are at the heart of our commitment to, and ongoing journey toward being a People First company. That commitment is central to our team of team’s philosophy and fosters an environment where everyone can Belong, Connect and Grow. We Deliver – Together.

KBR is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, disability, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, national origin, veteran status, genetic information, union status and/or beliefs, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local law.

About Huzzle

At Huzzle, we connect exceptional talent with top opportunities at leading companies across the UK, US, Canada, Europe, and Australia. Our clients include startups, digital agencies, and tech platforms in industries such as SaaS, MarTech, FinTech, and EdTech. Unlike an outsourcing agency, we place you directly with a client where you’re hired in-house as a valued member of their team.

Role Type: Full-time

Engagement: Independent Contractor

Job Summary

We're looking for a results-driven Media Buyer with at least 3 years of experience planning, executing, and optimizing paid advertising campaigns.

In this role, you'll take ownership of paid media campaigns across platforms such as Meta Ads and Google Ads, focusing on driving conversions, maximizing return on ad spend (ROAS), and scaling campaign performance.

The ideal candidate combines strong analytical skills with a creative, test-and-learn mindset and knows how to turn advertising budgets into measurable business results.

Previous experience working in a marketing or advertising agency is a plus, but not required.

Key Responsibilities

  • Plan, launch, manage, and optimize paid advertising campaigns across Meta Ads, Google Ads, and other relevant platforms.
  • Develop and execute paid media strategies focused on lead generation, customer acquisition, and revenue growth.
  • Monitor and improve key performance metrics, including ROAS, CPA, CPC, CTR, and conversion rates.
  • Manage advertising budgets effectively to maximize campaign profitability.
  • Conduct audience research, competitor analysis, and A/B testing to improve campaign performance.
  • Collaborate with creative teams to develop and test high-converting ad creatives and messaging.
  • Analyze campaign data, identify opportunities for improvement, and provide actionable performance insights.
  • Stay up to date with advertising platform updates, industry trends, and performance marketing best practices.

Requirements

  • 3+ years of hands-on experience in media buying, paid advertising, or performance marketing.
  • Proven experience managing and optimizing campaigns using Meta Ads Manager and Google Ads.
  • Strong understanding of paid media strategies, audience targeting, campaign optimization, and conversion tracking.
  • Experience managing advertising budgets and delivering measurable campaign results.
  • Proficiency with analytics and tracking tools such as Google Analytics (GA4) and Google Tag Manager.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with a data-driven approach to decision-making.
  • Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple campaigns, prioritize tasks, and work independently in a remote environment.

Nice to Have

  • Previous experience working in a digital marketing agency, advertising agency, or performance marketing agency.
  • Experience managing campaigns across multiple clients or industries.
  • Familiarity with additional advertising platforms such as TikTok Ads, LinkedIn Ads, or YouTube Ads.
  • Experience with conversion rate optimization (CRO), landing pages, and marketing automation.
  • Google Ads or Meta Blueprint certifications.

Benefits

💰 Competitive compensation based on experience and expertise.

🌎 100% remote opportunity - work from anywhere.

🚀 Work with international companies across exciting and fast-growing industries.

📈 Career growth opportunities with established businesses and ambitious marketing teams.

🎯 High-impact role where your expertise directly contributes to business growth.

🤝 Direct client placement - become an integral part of the company's team rather than working through a traditional outsourcing agency.

💻 Collaborative environment with opportunities to develop your performance marketing expertise.
